Before either\n//     attempted step leaves the board, its matching flap delivers the cat;\n//     the other coat leaves it puzzled on the edge tile. No flap means a wall.\n//     Along-edge movement and merely standing on that tile do not use a flap.\n//\n// 11. Actual entry into a tunnel relocates to its partner, preserving direction.\n//     The exit has no effects this tick and standing there never triggers a return.\n//\n// Level data (format 1) can grow: each kind of piece is its own optional list\n// (missing = none), and a hatch's cat is a coat name or an object with a coat.\n// ============================================================================\nconst GR_DIR = { R: 0, D: 1, L: 2, U: 3 }, GR_DIRS = ['R', 'D', 'L', 'U'];\nconst GR_DX = [1, 0, -1, 0], GR_DY = [0, 1, 0, -1];\nconst GR_TICK_MS = 300, GR_TIME_LIMIT = 36, GR_RELEASE_EVERY = 2;\nconst GR_GINGER = 1, GR_BLUE = 2, GR_COAT = { ginger: 1, blue: 2 }, GR_COATS = [null, 'ginger', 'blue'];\nconst GR_PLAIN = 0, GR_TYPE = { plain: 0, ginger: 1, blue: 2 }, GR_TYPES = ['plain', 'ginger', 'blue'];\nconst GC_FLOOR = 0, GC_DOG = 1, GC_BASKET_GINGER = 2, GC_BASKET_BLUE = 3, GC_HATCH = 4, GC_GATE = 5, GC_TUNNEL = 6;\nconst GO_RUNNING = 'running', GO_WON = 'won', GO_WRONG = 'wrongBasket', GO_TIME_UP = 'timeUp';\nconst GL_WAIT = 0, GL_BOARD = 1, GL_DONE = 2, GL_WRONG = 3, GL_STATES = ['waiting', 'travelling', 'delivered', 'puzzled'];\nconst GE_NONE = 0, GE_RELEASED = 1, GE_MOVED = 2, GE_DELIVERED = 3, GE_WRONG = 4, GE_STUCK = 5, GE_TUNNEL = 6, GE_WAIT = 7;\nconst GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS = ['circle', 'square', 'triangle', 'diamond'];\n\nconst grList = (a) => a || [];                          // a piece list a level leaves out is empty\nfunction grCatCoat(c) {\n  const coat = c !== null && typeof c === 'object' ? c.coat : c;\n  return Object.hasOwn(GR_COAT, coat) ? GR_COAT[coat] : 0;\n}\n\nfunction grCatBig(c) { return !!(c && typeof c === 'object' && c.big === true); }\n// Only actual movement attempts count; a bounce, stuck attempt or tunnel keeps the schedule.\nfunction grCanMove(s, i, t) { const age = t - s.releaseTick[i]; return !s.big[i] || age > 0 && age % 2 === 0; }\n\n// A fresh simulation of a level with the player's turntables ([{x, y, type, dir}]).\nfunction grCreate(level, placements) {\n  const W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h;\n  const cell = new Int8Array(W * H), chDir = new Int8Array(W * H).fill(-1), chType = new Int8Array(W * H);\n  const gates = grList(level.gates), gateAt = new Int16Array(W * H).fill(-1), gateExit = new Int8Array(gates.length * 2);\n  const flaps = grList(level.flaps), flapAt = new Int16Array(W * H * 4).fill(-1);\n  const tunnels = grList(level.tunnels), tunnelAt = new Int8Array(W * H).fill(-1), tunnelTo = new Int16Array(W * H).fill(-1);\n  for (let t = 0; t < tunnels.length; t++) {\n    const p = tunnels[t], a = p.a.y * W + p.a.x, b = p.b.y * W + p.b.x;\n    cell[a] = cell[b] = GC_TUNNEL; tunnelAt[a] = tunnelAt[b] = t; tunnelTo[a] = b; tunnelTo[b] = a;\n  }\n  for (let f = 0; f < flaps.length; f++) {\n    const p = flaps[f]; flapAt[(p.y * W + p.x) * 4 + GR_DIR[p.side]] = f;\n  }\n  for (let g = 0; g < gates.length; g++) {\n    const p = gates[g], k = p.y * W + p.x;\n    cell[k] = GC_GATE; gateAt[k] = g;\n    gateExit[g * 2] = GR_DIR[p.exits[0]]; gateExit[g * 2 + 1] = GR_DIR[p.exits[1]];\n  }\n  for (const d of grList(level.dogs)) cell[d.y * W + d.x] = GC_DOG;\n  for (const b of grList(level.baskets)) cell[b.y * W + b.x] = GR_COAT[b.coat] === GR_GINGER ? GC_BASKET_GINGER : GC_BASKET_BLUE;\n  let n = 0;\n  const hatches = grList(level.hatches).map((h) => {\n    cell[h.y * W + h.x] = GC_HATCH;\n    const hatch = { x: h.x, y: h.y, dir: GR_DIR[h.dir], first: n, count: h.cats.length };\n    n += h.cats.length;\n    return hatch;\n  });\n  for (const p of grList(placements)) { chDir[p.y * W + p.x] = GR_DIR[p.dir]; chType[p.y * W + p.x] = GR_TYPE[p.type]; }\n  const s = {\n    W, H, cell, chDir, chType, hatches, n, tick: 0, endTick: -1, timeLimit: level.timeLimit || GR_TIME_LIMIT,\n    outcome: GO_RUNNING, delivered: 0, puzzled: 0, wrong: -1, wrongTick: -1,\n    gates, gateAt, gateExit, gateState: new Uint8Array(gates.length), moveOrder: new Int16Array(n),\n    tunnels, tunnelAt, tunnelTo, tunnelUses: new Int32Array(tunnels.length),\n    tunnelPair: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1), entryX: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1), entryY: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1),\n    flaps, flapAt, homeFlap: new Int16Array(n).fill(-1),\n    // At most one gate entry per cat per tick. Ordered events feed the animation trace.\n    flipCount: 0, flipGate: new Int16Array(n), flipCat: new Int16Array(n), flipFrom: new Uint8Array(n),\n    // solver hook: per-tile bits of the coats whose turntable is still undecided (null in the game)\n    undec: null, paused: false, pendI: -1, pendK: -1, turns: new Int16Array(W * H), dogHits: 0,\n    // per cat: coat, state, tile and heading (a waiting cat sits on its hatch), and this tick's move (for animation)\n    hasBig: false, big: new Uint8Array(n), releaseTick: new Int32Array(n),\n    coat: new Int8Array(n), st: new Int8Array(n), x: new Int8Array(n), y: new Int8Array(n), dir: new Int8Array(n),\n    px: new Int8Array(n), py: new Int8Array(n), pdir: new Int8Array(n), ev: new Int8Array(n), bounced: new Int8Array(n),\n  };\n  grList(level.hatches).forEach((h, k) => {\n    for (let j = 0; j < h.cats.length; j++) {\n      const i = hatches[k].first + j;\n      s.big[i] = grCatBig(h.cats[j]) ? 1 : 0; s.hasBig = s.hasBig || !!s.big[i]; s.releaseTick[i] = j * GR_RELEASE_EVERY;\n      s.coat[i] = grCatCoat(h.cats[j]); s.x[i] = h.x; s.y[i] = h.y; s.dir[i] = hatches[k].dir;\n    }\n  });\n  // Cat IDs and result arrays stay hatch-major. Only this separate index is release-major.\n  for (let j = 0, q = 0; q < n; j++) for (let k = 0; k < hatches.length; k++) {\n    if (j < hatches[k].count) s.moveOrder[q++] = hatches[k].first + j;\n  }\n  return s;\n}\nfunction grBlocked(s, x, y) {\n  return x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= s.W || y >= s.H || s.cell[y * s.W + x] === GC_DOG;\n}\n// One settlement path preserves wrong-destination diagnostics for baskets/flaps.\nfunction grSettle(s, i, coat) {\n  if (coat === s.coat[i]) { s.st[i] = GL_DONE; s.delivered++; s.ev[i] = GE_DELIVERED; }\n  else {\n    s.st[i] = GL_WRONG; s.puzzled++; s.ev[i] = GE_WRONG;\n    if (s.wrong < 0 || (s.wrongTick === s.tick && i < s.wrong)) { s.wrong = i; s.wrongTick = s.tick; }\n  }\n}\nfunction grFlapAt(s, i, d) { return s.flapAt[(s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i]) * 4 + d]; }\nfunction grExitFlap(s, i, d) {\n  const f = grFlapAt(s, i, d);\n  if (f < 0) return false;\n  s.homeFlap[i] = f; s.dir[i] = d;\n  grSettle(s, i, GR_COAT[s.flaps[f].coat]);\n  return true;\n}\n// Rule 5: what entering a tile does.\nfunction grEnter(s, i) {\n  const k = s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i], c = s.cell[k];\n  // An entry consumes this move. Never settle the destination or recurse.\n  if (c === GC_TUNNEL) {\n    const pair = s.tunnelAt[k], to = s.tunnelTo[k];\n    s.entryX[i] = s.x[i]; s.entryY[i] = s.y[i]; s.tunnelPair[i] = pair;\n    s.x[i] = to % s.W; s.y[i] = Math.floor(to / s.W); s.ev[i] = GE_TUNNEL; s.tunnelUses[pair]++;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (c === GC_BASKET_GINGER || c === GC_BASKET_BLUE) {\n    grSettle(s, i, c === GC_BASKET_GINGER ? GR_GINGER : GR_BLUE);\n    return;\n  }\n  if (c === GC_GATE) {\n    const g = s.gateAt[k], from = s.gateState[g], e = s.flipCount++;\n    s.dir[i] = s.gateExit[g * 2 + from]; s.gateState[g] = 1 - from;\n    s.flipGate[e] = g; s.flipCat[e] = i; s.flipFrom[e] = from;\n    return;\n  }\n  if (s.undec !== null && (s.undec[k] & s.coat[i])) { s.pendI = i; s.pendK = k; s.paused = true; return; }\n  const d = s.chDir[k];\n  if (d >= 0 && (s.chType[k] === GR_PLAIN || s.chType[k] === s.coat[i])) {\n    if (d !== s.dir[i]) s.turns[k]++;\n    s.dir[i] = d;\n  }\n}\n// Rule 4: step; into a wall or a dog, reverse and try the other way in the same tick.\nfunction grMove(s, i) {\n  let d = s.dir[i], nx = s.x[i] + GR_DX[d], ny = s.y[i] + GR_DY[d];\n  if ((nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= s.W || ny >= s.H) && grExitFlap(s, i, d)) return;\n  if (grBlocked(s, nx, ny)) {\n    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < s.W && ny < s.H) s.dogHits++;\n    d = (d + 2) & 3; s.dir[i] = d; s.bounced[i] = 1;\n    nx = s.x[i] + GR_DX[d]; ny = s.y[i] + GR_DY[d];\n    if ((nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= s.W || ny >= s.H) && grExitFlap(s, i, d)) return;\n    if (grBlocked(s, nx, ny)) { s.ev[i] = GE_STUCK; return; }\n  }\n  s.x[i] = nx; s.y[i] = ny; s.ev[i] = GE_MOVED;\n  grEnter(s, i);\n}\n// One tick (rules 2, 3 and 8). Does nothing once the outcome is decided.\nfunction grTick(s) {\n  if (s.outcome !== GO_RUNNING || s.paused) return s;\n  const t = s.tick; s.flipCount = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) { s.px[i] = s.x[i]; s.py[i] = s.y[i]; s.pdir[i] = s.dir[i]; s.ev[i] = GE_NONE; s.bounced[i] = 0; s.tunnelPair[i] = s.entryX[i] = s.entryY[i] = -1; }\n  for (let q = 0; q < s.n; q++) {                                                 // 1. move\n    const i = s.moveOrder[q];\n    if (s.st[i] !== GL_BOARD) continue;\n    if (!grCanMove(s, i, t)) { s.ev[i] = GE_WAIT; continue; }\n    grMove(s, i);\n    if (s.paused) return s;                                                        // the solver takes over\n  }\n  if (t % GR_RELEASE_EVERY === 0) {                                               // 2. release\n    const j = t / GR_RELEASE_EVERY;\n    for (let k = 0; k < s.hatches.length; k++) {\n      const h = s.hatches[k];\n      if (j < h.count) { s.st[h.first + j] = GL_BOARD; s.ev[h.first + j] = GE_RELEASED; }\n    }\n  }\n  s.tick = t + 1;\n  if (s.delivered + s.puzzled === s.n) s.outcome = s.puzzled ? GO_WRONG : GO_WON;    // every cat has settled\n  else if (s.tick >= s.timeLimit) s.outcome = s.puzzled ? GO_WRONG : GO_TIME_UP;\n  if (s.outcome !== GO_RUNNING) s.endTick = t;\n  return s;\n}\nfunction grRun(level, placements) {\n  const s = grCreate(level, placements);\n  while (s.outcome === GO_RUNNING) grTick(s);\n  return s;\n}\n// The result as plain data (what tests/golden.json stores): cats hatch by hatch, in release order.\nfunction grResult(s) {\n  const cats = [];\n  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) {\n    const cat = { coat: GR_COATS[s.coat[i]], x: s.x[i], y: s.y[i], dir: GR_DIRS[s.dir[i]], state: GL_STATES[s.st[i]] };\n    if (s.big[i]) cat.big = true;\n    if (s.homeFlap[i] >= 0) {\n      const f = s.flaps[s.homeFlap[i]];\n      cat.destination = { kind: 'flap', side: f.side, coat: f.coat };\n    }\n    cats.push(cat);\n  }\n  const result = { outcome: s.outcome, endTick: s.endTick, cats };\n  if (s.gates.length) result.gates = s.gates.map((g, i) => ({ x: g.x, y: g.y, exit: GR_DIRS[s.gateExit[i * 2 + s.gateState[i]]] }));\n  return result;\n}\n// Static checks on a level (bounds, overlaps, names) and on a set of turntables (the tray).\nfunction grValidate(level, placements) {\n  if (!level || !level.board) return ['level needs a board'];\n  const errs = [], W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h, used = {};\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(W) || !Number.isSafeInteger(H) || W < 1 || H < 1) return ['board dimensions must be positive whole tiles'];\n  if (level.timeLimit !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(level.timeLimit) || level.timeLimit < 1)) errs.push('timeLimit must be a positive whole tick count');\n  for (const kind of ['hatches', 'baskets', 'dogs', 'gates']) {\n    const list = level[kind];\n    if (list !== undefined && list !== null && (!Array.isArray(list) || list.some(p => !p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p))))\n      return errs.concat(kind + ' must be a list of piece records');\n  }\n  if (placements !== undefined && placements !== null && (!Array.isArray(placements) || placements.some(p => !p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p))))\n    return errs.concat('turntables must be a list of piece records');\n  if (level.tray !== undefined) {\n    if (!level.tray || typeof level.tray !== 'object' || Array.isArray(level.tray)) errs.push('tray must be an object');\n    else for (const type of GR_TYPES) if (level.tray[type] !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(level.tray[type]) || level.tray[type] < 0))\n      errs.push('tray.' + type + ' must be a non-negative whole count');\n  }\n  const put = (what, x, y) => {\n    if (!Number.isInteger(x) || !Number.isInteger(y)) errs.push(what + ' coordinates must be whole tiles');\n    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= W || y >= H) errs.push(what + ' outside the board at ' + x + ',' + y);\n    const k = x + ',' + y;\n    if (used[k]) errs.push(what + ' overlaps ' + used[k] + ' at ' + k);\n    used[k] = what;\n  };\n  for (const h of grList(level.hatches)) {\n    put('hatch', h.x, h.y);\n    if (GR_DIRS.indexOf(h.dir) < 0) errs.push('bad hatch dir ' + h.dir);\n    if (!Array.isArray(h.cats) || !h.cats.length) errs.push('a hatch at ' + h.x + ',' + h.y + ' needs a non-empty cats list');\n    else for (const c of h.cats) {\n      if (!grCatCoat(c)) errs.push('bad cat coat ' + JSON.stringify(c));\n      if (c && typeof c === 'object' && Object.hasOwn(c, 'big') && typeof c.big !== 'boolean') errs.push('cat big flag must be boolean');\n    }\n  }\n  for (const b of grList(level.baskets)) { put('basket', b.x, b.y); if (b.coat !== 'ginger' && b.coat !== 'blue') errs.push('bad basket coat ' + b.coat); }\n  for (const d of grList(level.dogs)) put('dog', d.x, d.y);\n  for (const g of grList(level.gates)) {\n    put('gate', g.x, g.y);\n    if (!Number.isInteger(g.x) || !Number.isInteger(g.y)) errs.push('gate coordinates must be whole tiles');\n    if (!Array.isArray(g.exits) || g.exits.length !== 2 || !GR_DIRS.includes(g.exits[0]) || !GR_DIRS.includes(g.exits[1]) ||\n        g.exits[0] === g.exits[1]) errs.push('gate exits must be two different directions');\n  }\n  if (level.tunnels !== undefined) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(level.tunnels)) errs.push('tunnels must be a list of complete pairs');\n    else {\n      const symbols = new Set();\n      if (level.tunnels.length > 4) errs.push('at most four tunnel pairs');\n      for (const t of level.tunnels) {\n        if (!t || typeof t !== 'object' || Array.isArray(t) || !t.a || !t.b ||\n            typeof t.a !== 'object' || typeof t.b !== 'object' || Array.isArray(t.a) || Array.isArray(t.b)) {\n          errs.push('tunnel needs two endpoint records'); continue;\n        }\n        if (!GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS.includes(t.symbol) || symbols.has(t.symbol)) errs.push('tunnel symbols must be distinct circle/square/triangle/diamond');\n        symbols.add(t.symbol);\n        for (const e of [t.a, t.b]) {\n          put('tunnel', e.x, e.y);\n          if (Array.isArray(level.flaps) && level.flaps.some(f => f && f.x === e.x && f.y === e.y)) errs.push('tunnel overlaps flap');\n          if (grList(level.hatches).some(h => h.x + GR_DX[GR_DIR[h.dir]] === e.x && h.y + GR_DY[GR_DIR[h.dir]] === e.y)) errs.push('tunnel cannot be a hatch exit tile');\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  if (level.flaps !== undefined && !Array.isArray(level.flaps)) errs.push('flaps must be a list');\n  else {\n    const edges = new Set();\n    for (const f of grList(level.flaps)) {\n      if (!f || typeof f !== 'object') { errs.push('invalid flap record'); continue; }\n      const tile = Number.isInteger(f.x) && Number.isInteger(f.y) && f.x >= 0 && f.y >= 0 && f.x < W && f.y < H;\n      if (!tile) errs.push('flap coordinates must be whole tiles inside the board');\n      if (!GR_DIRS.includes(f.side)) errs.push('bad flap side ' + f.side);\n      else if (tile && !((f.side === 'R' && f.x === W - 1) || (f.side === 'L' && f.x === 0) ||\n          (f.side === 'D' && f.y === H - 1) || (f.side === 'U' && f.y === 0))) errs.push('flap side must face an outer edge');\n      if (f.coat !== 'ginger' && f.coat !== 'blue') errs.push('bad flap coat ' + f.coat);\n      const key = f.x + ',' + f.y + ',' + f.side;\n      if (edges.has(key)) errs.push('duplicate flap side at ' + key);\n      edges.add(key);\n      if (grList(level.hatches).some(h => h.x === f.x && h.y === f.y && h.dir === f.side)) errs.push('flap conflicts with hatch direction at ' + key);\n    }\n  }\n  if (placements) {\n    const tray = level.tray || {}, left = { plain: tray.plain | 0, ginger: tray.ginger | 0, blue: tray.blue | 0 };\n    for (const p of placements) {\n      put('turntable', p.x, p.y);\n      if (GR_DIRS.indexOf(p.dir) < 0) errs.push('bad turntable dir ' + p.dir);\n      if (GR_TYPES.indexOf(p.type) < 0) errs.push('bad turntable type ' + p.type);\n      else if (--left[p.type] < 0) errs.push('the tray has no spare ' + p.type + ' turntable');\n    }\n  }\n  return errs;\n}\nif (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {\n  module.exports = { grCreate, grTick, grRun, grResult, grValidate, grEnter, grCatCoat, grCatBig, grCanMove, grFlapAt, GR_DIR, GR_DIRS, GR_DX, GR_DY, GR_TICK_MS,\n    GR_TIME_LIMIT, GR_GINGER, GR_BLUE, GR_COAT, GR_COATS, GR_PLAIN, GR_TYPE, GR_TYPES, GC_FLOOR, GC_DOG,\n    GC_BASKET_GINGER, GC_BASKET_BLUE, GC_HATCH, GC_GATE, GC_TUNNEL, GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS, GO_RUNNING, GO_WON, GO_WRONG,\n    GO_TIME_UP, GL_WAIT, GL_BOARD, GL_DONE, GL_WRONG, GL_STATES, GE_NONE, GE_RELEASED, GE_MOVED, GE_DELIVERED, GE_WRONG, GE_STUCK, GE_TUNNEL, GE_WAIT };\n}\n\n// Optional generated content. Missing permissions are off; unsupported opt-ins\n// fail explicitly until their room's rule phase implements them. No RNG use.\nconst PIECE_PERMISSIONS = (function () {\n  const names = ['flaps', 'points', 'tunnels', 'bigCats'];\n  const off = Object.freeze({ flaps: false, points: false, tunnels: false, bigCats: false });\n  function read(settings) {\n    if (settings.allowedPieces === undefined) return off;\n    const source = settings.allowedPieces;\n    if (!source || typeof source !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source)) throw new RangeError('allowedPieces must be a piece-permission object');\n    const out = { ...off };\n    for (const name of Object.keys(source)) {\n      if (!names.includes(name) || typeof source[name] !== 'boolean') throw new RangeError('invalid piece permission ' + name);\n      out[name] = source[name];\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n  return { read };\n})();\nif (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = PIECE_PERMISSIONS;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 11 SOLVER: exhaustive solver for the puzzle. Runs in Node (tests,\n// tools/check-levels.js) and in the page (the ?edit level editor's Check button).\n// Uses the game's own rules (10_rules.js), so it can never disagree with play.\n//\n// A solution is a set of turntables taken from the tray (any subset, each on a free\n// floor tile, one per tile, any of 4 directions) that wins, where every turntable\n// turns at least one cat at least once. Layouts that differ only by turntables nothing\n// ever uses count once, which keeps the solution count meaningful.\n//\n// Search: re-run the simulation from scratch, including every fixed gate's state.\n// Gates are not free floor, so neither search places a turntable on them. No state\n// is shared between branches. The first time a cat of coat c enters a\n// free tile whose content is still undecided for c, branch on\n//   nothing acts on c here | plain turntable x4 directions | c-coloured turntable x4\n// (a turntable of the other coat is decided later, if and when that coat arrives).\n// Every winning layout with no idle turntables is reached by exactly one branch path.\n// A wrong basket ends a branch at once: no later choice can undo it.\n// opts: maxNodes (give up past this many, truncated), keep (solutions to return), stopAfter (stop once more\n// than this many solutions are found, stopped: then count is only a lower bound, for generators that just\n// need to know a level has too many).\n// ============================================================================\nconst SOLVER = (function () {\nconst R = (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) ? require('./10_rules.js')\n  : { grCreate, grTick, grRun, grValidate, GR_GINGER, GR_BLUE, GR_TYPES, GR_DIRS, GC_FLOOR, GE_TUNNEL, GO_RUNNING, GO_WON };\nconst TYPES = R.GR_TYPES, DIRS = R.GR_DIRS;\n\nfunction solve(level, opts) {\n  const errors = R.grValidate(level, null);\n  if (errors.length) throw new RangeError(errors.join('; '));\n  const maxNodes = (opts && opts.maxNodes) || 5e6, keep = (opts && opts.keep) || 50, stopAfter = (opts && opts.stopAfter) || Infinity;\n  const W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h, N = W * H;\n  const base = R.grCreate(level, []);\n  const chDir = new Int8Array(N).fill(-1), chType = new Int8Array(N), undec = new Uint8Array(N);\n  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) undec[k] = base.cell[k] === R.GC_FLOOR ? 3 : 0;\n  const tray = [level.tray.plain | 0, level.tray.ginger | 0, level.tray.blue | 0];\n  const out = { solvable: false, count: 0, minTurntables: 0, best: null, solutions: [], nodes: 0, truncated: false, stopped: false };\n  let min = Infinity;\n\n  function run() {\n    const s = R.grCreate(level, []);\n    s.chDir.set(chDir); s.chType.set(chType); s.undec = undec;\n    while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING && !s.paused && s.puzzled === 0) R.grTick(s);\n    return s;\n  }\n  function record(s) {\n    const list = [];\n    for (let k = 0; Shared by tools/daily.js (which writes\n// daily/puzzles.json), the page and the tests.\n//  - Dates are calendar days written 'YYYY-MM-DD' (the player's local date); day\n//    numbers count days since 1970-01-01, so no time zone ever enters.\n//  - Puzzle #1 is the file's startDate; #n is the (n - 1)th day after it.\n//  - Weekdays: 0 Monday ... 6 Sunday.\n// Swift: struct DailyPuzzle, Calendar-free day numbers, the same score and text.\n// ============================================================================\nconst DAILY = (function () {\n  const WEEKDAYS = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];\n  const DAY_MS = 86400000, pad = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n;\n  function dayNumber(key) {\n    const m = /^(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})$/.exec(key || '');\n    if (!m) return NaN;\n    const t = Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]), d = new Date(t);\n    return d.getUTCMonth() === +m[2] - 1 && d.getUTCDate() === +m[3] ? daily.puzzles[i] : null;\n  }\n  // Difficulty: more turntables, bounces, cats and dogs, fewer solutions and a bigger board are harder.\n  // stats: { turntables, bounces, cats, dogs, solutions, area }\n  function difficulty(st) {\n    const v = 10 * st.turntables + 4 * Math.min(st.bounces, 6) + 3 * st.cats + 1.5 * st.dogs + 4 * (3 - Math.min(st.solutions, 3)) + 0.5 * (st.area - 20);\n    return Math.round(v * 10) / 10;\n  }\n  // The range of scores a weekday's targets allow ({ turntables: [lo, hi], ... } from daily/settings.json).\n  function difficultyRange(t, minArea, maxArea) {\n    return [difficulty({ turntables: t.turntables[0], bounces: t.bounces[0], cats: t.cats[0], dogs: t.dogs[0], solutions: t.solutions[1], area: minArea }),\n      difficulty({ turntables: t.turntables[1], bounces: t.bounces[1], cats: t.cats[1], dogs: t.dogs[1], solutions: t.solutions[0], area: maxArea })];\n  }\n  // The share card: no tiles, no directions, nothing that gives the solution away.\n  // attempts: [false, false, true] (each Send: failed or solved); stars: { delivered, tidy, firstPost }\n  function shareText(entry, attempts, turntables, stars) {\n    const n = (stars.delivered ? 1 : 0) + (stars.tidy ? 1 : 0) + (stars.firstPost ? 1 : 0);\n    return 'Cats by Post #' + entry.number + ' · ' + WEEKDAYS[weekday(entry.date)] + '\\n' +\n      attempts.map((ok) => (ok ? k=base.y[i]*W+base.x[i];if(base.ev[i]!==R.GE_MOVED||occupied.has(k)||seen.has(k))continue;\n    seen.add(k);entries.push(k);\n  }}\n  if(!entries.length||free.length<2)return false;\n  const start=Math.floor(rnd()*entries.length*free.length),total=entries.length*free.length;\n  for(let n=0;n<total;n++){\n    const q=(start+n)%total,a=entries[Math.floor(q/free.length)],b=free[q%free.length];if(a===b)continue;\n    level.tunnels=[{a:{x:a%W,y:Math.floor(a/W)},b:{x:b%W,y:Math.floor(b/W)},symbol:'circle'}];\n    const s=R.grRun(level,level.solution);\n    if(s.outcome===R.GO_WON&&s.tunnelUses[0]>0&&level.solution.every(p=>s.turns[p.y*W+p.x]>0))return true;\n  }\n  delete level.tunnels;return false;\n}\n// Size conversion is opt-in only, after shared-piece construction. A bounded\n// rotation tries one big member in a mixed queue; real replay verifies its route.\nfunction addBigCats(level, rnd) {\n  const members = []; for (const h of level.hatches) for (let j=0;j<h.cats.length;j++) members.push({h,j,cat:h.cats[j]});\n  const start = Math.floor(rnd()*members.length);\n  for (let k=0;k<members.length;k++) {\n    for (const m of members) m.h.cats[m.j]=m.cat;\n    const m=members[(start+k)%members.length];m.h.cats[m.j]=typeof m.cat==='object'?{...m.cat,big:true}:{coat:m.cat,big:true};\n    const s=R.grRun(level,level.solution);\n    if(s.outcome===R.GO_WON&&level.solution.every(p=>s.turns[p.y*s.W+p.x]>0))return true;\n  }\n  for (const m of members) m.h.cats[m.j]=m.cat;return false;\n}\n// Every tile a layout's cats step on.\nfunction pathTiles(level, placements) {\n  const s = R.grCreate(level, placements), seen = new Set();\n  while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING) { R.grTick(s); for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) if (s.st[i] !== R.GL_WAIT) seen.add(s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i]); }\n  return seen;\n}\n// Bounces a layout makes (edges and dogs), summed over every cat and tick.\nfunction bounceCount(level, placements) {\n  const s = R.grCreate(level, placements);\n  let n = 0;\n  while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING) { R.grTick(s); for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) n += s.bounced[i]; }\n  return n;\n}\nfunction statsOf(level, r) {\n  return { turntables: r.minTurntables, bounces: Math.min(...r.solutions.map((sol) => bounceCount(level, sol))), cats: level.hatches.reduce((n, h) => n + h.cats.length, 0),\n    dogs: level.dogs.length, solutions: r.count, area: level.board.w * level.board.h, hatches: level.hatches.length };\n}\nfunction within(st, T, s) {\n  const [lo, hi] = CAL.difficultyRange(T, s.minBoard.w * s.minBoard.h, s.maxBoard.w * s.maxBoard.h), score = CAL.difficulty(st);\n  return st.turntables >= T.turntables[0] && st.turntables <= T.turntables[1] && st.bounces >= T.bounces[0] && st.cats >= T.cats[0] && st.cats <= T.cats[1] &&\n    st.dogs >= T.dogs[0] && st.dogs <= T.dogs[1] && st.solutions >= T.solutions[0] && st.solutions <= T.solutions[1] && score >= lo && score <= hi;\n}\nconst MAX_NODES = 400000;\nfunction finish(s, wd, built, rnd, why) {\n  const T = targetsFor(s, wd), L = built.level, W = L.board.w, need = L.solution.length, intended = S.key(L.solution);\n  if (R.grRun(L, L.solution).outcome !== R.GO_WON) { why.replay++; return null; }\n  // Added dogs stay off the intended route, so they cannot raise its bounce\n  // count. Reject an impossible weekday target before certifying other answers.\n  if (T.bounces[0] > 0 && bounceCount(L, L.solution) < T.bounces[0]) { why.targets++; return null; }\n  // Count solutions, stopping early while there are too many: enough of the others to see which tiles they need.\n  const count = () => S.solve(L, { maxNodes: MAX_NODES, stopAfter: T.solutions[1] + 24 });\n  let r = count();\n  if (r.truncated || !r.solvable) { why.solver++; return null; }\n  // Dogs never go in line with an intended turntable's arrow (that would make its reversed twin a solution too).\n  const inLine = new Set();\n  for (const p of L.solution) { const d = R.GR_DIR[p.dir]; for (const sgn of [1, -1]) { const x = p.x + sgn * DX[d], y = p.y + sgn * DY[d]; if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < W && y < L.board.h) inLine.add(y * W + x); } }\n  const untouched = new Set(built.untouched.filter((k) => !inLine.has(k)));\n  // Too many solutions, or a shorter one: a dog on the untouched tile the most other solutions need.\n  while ((r.stopped || r.count > T.solutions[1] || r.minTurntables < need) && L.dogs.length < T.dogs[1]) {\n    const votes = new Map(), vote = (k, n) => { if (untouched.has(k)) votes.set(k, (votes.get(k) || 0) + n); };\n    for (const sol of r.solutions) {\n      if (S.key(sol) === intended) continue;\n      for (const p of sol) vote(p.y * W + p.x, 3);                          // a dog here rules this one out\n      for (const k of pathTiles(L, sol)) vote(k, 1);                         // or sends its cats elsewhere\n    }\n    if (!votes.size) { why.inseparable++; return null; }                    // the others only use tiles the intended run needs\n    let k = -1, best = 0;\n    for (const [tile, n] of votes) if (n > best || (n === best && rnd() < 0.5)) { k = tile; best = n; }\n    untouched.delete(k); L.dogs.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0 });\n    // With no dogs left, surviving known answers can already prove failure.\n    // Drop idle turns and deduplicate before counting these lower-bound witnesses.\n    // Acceptance still needs a complete count: a new dog can create new answers.\n    if (L.dogs.length === T.dogs[1]) {\n      const surviving = new Set();\n      for (const sol of r.solutions) {\n        const state = R.grRun(L, sol);\n        if (state.outcome !== R.GO_WON) continue;\n        const active = sol.filter((p) => state.turns[p.y * W + p.x] > 0);\n        surviving.add(S.key(active));\n        if (active.length < need || surviving.size > T.solutions[1]) { why.tooMany++; return null; }\n      }\n    }\n    r = count();\n    if (r.truncated || !r.solvable) { why.solver++; return null; }\n  }\n  if (r.stopped || r.count > T.solutions[1] || r.minTurntables < need) { why.tooMany++; return null; }\n  // Too few dogs for the weekday: add ones the solution count can live with.\n  const spare = [...untouched];\n  while (L.dogs.length < T.dogs[0] && spare.length) {\n    const k = spare.splice(Math.floor(rnd() * spare.length), 1)[0];\n    L.dogs.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0 });\n    const r2 = S.solve(L, { maxNodes: MAX_NODES });\n    if (r2.truncated || r2.stopped || !r2.solvable || r2.count > T.solutions[1] || r2.minTurntables < need) L.dogs.pop(); else r = r2;\n  }\n  const st = statsOf(L, r);\n  if (!within(st, T, s)) { why.targets++; return null; }\n  L.minTurntables = r.minTurntables;\n  return { level: L, stats: st, difficulty: CAL.difficulty(st) };\n}\n  function practice(settings, seed, weekday, maxTries, onProgress) {\n    P.read(settings);\n    if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff) throw new RangeError('seed must be a 32-bit unsigned integer');\n    if (!Number.isInteger(weekday) || weekday < 0 || weekday > 6) throw new RangeError('weekday must be 0..6');\n    const limit = maxTries === undefined ? 120000 : maxTries;\n    if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw new RangeError('maxTries must be positive');\n    const random = rng(seed), why = { built: 0, replay: 0, solver: 0, inseparable: 0, tooMany: 0, targets: 0 };\n    for (let tries = 1; tries <= limit; tries++) {\n      const built = construct(settings, weekday, random);\n      if (built) {\n        why.built++;\n        const p = finish(settings, weekday, built, random, why);\n        if (p) return {\n          seed, weekday, tries, difficulty: p.difficulty, stats: p.stats,\n          level: Object.assign({ id: 'practice-' + weekday + '-' + seed, title: 'Practice · ' + CAL.WEEKDAYS[weekday] }, p.level),\n        };\n      }\n      if (onProgress && tries % 1000 === 0) onProgress(tries);\n    }\n    throw new Error('No ' + CAL.WEEKDAYS[weekday] + ' puzzle found for seed ' + seed + ' in ' + limit + ' tries');\n  }\n  function dateForWeekday(todayKey, weekday) {\n    if (Number.isNaN(CAL.dayNumber(todayKey)) || !Number.isInteger(weekday) || weekday < 0 || weekday > 6)\n      throw new RangeError('expected a valid date and weekday 0..6');\n    return CAL.keyOf(CAL.dayNumber(todayKey) + weekday - CAL.weekday(todayKey));\n  }\n  return { rng, targetsFor, construct, finish, statsOf, bounceCount, within, practice, dateForWeekday };\n})();\nif (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = PUZZLEGEN;\n\n// Bundled into a Blob worker by build.sh, so the game stays a single offline HTML file.\nself.onmessage = (event) => {\n  const { seed, weekday, allowedPieces } = event.data;\n  try {\n    const settings = allowedPieces === undefined ? DAILY_SETTINGS : { ...DAILY_SETTINGS, allowedPieces };\n    const puzzle = PUZZLEGEN.practice(settings, seed, weekday, undefined,\n      (tries) => self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', tries }));\n    self.postMessage({ type: 'ready', puzzle });\n  } catch (error) {\n    self.postMessage({ type: 'error', message: error.message });\n  }\n};\n";
// ============================================================================
// 10 RULES: the Cats by Post puzzle as a pure, deterministic simulation. No DOM,
// canvas, clock or randomness, and whole numbers only: the caller advances it
// one tick at a time, once every 300 ms. This is the part to port 1:1 to Swift,
// which runs the same golden cases (tests/golden.json).
//
// Board: x = column (+x right), y = row (+y down); (0,0) is the back corner tile,
// and the board's edges are walls. Level and result data use names that map to
// Swift enums: Dir U R D L; Coat ginger blue; TurntableType plain ginger blue;
// Outcome running won wrongBasket timeUp; CatState waiting travelling delivered
// puzzled. Inside, directions are 0 R, 1 D, 2 L, 3 U (clockwise, like the scene's
// E S W N) and coats 1 ginger, 2 blue (a coloured turntable has its coat's number).
//
// The rules (exact: the levels depend on them):
//  1. One tick every 300 ms (the caller's clock).
//  2. Each tick: first move travelling cats in release-tick order, breaking ties
//     by hatch list order. Then release new cats, also in hatch list order.
//  3. Each hatch releases its cats in order, one every 2 ticks from tick 0. A new
//     cat appears on the hatch tile facing the hatch's direction and starts
//     moving on the next tick.
//  4. A cat steps 1 tile. Into a wall or a dog it reverses and steps that way in
//     the same tick; if that's blocked too, it stays where it is.
//  5. Entering a tile: its own coat's basket delivers it; the other basket leaves
//     it puzzled there (the attempt has failed); a turntable turns it to face the
//     turntable's way (plain turns every cat, ginger only ginger, blue only blue).
//  6. Hatch tiles are plain floor once a cat has left them.
//  7. Cats pass through each other. A puzzled cat doesn't block its basket.
//  8. Won: every cat delivered. After a wrong basket the run plays on until every
//     cat is delivered or puzzled, or time runs out, and ends wrongBasket. Time up:
//     the level's time limit (36 ticks unless it sets timeLimit) with cats still out.
//  9. A gate (railway points) has two distinct exits and starts on the first. A cat
//     entering its tile turns to face the gate's current exit, then the gate switches
//     to its other exit. It turns every cat. Cats move in the order they were released,
//     so when two cats enter a gate in the same tick, the one released first takes the
//     current exit. A cat that stays where it is doesn't switch it. Each run starts
//     with every gate on its first exit.
//     Entry includes the reversed step of a bounce (rule 4), exactly once.
// 10. A coloured flap occupies one outer side of an edge tile. Before either
//     attempted step leaves the board, its matching flap delivers the cat;
//     the other coat leaves it puzzled on the edge tile. No flap means a wall.
//     Along-edge movement and merely standing on that tile do not use a flap.
//
// 11. Actual entry into a tunnel relocates to its partner, preserving direction.
//     The exit has no effects this tick and standing there never triggers a return.
//
// Level data (format 1) can grow: each kind of piece is its own optional list
// (missing = none), and a hatch's cat is a coat name or an object with a coat.
// ============================================================================
const GR_DIR = { R: 0, D: 1, L: 2, U: 3 }, GR_DIRS = ['R', 'D', 'L', 'U'];
const GR_DX = [1, 0, -1, 0], GR_DY = [0, 1, 0, -1];
const GR_TICK_MS = 300, GR_TIME_LIMIT = 36, GR_RELEASE_EVERY = 2;
const GR_GINGER = 1, GR_BLUE = 2, GR_COAT = { ginger: 1, blue: 2 }, GR_COATS = [null, 'ginger', 'blue'];
const GR_PLAIN = 0, GR_TYPE = { plain: 0, ginger: 1, blue: 2 }, GR_TYPES = ['plain', 'ginger', 'blue'];
const GC_FLOOR = 0, GC_DOG = 1, GC_BASKET_GINGER = 2, GC_BASKET_BLUE = 3, GC_HATCH = 4, GC_GATE = 5, GC_TUNNEL = 6;
const GO_RUNNING = 'running', GO_WON = 'won', GO_WRONG = 'wrongBasket', GO_TIME_UP = 'timeUp';
const GL_WAIT = 0, GL_BOARD = 1, GL_DONE = 2, GL_WRONG = 3, GL_STATES = ['waiting', 'travelling', 'delivered', 'puzzled'];
const GE_NONE = 0, GE_RELEASED = 1, GE_MOVED = 2, GE_DELIVERED = 3, GE_WRONG = 4, GE_STUCK = 5, GE_TUNNEL = 6, GE_WAIT = 7;
const GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS = ['circle', 'square', 'triangle', 'diamond'];

const grList = (a) => a || [];                          // a piece list a level leaves out is empty
function grCatCoat(c) {
  const coat = c !== null && typeof c === 'object' ? c.coat : c;
  return Object.hasOwn(GR_COAT, coat) ? GR_COAT[coat] : 0;
}

function grCatBig(c) { return !!(c && typeof c === 'object' && c.big === true); }
// Only actual movement attempts count; a bounce, stuck attempt or tunnel keeps the schedule.
function grCanMove(s, i, t) { const age = t - s.releaseTick[i]; return !s.big[i] || age > 0 && age % 2 === 0; }

// A fresh simulation of a level with the player's turntables ([{x, y, type, dir}]).
function grCreate(level, placements) {
  const W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h;
  const cell = new Int8Array(W * H), chDir = new Int8Array(W * H).fill(-1), chType = new Int8Array(W * H);
  const gates = grList(level.gates), gateAt = new Int16Array(W * H).fill(-1), gateExit = new Int8Array(gates.length * 2);
  const flaps = grList(level.flaps), flapAt = new Int16Array(W * H * 4).fill(-1);
  const tunnels = grList(level.tunnels), tunnelAt = new Int8Array(W * H).fill(-1), tunnelTo = new Int16Array(W * H).fill(-1);
  for (let t = 0; t < tunnels.length; t++) {
    const p = tunnels[t], a = p.a.y * W + p.a.x, b = p.b.y * W + p.b.x;
    cell[a] = cell[b] = GC_TUNNEL; tunnelAt[a] = tunnelAt[b] = t; tunnelTo[a] = b; tunnelTo[b] = a;
  }
  for (let f = 0; f < flaps.length; f++) {
    const p = flaps[f]; flapAt[(p.y * W + p.x) * 4 + GR_DIR[p.side]] = f;
  }
  for (let g = 0; g < gates.length; g++) {
    const p = gates[g], k = p.y * W + p.x;
    cell[k] = GC_GATE; gateAt[k] = g;
    gateExit[g * 2] = GR_DIR[p.exits[0]]; gateExit[g * 2 + 1] = GR_DIR[p.exits[1]];
  }
  for (const d of grList(level.dogs)) cell[d.y * W + d.x] = GC_DOG;
  for (const b of grList(level.baskets)) cell[b.y * W + b.x] = GR_COAT[b.coat] === GR_GINGER ? GC_BASKET_GINGER : GC_BASKET_BLUE;
  let n = 0;
  const hatches = grList(level.hatches).map((h) => {
    cell[h.y * W + h.x] = GC_HATCH;
    const hatch = { x: h.x, y: h.y, dir: GR_DIR[h.dir], first: n, count: h.cats.length };
    n += h.cats.length;
    return hatch;
  });
  for (const p of grList(placements)) { chDir[p.y * W + p.x] = GR_DIR[p.dir]; chType[p.y * W + p.x] = GR_TYPE[p.type]; }
  const s = {
    W, H, cell, chDir, chType, hatches, n, tick: 0, endTick: -1, timeLimit: level.timeLimit || GR_TIME_LIMIT,
    outcome: GO_RUNNING, delivered: 0, puzzled: 0, wrong: -1, wrongTick: -1,
    gates, gateAt, gateExit, gateState: new Uint8Array(gates.length), moveOrder: new Int16Array(n),
    tunnels, tunnelAt, tunnelTo, tunnelUses: new Int32Array(tunnels.length),
    tunnelPair: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1), entryX: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1), entryY: new Int8Array(n).fill(-1),
    flaps, flapAt, homeFlap: new Int16Array(n).fill(-1),
    // At most one gate entry per cat per tick. Ordered events feed the animation trace.
    flipCount: 0, flipGate: new Int16Array(n), flipCat: new Int16Array(n), flipFrom: new Uint8Array(n),
    // solver hook: per-tile bits of the coats whose turntable is still undecided (null in the game)
    undec: null, paused: false, pendI: -1, pendK: -1, turns: new Int16Array(W * H), dogHits: 0,
    // per cat: coat, state, tile and heading (a waiting cat sits on its hatch), and this tick's move (for animation)
    hasBig: false, big: new Uint8Array(n), releaseTick: new Int32Array(n),
    coat: new Int8Array(n), st: new Int8Array(n), x: new Int8Array(n), y: new Int8Array(n), dir: new Int8Array(n),
    px: new Int8Array(n), py: new Int8Array(n), pdir: new Int8Array(n), ev: new Int8Array(n), bounced: new Int8Array(n),
  };
  grList(level.hatches).forEach((h, k) => {
    for (let j = 0; j < h.cats.length; j++) {
      const i = hatches[k].first + j;
      s.big[i] = grCatBig(h.cats[j]) ? 1 : 0; s.hasBig = s.hasBig || !!s.big[i]; s.releaseTick[i] = j * GR_RELEASE_EVERY;
      s.coat[i] = grCatCoat(h.cats[j]); s.x[i] = h.x; s.y[i] = h.y; s.dir[i] = hatches[k].dir;
    }
  });
  // Cat IDs and result arrays stay hatch-major. Only this separate index is release-major.
  for (let j = 0, q = 0; q < n; j++) for (let k = 0; k < hatches.length; k++) {
    if (j < hatches[k].count) s.moveOrder[q++] = hatches[k].first + j;
  }
  return s;
}
function grBlocked(s, x, y) {
  return x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= s.W || y >= s.H || s.cell[y * s.W + x] === GC_DOG;
}
// One settlement path preserves wrong-destination diagnostics for baskets/flaps.
function grSettle(s, i, coat) {
  if (coat === s.coat[i]) { s.st[i] = GL_DONE; s.delivered++; s.ev[i] = GE_DELIVERED; }
  else {
    s.st[i] = GL_WRONG; s.puzzled++; s.ev[i] = GE_WRONG;
    if (s.wrong < 0 || (s.wrongTick === s.tick && i < s.wrong)) { s.wrong = i; s.wrongTick = s.tick; }
  }
}
function grFlapAt(s, i, d) { return s.flapAt[(s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i]) * 4 + d]; }
function grExitFlap(s, i, d) {
  const f = grFlapAt(s, i, d);
  if (f < 0) return false;
  s.homeFlap[i] = f; s.dir[i] = d;
  grSettle(s, i, GR_COAT[s.flaps[f].coat]);
  return true;
}
// Rule 5: what entering a tile does.
function grEnter(s, i) {
  const k = s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i], c = s.cell[k];
  // An entry consumes this move. Never settle the destination or recurse.
  if (c === GC_TUNNEL) {
    const pair = s.tunnelAt[k], to = s.tunnelTo[k];
    s.entryX[i] = s.x[i]; s.entryY[i] = s.y[i]; s.tunnelPair[i] = pair;
    s.x[i] = to % s.W; s.y[i] = Math.floor(to / s.W); s.ev[i] = GE_TUNNEL; s.tunnelUses[pair]++;
    return;
  }
  if (c === GC_BASKET_GINGER || c === GC_BASKET_BLUE) {
    grSettle(s, i, c === GC_BASKET_GINGER ? GR_GINGER : GR_BLUE);
    return;
  }
  if (c === GC_GATE) {
    const g = s.gateAt[k], from = s.gateState[g], e = s.flipCount++;
    s.dir[i] = s.gateExit[g * 2 + from]; s.gateState[g] = 1 - from;
    s.flipGate[e] = g; s.flipCat[e] = i; s.flipFrom[e] = from;
    return;
  }
  if (s.undec !== null && (s.undec[k] & s.coat[i])) { s.pendI = i; s.pendK = k; s.paused = true; return; }
  const d = s.chDir[k];
  if (d >= 0 && (s.chType[k] === GR_PLAIN || s.chType[k] === s.coat[i])) {
    if (d !== s.dir[i]) s.turns[k]++;
    s.dir[i] = d;
  }
}
// Rule 4: step; into a wall or a dog, reverse and try the other way in the same tick.
function grMove(s, i) {
  let d = s.dir[i], nx = s.x[i] + GR_DX[d], ny = s.y[i] + GR_DY[d];
  if ((nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= s.W || ny >= s.H) && grExitFlap(s, i, d)) return;
  if (grBlocked(s, nx, ny)) {
    if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < s.W && ny < s.H) s.dogHits++;
    d = (d + 2) & 3; s.dir[i] = d; s.bounced[i] = 1;
    nx = s.x[i] + GR_DX[d]; ny = s.y[i] + GR_DY[d];
    if ((nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= s.W || ny >= s.H) && grExitFlap(s, i, d)) return;
    if (grBlocked(s, nx, ny)) { s.ev[i] = GE_STUCK; return; }
  }
  s.x[i] = nx; s.y[i] = ny; s.ev[i] = GE_MOVED;
  grEnter(s, i);
}
// One tick (rules 2, 3 and 8). Does nothing once the outcome is decided.
function grTick(s) {
  if (s.outcome !== GO_RUNNING || s.paused) return s;
  const t = s.tick; s.flipCount = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) { s.px[i] = s.x[i]; s.py[i] = s.y[i]; s.pdir[i] = s.dir[i]; s.ev[i] = GE_NONE; s.bounced[i] = 0; s.tunnelPair[i] = s.entryX[i] = s.entryY[i] = -1; }
  for (let q = 0; q < s.n; q++) {                                                 // 1. move
    const i = s.moveOrder[q];
    if (s.st[i] !== GL_BOARD) continue;
    if (!grCanMove(s, i, t)) { s.ev[i] = GE_WAIT; continue; }
    grMove(s, i);
    if (s.paused) return s;                                                        // the solver takes over
  }
  if (t % GR_RELEASE_EVERY === 0) {                                               // 2. release
    const j = t / GR_RELEASE_EVERY;
    for (let k = 0; k < s.hatches.length; k++) {
      const h = s.hatches[k];
      if (j < h.count) { s.st[h.first + j] = GL_BOARD; s.ev[h.first + j] = GE_RELEASED; }
    }
  }
  s.tick = t + 1;
  if (s.delivered + s.puzzled === s.n) s.outcome = s.puzzled ? GO_WRONG : GO_WON;    // every cat has settled
  else if (s.tick >= s.timeLimit) s.outcome = s.puzzled ? GO_WRONG : GO_TIME_UP;
  if (s.outcome !== GO_RUNNING) s.endTick = t;
  return s;
}
function grRun(level, placements) {
  const s = grCreate(level, placements);
  while (s.outcome === GO_RUNNING) grTick(s);
  return s;
}
// The result as plain data (what tests/golden.json stores): cats hatch by hatch, in release order.
function grResult(s) {
  const cats = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) {
    const cat = { coat: GR_COATS[s.coat[i]], x: s.x[i], y: s.y[i], dir: GR_DIRS[s.dir[i]], state: GL_STATES[s.st[i]] };
    if (s.big[i]) cat.big = true;
    if (s.homeFlap[i] >= 0) {
      const f = s.flaps[s.homeFlap[i]];
      cat.destination = { kind: 'flap', side: f.side, coat: f.coat };
    }
    cats.push(cat);
  }
  const result = { outcome: s.outcome, endTick: s.endTick, cats };
  if (s.gates.length) result.gates = s.gates.map((g, i) => ({ x: g.x, y: g.y, exit: GR_DIRS[s.gateExit[i * 2 + s.gateState[i]]] }));
  return result;
}
// Static checks on a level (bounds, overlaps, names) and on a set of turntables (the tray).
function grValidate(level, placements) {
  if (!level || !level.board) return ['level needs a board'];
  const errs = [], W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h, used = {};
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(W) || !Number.isSafeInteger(H) || W < 1 || H < 1) return ['board dimensions must be positive whole tiles'];
  if (level.timeLimit !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(level.timeLimit) || level.timeLimit < 1)) errs.push('timeLimit must be a positive whole tick count');
  for (const kind of ['hatches', 'baskets', 'dogs', 'gates']) {
    const list = level[kind];
    if (list !== undefined && list !== null && (!Array.isArray(list) || list.some(p => !p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p))))
      return errs.concat(kind + ' must be a list of piece records');
  }
  if (placements !== undefined && placements !== null && (!Array.isArray(placements) || placements.some(p => !p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p))))
    return errs.concat('turntables must be a list of piece records');
  if (level.tray !== undefined) {
    if (!level.tray || typeof level.tray !== 'object' || Array.isArray(level.tray)) errs.push('tray must be an object');
    else for (const type of GR_TYPES) if (level.tray[type] !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(level.tray[type]) || level.tray[type] < 0))
      errs.push('tray.' + type + ' must be a non-negative whole count');
  }
  const put = (what, x, y) => {
    if (!Number.isInteger(x) || !Number.isInteger(y)) errs.push(what + ' coordinates must be whole tiles');
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= W || y >= H) errs.push(what + ' outside the board at ' + x + ',' + y);
    const k = x + ',' + y;
    if (used[k]) errs.push(what + ' overlaps ' + used[k] + ' at ' + k);
    used[k] = what;
  };
  for (const h of grList(level.hatches)) {
    put('hatch', h.x, h.y);
    if (GR_DIRS.indexOf(h.dir) < 0) errs.push('bad hatch dir ' + h.dir);
    if (!Array.isArray(h.cats) || !h.cats.length) errs.push('a hatch at ' + h.x + ',' + h.y + ' needs a non-empty cats list');
    else for (const c of h.cats) {
      if (!grCatCoat(c)) errs.push('bad cat coat ' + JSON.stringify(c));
      if (c && typeof c === 'object' && Object.hasOwn(c, 'big') && typeof c.big !== 'boolean') errs.push('cat big flag must be boolean');
    }
  }
  for (const b of grList(level.baskets)) { put('basket', b.x, b.y); if (b.coat !== 'ginger' && b.coat !== 'blue') errs.push('bad basket coat ' + b.coat); }
  for (const d of grList(level.dogs)) put('dog', d.x, d.y);
  for (const g of grList(level.gates)) {
    put('gate', g.x, g.y);
    if (!Number.isInteger(g.x) || !Number.isInteger(g.y)) errs.push('gate coordinates must be whole tiles');
    if (!Array.isArray(g.exits) || g.exits.length !== 2 || !GR_DIRS.includes(g.exits[0]) || !GR_DIRS.includes(g.exits[1]) ||
        g.exits[0] === g.exits[1]) errs.push('gate exits must be two different directions');
  }
  if (level.tunnels !== undefined) {
    if (!Array.isArray(level.tunnels)) errs.push('tunnels must be a list of complete pairs');
    else {
      const symbols = new Set();
      if (level.tunnels.length > 4) errs.push('at most four tunnel pairs');
      for (const t of level.tunnels) {
        if (!t || typeof t !== 'object' || Array.isArray(t) || !t.a || !t.b ||
            typeof t.a !== 'object' || typeof t.b !== 'object' || Array.isArray(t.a) || Array.isArray(t.b)) {
          errs.push('tunnel needs two endpoint records'); continue;
        }
        if (!GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS.includes(t.symbol) || symbols.has(t.symbol)) errs.push('tunnel symbols must be distinct circle/square/triangle/diamond');
        symbols.add(t.symbol);
        for (const e of [t.a, t.b]) {
          put('tunnel', e.x, e.y);
          if (Array.isArray(level.flaps) && level.flaps.some(f => f && f.x === e.x && f.y === e.y)) errs.push('tunnel overlaps flap');
          if (grList(level.hatches).some(h => h.x + GR_DX[GR_DIR[h.dir]] === e.x && h.y + GR_DY[GR_DIR[h.dir]] === e.y)) errs.push('tunnel cannot be a hatch exit tile');
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (level.flaps !== undefined && !Array.isArray(level.flaps)) errs.push('flaps must be a list');
  else {
    const edges = new Set();
    for (const f of grList(level.flaps)) {
      if (!f || typeof f !== 'object') { errs.push('invalid flap record'); continue; }
      const tile = Number.isInteger(f.x) && Number.isInteger(f.y) && f.x >= 0 && f.y >= 0 && f.x < W && f.y < H;
      if (!tile) errs.push('flap coordinates must be whole tiles inside the board');
      if (!GR_DIRS.includes(f.side)) errs.push('bad flap side ' + f.side);
      else if (tile && !((f.side === 'R' && f.x === W - 1) || (f.side === 'L' && f.x === 0) ||
          (f.side === 'D' && f.y === H - 1) || (f.side === 'U' && f.y === 0))) errs.push('flap side must face an outer edge');
      if (f.coat !== 'ginger' && f.coat !== 'blue') errs.push('bad flap coat ' + f.coat);
      const key = f.x + ',' + f.y + ',' + f.side;
      if (edges.has(key)) errs.push('duplicate flap side at ' + key);
      edges.add(key);
      if (grList(level.hatches).some(h => h.x === f.x && h.y === f.y && h.dir === f.side)) errs.push('flap conflicts with hatch direction at ' + key);
    }
  }
  if (placements) {
    const tray = level.tray || {}, left = { plain: tray.plain | 0, ginger: tray.ginger | 0, blue: tray.blue | 0 };
    for (const p of placements) {
      put('turntable', p.x, p.y);
      if (GR_DIRS.indexOf(p.dir) < 0) errs.push('bad turntable dir ' + p.dir);
      if (GR_TYPES.indexOf(p.type) < 0) errs.push('bad turntable type ' + p.type);
      else if (--left[p.type] < 0) errs.push('the tray has no spare ' + p.type + ' turntable');
    }
  }
  return errs;
}
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  module.exports = { grCreate, grTick, grRun, grResult, grValidate, grEnter, grCatCoat, grCatBig, grCanMove, grFlapAt, GR_DIR, GR_DIRS, GR_DX, GR_DY, GR_TICK_MS,
    GR_TIME_LIMIT, GR_GINGER, GR_BLUE, GR_COAT, GR_COATS, GR_PLAIN, GR_TYPE, GR_TYPES, GC_FLOOR, GC_DOG,
    GC_BASKET_GINGER, GC_BASKET_BLUE, GC_HATCH, GC_GATE, GC_TUNNEL, GR_TUNNEL_SYMBOLS, GO_RUNNING, GO_WON, GO_WRONG,
    GO_TIME_UP, GL_WAIT, GL_BOARD, GL_DONE, GL_WRONG, GL_STATES, GE_NONE, GE_RELEASED, GE_MOVED, GE_DELIVERED, GE_WRONG, GE_STUCK, GE_TUNNEL, GE_WAIT };
}
// Optional generated content. Missing permissions are off; unsupported opt-ins
// fail explicitly until their room's rule phase implements them. No RNG use.
const PIECE_PERMISSIONS = (function () {
  const names = ['flaps', 'points', 'tunnels', 'bigCats'];
  const off = Object.freeze({ flaps: false, points: false, tunnels: false, bigCats: false });
  function read(settings) {
    if (settings.allowedPieces === undefined) return off;
    const source = settings.allowedPieces;
    if (!source || typeof source !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source)) throw new RangeError('allowedPieces must be a piece-permission object');
    const out = { ...off };
    for (const name of Object.keys(source)) {
      if (!names.includes(name) || typeof source[name] !== 'boolean') throw new RangeError('invalid piece permission ' + name);
      out[name] = source[name];
    }
    return out;
  }
  return { read };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = PIECE_PERMISSIONS;
// ============================================================================
// 11 SOLVER: exhaustive solver for the puzzle. Runs in Node (tests,
// tools/check-levels.js) and in the page (the ?edit level editor's Check button).
// Uses the game's own rules (10_rules.js), so it can never disagree with play.
//
// A solution is a set of turntables taken from the tray (any subset, each on a free
// floor tile, one per tile, any of 4 directions) that wins, where every turntable
// turns at least one cat at least once. Layouts that differ only by turntables nothing
// ever uses count once, which keeps the solution count meaningful.
//
// Search: re-run the simulation from scratch, including every fixed gate's state.
// Gates are not free floor, so neither search places a turntable on them. No state
// is shared between branches. The first time a cat of coat c enters a
// free tile whose content is still undecided for c, branch on
//   nothing acts on c here | plain turntable x4 directions | c-coloured turntable x4
// (a turntable of the other coat is decided later, if and when that coat arrives).
// Every winning layout with no idle turntables is reached by exactly one branch path.
// A wrong basket ends a branch at once: no later choice can undo it.
// opts: maxNodes (give up past this many, truncated), keep (solutions to return), stopAfter (stop once more
// than this many solutions are found, stopped: then count is only a lower bound, for generators that just
// need to know a level has too many).
// ============================================================================
const SOLVER = (function () {
const R = (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) ? require('./10_rules.js')
  : { grCreate, grTick, grRun, grValidate, GR_GINGER, GR_BLUE, GR_TYPES, GR_DIRS, GC_FLOOR, GE_TUNNEL, GO_RUNNING, GO_WON };
const TYPES = R.GR_TYPES, DIRS = R.GR_DIRS;

function solve(level, opts) {
  const errors = R.grValidate(level, null);
  if (errors.length) throw new RangeError(errors.join('; '));
  const maxNodes = (opts && opts.maxNodes) || 5e6, keep = (opts && opts.keep) || 50, stopAfter = (opts && opts.stopAfter) || Infinity;
  const W = level.board.w, H = level.board.h, N = W * H;
  const base = R.grCreate(level, []);
  const chDir = new Int8Array(N).fill(-1), chType = new Int8Array(N), undec = new Uint8Array(N);
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) undec[k] = base.cell[k] === R.GC_FLOOR ? 3 : 0;
  const tray = [level.tray.plain | 0, level.tray.ginger | 0, level.tray.blue | 0];
  const out = { solvable: false, count: 0, minTurntables: 0, best: null, solutions: [], nodes: 0, truncated: false, stopped: false };
  let min = Infinity;

  function run() {
    const s = R.grCreate(level, []);
    s.chDir.set(chDir); s.chType.set(chType); s.undec = undec;
    while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING && !s.paused && s.puzzled === 0) R.grTick(s);
    return s;
  }
  function record(s) {
    const list = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) {
      if (chDir[k] < 0) continue;
      if (s.turns[k] === 0) return;                 // idle turntable: counted by the branch without it
      list.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0, type: TYPES[chType[k]], dir: DIRS[chDir[k]] });
    }
    out.count++; out.solvable = true;
    if (out.solutions.length < keep) out.solutions.push(list);
    if (list.length < min) { min = list.length; out.best = list; }
    if (out.count > stopAfter) out.stopped = true;
  }
  function search() {
    if (out.stopped) return;
    if (++out.nodes > maxNodes) { out.truncated = true; return; }
    const s = run();
    if (s.outcome === R.GO_WON) { record(s); return; }
    if (!s.paused) return;                          // failed: later choices can't change the past
    const k = s.pendK, c = s.coat[s.pendI], other = 3 - c, saved = undec[k];
    undec[k] = saved & ~c; search(); undec[k] = saved;
    if (tray[0] > 0 && (saved & other)) {           // plain acts on both colours
      tray[0]--; undec[k] = 0; chType[k] = 0;
      for (let d = 0; d < 4 && !out.truncated && !out.stopped; d++) { chDir[k] = d; search(); }
      chDir[k] = -1; undec[k] = saved; tray[0]++;
    }
    if (tray[c] > 0) {
      tray[c]--; undec[k] = 0; chType[k] = c;
      for (let d = 0; d < 4 && !out.truncated && !out.stopped; d++) { chDir[k] = d; search(); }
      chDir[k] = -1; undec[k] = saved; tray[c]++;
    }
  }
  search();
  out.minTurntables = out.solvable ? min : 0;
  return out;
}

// Replay a layout tick by tick and describe what happens (for level checks).
function analyse(level, chutes) {
  const s = R.grCreate(level, chutes), W = s.W;
  const seen = [];                                   // per cat: tile -> movement axes entered with
  for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) seen.push(new Map());
  const info = { won: false, ticks: 0, dogBounces: 0, selfCross: false, colourPass: false, types: new Set() };
  const chuteAt = new Map(chutes.map((c) => [c.y * W + c.x, c]));
  const turnedBy = new Map(), passedBy = new Map();
  while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING) {
    R.grTick(s);
    for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) {
      if (s.ev[i] === 1) { seen[i].set(s.y[i] * W + s.x[i], (s.dir[i] & 1) ? 2 : 1); continue; }   // released
      if (!(s.ev[i] === 2 || s.ev[i] === 3 || s.ev[i] === 4 || s.ev[i] === R.GE_TUNNEL)) continue;   // moved / delivered / wrong
      if (s.homeFlap[i] >= 0) continue;                  // outward settlement remains on the edge; it is not a tile entry
      const tunnel = s.ev[i] === R.GE_TUNNEL;
      const k = (tunnel ? s.entryY[i] : s.y[i]) * W + (tunnel ? s.entryX[i] : s.x[i]);
      const axis = (s.pdir[i] & 1) ? 2 : 1;
      const m = seen[i], prev = m.get(k) | 0;
      if (prev && !(prev & axis)) info.selfCross = true;
      m.set(k, prev | axis);
      if (tunnel) { seen[i].set(s.y[i] * W + s.x[i], axis); continue; }
      const c = chuteAt.get(k);
      if (c) {
        const acts = c.type === 'plain' || (c.type === 'ginger' ? s.coat[i] === R.GR_GINGER : s.coat[i] === R.GR_BLUE);
        (acts ? turnedBy : passedBy).set(c, ((acts ? turnedBy : passedBy).get(c) | 0) | s.coat[i]);
      }
    }
  }
  info.won = s.outcome === R.GO_WON; info.ticks = s.tick; info.dogBounces = s.dogHits; info.outcome = s.outcome;
  for (const c of chutes) info.types.add(c.type);
  // a coloured turntable that acts on its own coat and is crossed harmlessly by the other coat
  for (const c of chutes) if (c.type !== 'plain' && turnedBy.get(c) && passedBy.get(c)) info.colourPass = true;
  return info;
}
function key(list) { return list.map((c) => c.x + ',' + c.y + c.type[0] + c.dir).sort().join(' '); }

// Reference for the tests and tools/check-levels.js --exhaustive: try every legal placement of the tray's
// turntables (any subset, one per free floor tile, any of 4 directions), replay each in full, and count the
// ones that win with every turntable turning a cat. No pruning: slow, but too simple to be wrong.
function exhaustive(level) {
  const errors = R.grValidate(level, null);
  if (errors.length) throw new RangeError(errors.join('; '));
  const W = level.board.w, base = R.grCreate(level, []), free = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < base.cell.length; k++) if (base.cell[k] === R.GC_FLOOR) free.push(k);
  const tray = [level.tray.plain | 0, level.tray.ginger | 0, level.tray.blue | 0];
  const out = { solvable: false, count: 0, minTurntables: 0, best: null, layouts: 0 }, cur = [];
  function test() {
    out.layouts++;
    const s = R.grRun(level, cur);
    if (s.outcome !== R.GO_WON) return;
    for (const c of cur) if (s.turns[c.y * W + c.x] === 0) return;   // idle: the layout without it is already counted
    out.count++; out.solvable = true;
    if (!out.best || cur.length < out.best.length) out.best = cur.map((c) => Object.assign({}, c));
  }
  function place(from) {
    test();
    for (let f = from; f < free.length; f++) {
      const k = free[f];
      for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
        if (tray[t] === 0) continue;
        tray[t]--;
        for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) { cur.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0, type: TYPES[t], dir: DIRS[d] }); place(f + 1); cur.pop(); }
        tray[t]++;
      }
    }
  }
  place(0);
  out.minTurntables = out.best ? out.best.length : 0;
  return out;
}

return { solve, analyse, key, exhaustive };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = SOLVER;
// ============================================================================
// 12 BOARD ANIMATION (pure; Node-exported). Turns a cat's run under the rules into
// an animation pose at any moment. A "trace" is one cat's run: when its box sits on
// the hatch (rel), the tick length, and one record per tick after release (start tile
// and heading, end tile and heading, the rules' event, whether it bounced).
// pose(trace, now, out) is a pure function of time with no allocation, so the demo
// (loop time) and the game (seconds since Send) share it. Swift: a struct Trace and
// func pose(_ trace: Trace, at t: Double) -> CatPose.
//
// Timing, 10 fps stepped (F = frames per tick: 5 in the demo, 3 in the game):
//  travel   glide to the next tile (2 wu steps), 1 px bob; on a turntable the head
//           turns one frame before the box
//  bounce   nudge the obstacle, tiny hop with the ears back for 2 frames, turn round
//           (head first), glide back
//  home     box stops at the basket's edge; stretch, hop in, turn once, curl up, nap;
//           the empty box folds flat in 3 frames and slides off towards the conveyor
//  wrong    hop out onto the basket's rim and sit there, puzzled, for good
//  leave    (demo) after the nap: wake, yawn, stretch, hop through the cat flap
// ============================================================================
const BOARDANIM = (function () {
  const A = { HIDDEN: 0, POP: 1, TRAVEL: 2, BOUNCE: 3, STOP: 4, STRETCH: 5, HOP: 6, TURN: 7, CURL: 8, NAP: 9,
    WAKE: 10, LEAVE: 11, PUZZLED: 12, STUCK: 13, IDLE: 14 };
  const EARS_UP = 0, EARS_TWITCH = 1, EARS_BACK = 2;
  const END_RUNNING = 0, END_HOME = 1, END_WRONG = 2, END_STOPPED = 3;
  const EV_RELEASED = 1, EV_MOVED = 2, EV_DELIVERED = 3, EV_WRONG = 4, EV_STUCK = 5, EV_TUNNEL = 6, EV_WAIT = 7;    // the rules' GE_* codes
  const DX = [1, 0, -1, 0], DY = [0, 1, 0, -1];
  const FPS = 10;
  // Seconds after the home tick ends.
  const T_HOP = 0.3, T_TURN = 0.6, T_CURL = 0.9, T_NAP = 1.2, T_FOLD = 0.6, T_FLAT = 0.9, T_GONE = 1.8;
  const WAKE_LEN = 0.9, LEAVE_LEN = 0.6, ENTRY = 4, SLIDE = 12, RIM_OFF = 3;
  const SLIDE_X = -Math.SQRT1_2, SLIDE_Y = Math.SQRT1_2;          // towards the conveyor (front-left of the room)

  function makeTrace(maxTicks) {
    return {
      big: false, rel: 0, tick: 0.5, pop: 0.5, ox: 0, oy: 0, bw: 6, bh: 5, n: 0, end: END_RUNNING,
      napUntil: Infinity, leaveDir: 3, homeDX: 0, homeDY: 0, coat: 1, look: 0, blinkPhase: 0, hatchDir: 0,
      homeKind: 'basket', homeSide: -1, homeFlap: -1,
      hx: 0, hy: 0, max: maxTicks,
      x0: new Int8Array(maxTicks), y0: new Int8Array(maxTicks), d0: new Int8Array(maxTicks),
      x1: new Int8Array(maxTicks), y1: new Int8Array(maxTicks), d1: new Int8Array(maxTicks),
      ev: new Int8Array(maxTicks), bn: new Int8Array(maxTicks),
      tunnel: new Int8Array(maxTicks).fill(-1), entryX: new Int8Array(maxTicks), entryY: new Int8Array(maxTicks), recorded: false,
    };
  }
  function reset(tr) {
    tr.big = false; tr.recorded = false; tr.n = 0; tr.end = END_RUNNING; tr.napUntil = Infinity; tr.homeDX = 0; tr.homeDY = 0;
    tr.homeKind = 'basket'; tr.homeSide = -1; tr.homeFlap = -1;
  }
  function recordDestination(tr, s, i) {
    if (!tr.recorded) return;
    tr.big = !!s.big[i];
    if (s.ev[i] === EV_TUNNEL) {
      const k = tr.n - 1; tr.tunnel[k] = s.tunnelPair[i]; tr.entryX[k] = s.entryX[i]; tr.entryY[k] = s.entryY[i];
    }
    if (s.homeFlap[i] < 0) return;
    tr.homeKind = 'flap'; tr.homeFlap = s.homeFlap[i];
    const side = s.flaps[tr.homeFlap].side;
    tr.homeSide = side === 'R' ? 0 : side === 'D' ? 1 : side === 'L' ? 2 : 3;
  }
  function record(tr, x0, y0, d0, x1, y1, d1, ev, bounced) {
    tr.recorded = false;
    if (tr.n >= tr.max) return;
    const k = tr.n++; tr.recorded = true; tr.tunnel[k] = -1;
    tr.x0[k] = x0; tr.y0[k] = y0; tr.d0[k] = d0; tr.x1[k] = x1; tr.y1[k] = y1; tr.d1[k] = d1; tr.ev[k] = ev; tr.bn[k] = bounced;
    if (ev === EV_DELIVERED) tr.end = END_HOME; else if (ev === EV_WRONG) tr.end = END_WRONG;
  }
  // Run one cat through the real rules (R = 10_rules) and fill its trace.
  // One cat of coat ('ginger' | 'blue') from the level's first hatch. The caller places the board
  // in the room afterwards (tr.ox, tr.oy: world units of the board's back corner).
  function runRules(R, level, chutes, coat, tick, rel, tr) {
    const h0 = level.hatches[0];
    const one = { board: level.board, dogs: level.dogs, baskets: level.baskets, gates: level.gates, flaps: level.flaps, tunnels: level.tunnels,
      timeLimit: level.timeLimit, hatches: [{ x: h0.x, y: h0.y, dir: h0.dir, cats: [coat] }] };
    const s = R.grCreate(one, chutes);
    reset(tr);
    tr.tick = tick; tr.pop = tick; tr.rel = rel; tr.coat = R.GR_COAT[coat && typeof coat === 'object' ? coat.coat : coat]; tr.big = !!(coat && typeof coat === 'object' && coat.big === true);
    tr.ox = 0; tr.oy = 0; tr.bw = level.board.w; tr.bh = level.board.h;
    tr.hx = h0.x; tr.hy = h0.y; tr.hatchDir = R.GR_DIR[h0.dir];
    R.grTick(s);                                                   // tick 0: the box pops up on the hatch
    while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING && tr.n < tr.max) {
      R.grTick(s);
      record(tr, s.px[0], s.py[0], s.pdir[0], s.x[0], s.y[0], s.dir[0], s.ev[0], s.bounced[0]);
      recordDestination(tr, s, 0);
    }
    if (tr.end === END_RUNNING) tr.end = END_STOPPED;
    return tr;
  }
  // A shared gate trace, recorded in rules move order. Allocate once before Send.
  // The swing begins when the entering cat reaches the tile; same-tick arrivals
  // all retain their rule events, with the last one determining the displayed flap.
  function makeGateTrace(max) {
    return { n: 0, time: new Float64Array(max), gate: new Int16Array(max), cat: new Int16Array(max), from: new Uint8Array(max) };
  }
  function recordGates(tr, s, time) {
    for (let e = 0; e < s.flipCount; e++) {
      const k = tr.n++;
      tr.time[k] = time; tr.gate[k] = s.flipGate[e]; tr.cat[k] = s.flipCat[e]; tr.from[k] = s.flipFrom[e];
    }
  }
  function makeGateOut() { return { state: 0, from: 0, frame: 2 }; }
  function gatePose(tr, gate, now, out) {
    out.state = 0; out.from = 0; out.frame = 2;
    if (tr) for (let k = tr.n - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
      if (tr.gate[k] !== gate || tr.time[k] > now + 1e-9) continue;
      out.from = tr.from[k]; out.state = 1 - out.from;
      out.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor((now - tr.time[k]) * FPS + 1e-6));
      break;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function makeOut() {
    return { big: false, anim: A.HIDDEN, frame: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, dir: 0, head: 0, ears: EARS_UP, eyes: 0, bob: 0,
      boxX: 0, boxY: 0, boxFold: -1, boxFade: 0, hatchOpen: 0, spinX: -1, spinY: -1, spin: 0,
      bumpX: -1, bumpY: -1, bumpAge: -1, flapOpen: 0, flapWrong: false, home: 0, tunnelPair: -1, tunnelPhase: -1 };
  }
  const q2 = (v) => Math.round(v * 0.5) * 2;                      // whole 2 wu steps: clean 2:1 pixel moves
  const ss = (t) => { t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t; return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
  const cx = (tr, x) => tr.ox + x * 16 + 8, cy = (tr, y) => tr.oy + y * 16 + 8;
  function flapBounce(dt) {                                       // open, then two decaying swings
    if (dt < 0 || dt > 0.9) return 0;
    return dt < 0.12 ? 1 : dt < 0.22 ? 0.5 : dt < 0.34 ? 0 : dt < 0.44 ? 0.5 : 0;
  }
  // Blink every 4 s and twitch an ear every 6 s (whole frames, so the 48 s demo loop is seamless).
  function face(tr, now, o) {
    const g = Math.floor(now * FPS + 1e-6);
    if(tr.big){const p=((g+tr.blinkPhase)%60+60)%60;o.eyes=p<6?1:p>=30&&p<37?2:0;o.ears=EARS_UP;return;}
    o.eyes = ((g + tr.blinkPhase) % 40 + 40) % 40 === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    o.ears = ((g + tr.blinkPhase * 7 + 20) % 60 + 60) % 60 === 0 ? EARS_TWITCH : EARS_UP;
  }
  function lastBump(tr, k, now, o) {                              // latest bounce into an on-board obstacle
    o.bumpX = -1; o.bumpY = -1; o.bumpAge = -1;
    for (let j = Math.min(k, tr.n - 1); j >= 0; j--) {
      if (!tr.bn[j]) continue;
      const bx = tr.x0[j] + DX[tr.d0[j]], by = tr.y0[j] + DY[tr.d0[j]];
      if (bx < 0 || by < 0 || bx >= tr.bw || by >= tr.bh) return;  // the board's edge: no dog to wake
      const age = now - (tr.rel + j * tr.tick + 0.2 * tr.tick);
      if (age >= 0) { o.bumpX = bx; o.bumpY = by; o.bumpAge = age; }
      return;
    }
  }
  function pose(tr, now, o) {
    o.big = !!tr.big; o.tunnelPair = -1; o.tunnelPhase = -1;
    o.frame = 0; o.z = 0; o.bob = 0; o.boxFold = -1; o.boxFade = 0; o.hatchOpen = 0;
    o.spinX = -1; o.spinY = -1; o.spin = 0; o.flapOpen = 0; o.flapWrong = false; o.home = 0; o.ears = EARS_UP; o.eyes = 0;
    o.bumpX = -1; o.bumpY = -1; o.bumpAge = -1;
    const F = Math.max(1, Math.round(tr.tick * FPS));
    if (now < tr.rel - tr.pop) { o.anim = A.HIDDEN; return o; }
    if (now < tr.rel) {                                           // pops up through the hatch
      const f = (now - (tr.rel - tr.pop)) / tr.pop;
      o.anim = A.POP; o.frame = Math.min(F - 1, Math.floor(f * F));
      o.x = q2(cx(tr, tr.hx)); o.y = q2(cy(tr, tr.hy)); o.dir = o.head = tr.hatchDir;
      const rise=tr.big?32:8;o.z = -rise + Math.round(ss((f - 0.15) / 0.6) * rise);
      o.hatchOpen = f < 0.12 ? 1 : f < 0.8 ? 2 : f < 0.9 ? 1 : 0;
      face(tr, now, o);
      return o;
    }
    const k = Math.floor((now - tr.rel) / tr.tick);
    if (k < tr.n) { move(tr, k, (now - tr.rel - k * tr.tick) / tr.tick, F, now, o); lastBump(tr, k, now, o); return o; }
    if (tr.n === 0) { o.anim = A.IDLE; o.x = q2(cx(tr, tr.hx)); o.y = q2(cy(tr, tr.hy)); o.dir = o.head = tr.hatchDir; face(tr, now, o); return o; }
    lastBump(tr, tr.n - 1, now, o);
    const j = tr.n - 1, T = now - (tr.rel + tr.n * tr.tick);
    const hx = cx(tr, tr.x1[j]), hy = cy(tr, tr.y1[j]), dIn = tr.d0[j];
    if (tr.homeKind === 'flap') return flapHome(tr, T, now, hx, hy, o);
    const ex = hx - DX[dIn] * ENTRY, ey = hy - DY[dIn] * ENTRY;   // where the box stopped
    if (tr.end === END_HOME) return home(tr, T, now, hx + tr.homeDX, hy + tr.homeDY, ex, ey, dIn, o);
    if (tr.end === END_WRONG) return wrong(tr, T, now, hx, hy, ex, ey, dIn, o);
    o.anim = A.IDLE; o.x = q2(hx); o.y = q2(hy); o.dir = o.head = tr.d1[j]; face(tr, now, o);
    return o;
  }
  function move(tr, k, f, F, now, o) {
    const fr = Math.min(F - 1, Math.floor(f * F));
    const x0 = cx(tr, tr.x0[k]), y0 = cy(tr, tr.y0[k]), d0 = tr.d0[k], d1 = tr.d1[k], ev = tr.ev[k];
    let x1 = cx(tr, tr.x1[k]), y1 = cy(tr, tr.y1[k]);
    o.frame = fr; o.dir = o.head = d0;
    face(tr, now, o);
    if (ev === EV_WAIT) {
      o.anim = A.IDLE; o.x = q2(x0); o.y = q2(y0); return;
    }
    if (ev === EV_TUNNEL) {
      const ex = cx(tr, tr.entryX[k]), ey = cy(tr, tr.entryY[k]);
      o.tunnelPair = tr.tunnel[k]; o.tunnelPhase = f < .45 ? 0 : f < .65 ? 1 : 2;
      o.anim = o.tunnelPhase === 1 ? A.HIDDEN : A.TRAVEL;
      o.dir = o.head = tr.bn[k] && f < .15 ? d0 : d1;
      const drop=tr.big?32:24;
      if (o.tunnelPhase === 2) {
        o.x = x1; o.y = y1; o.z = -drop + Math.round(ss((f - .65) / .27) * drop);
      } else {
        let ax = x0, ay = y0, t = f / .25;
        if (tr.bn[k]) {
          const nudge = ss(f / .15) * 3;
          ax += DX[d0] * nudge; ay += DY[d0] * nudge; t = (f - .15) / .1;
        }
        o.x = q2(ax + (ex - ax) * ss(t)); o.y = q2(ay + (ey - ay) * ss(t));
        o.z = 0 - Math.round(ss((f - .25) / .2) * drop);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (tr.homeKind === 'flap' && k === tr.n - 1) {
      const d = tr.homeSide, p = ss(f);
      o.x = q2(x0 + DX[d] * 3 * p); o.y = q2(y0 + DY[d] * 3 * p);
      o.dir = o.head = tr.bn[k] && f < .5 ? d0 : d;
      o.anim = A.TRAVEL;
      return;
    }
    if (ev === EV_STUCK) {                                        // boxed in: jiggle, look both ways
      o.anim = A.STUCK; o.x = q2(x0) + ((Math.floor(now * FPS) & 1) ? 2 : 0); o.y = q2(y0);
      o.head = (Math.floor(now * FPS / 2) & 1) ? d0 : (d0 + 2) & 3;
      return;
    }
    if (tr.bn[k]) {                                               // bounce: bump, hop, turn round, glide back
      const back = (d0 + 2) & 3, b0 = F >= 4 ? 1 : 0;              // first ears-back frame
      const fTurn = Math.min(0.99, (b0 + 3) / F);                   // body turns round on this fraction
      o.anim = A.BOUNCE;
      if (fr === b0 || fr === b0 + 1) { o.ears = EARS_BACK; o.z = fr === b0 ? 2 : 1; }
      if (fr >= b0 + 2) o.head = back;
      if (fr >= b0 + 3 || (F < 4 && fr >= b0 + 2)) o.dir = back;
      if (fr === F - 1 && d1 !== back) o.head = d1;                 // a turntable on the way back: head first again
      const nx = x0 + DX[d0] * 3 * ss(f / 0.2), ny = y0 + DY[d0] * 3 * ss(f / 0.2);
      const g = F < 4 ? (f - 2 / F) * F : (f - fTurn) / (1 - fTurn);
      o.x = q2(g > 0 ? nx + (x1 - nx) * ss(g) : nx); o.y = q2(g > 0 ? ny + (y1 - ny) * ss(g) : ny);
      return;
    }
    const turned = d1 !== d0 && ev === EV_MOVED, arrive = ev === EV_MOVED ? (turned ? 0.6 : 0.8) : 0.6;
    if (ev !== EV_MOVED) { x1 -= DX[d0] * ENTRY; y1 -= DY[d0] * ENTRY; }   // home or wrong: stop at the basket's edge
    const m = ss(f / arrive);
    o.x = q2(x0 + (x1 - x0) * m); o.y = q2(y0 + (y1 - y0) * m);
    o.anim = ev !== EV_MOVED && f >= arrive ? A.STOP : A.TRAVEL;
    if (f < arrive) o.bob = Math.floor(now * FPS / 2) & 1;
    if (turned) {
      const hf = Math.floor(0.6 * F);
      if (fr >= hf) { o.head = d1; o.spinX = tr.x1[k]; o.spinY = tr.y1[k]; o.spin = fr - hf + 1; }
      if (fr >= hf + 1) o.dir = d1;
    }
  }
  // Rule-phase preview only: remain boxed, then hide at the exit. The piece
  // phase supplies the checked push/rim/fold artwork; never borrow basket hops.
  function flapHome(tr, T, now, hx, hy, o) {
    const d = tr.homeSide;
    o.x = q2(hx + DX[d] * 3); o.y = q2(hy + DY[d] * 3); o.dir = o.head = d;
    o.anim = tr.end === END_WRONG || T < .3 ? A.IDLE : A.HIDDEN;
    o.flapWrong = tr.end === END_WRONG;
    o.flapOpen = o.flapWrong ? 0 : flapBounce(T);
    face(tr, now, o); return o;
  }
  function home(tr, T, now, hx, hy, ex, ey, dIn, o) {
    o.home = 1; o.dir = o.head = dIn;
    if (now >= tr.napUntil) {
      const w = now - tr.napUntil;
      o.x = q2(hx); o.y = q2(hy);
      if (w < WAKE_LEN) { o.anim = A.WAKE; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor(w / WAKE_LEN * 3)); o.dir = o.head = tr.leaveDir; return o; }
      const p = (w - WAKE_LEN) / LEAVE_LEN, ld = tr.leaveDir;
      const tFlap = tr.napUntil + WAKE_LEN + LEAVE_LEN * 0.35;           // reaches the flap about a third of the way
      o.flapOpen = now < tFlap ? 0 : flapBounce(now - tFlap);
      if (p >= 1) { o.anim = A.HIDDEN; return o; }
      o.anim = A.LEAVE; o.frame = Math.min(1, Math.floor(p * 2)); o.dir = o.head = ld;
      o.x = q2(hx + DX[ld] * 12 * p); o.y = q2(hy + DY[ld] * 12 * p); o.z = Math.round(Math.sin(Math.min(1, p * 1.5) * Math.PI) * 2);
      return o;
    }
    if (T < T_HOP) { o.anim = A.STRETCH; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor(T / T_HOP * 3)); o.x = q2(ex); o.y = q2(ey); return o; }
    // the box is empty from here: it waits, folds flat in 3 frames, then slides away and fades
    o.boxFold = T < T_FOLD ? 0 : T < T_FLAT ? 1 + Math.floor((T - T_FOLD) * FPS + 1e-6) : T < T_GONE ? 4 : -1;
    const sl = ss((T - T_FLAT) / (T_GONE - T_FLAT));
    o.boxX = q2(ex + SLIDE_X * SLIDE * sl); o.boxY = q2(ey + SLIDE_Y * SLIDE * sl); o.boxFade = T < T_FLAT ? 0 : (T - T_FLAT) / (T_GONE - T_FLAT);
    if (T < T_TURN) {
      const p = (T - T_HOP) / (T_TURN - T_HOP);
      o.anim = A.HOP; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor(p * 3));
      o.x = q2(ex + (hx - ex) * p); o.y = q2(ey + (hy - ey) * p); o.z = Math.round(Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 3);
      return o;
    }
    o.x = q2(hx); o.y = q2(hy);
    if (T < T_CURL) { o.anim = A.TURN; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor((T - T_TURN) / (T_CURL - T_TURN) * 3)); o.dir = o.head = (dIn + 1 + o.frame) & 3; return o; }
    if (T < T_NAP) { o.anim = A.CURL; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor((T - T_CURL) / (T_NAP - T_CURL) * 3)); return o; }
    o.anim = A.NAP; o.frame = Math.floor(now / 1.5) & 1;            // slow breathing
    o.ears = ((Math.floor(now * FPS) + tr.blinkPhase * 11) % 80 + 80) % 80 === 0 ? EARS_TWITCH : EARS_UP;
    return o;
  }
  function wrong(tr, T, now, hx, hy, ex, ey, dIn, o) {
    o.dir = o.head = dIn; o.boxX = q2(ex); o.boxY = q2(ey); o.boxFold = T < 0 ? -1 : 0;
    const rx = hx + RIM_OFF, ry = hy + RIM_OFF;                   // the basket's near rim
    if (T < T_HOP) { o.anim = A.STRETCH; o.boxFold = -1; o.x = q2(ex); o.y = q2(ey); o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor(T / T_HOP * 3)); return o; }
    if (T < T_TURN) {
      const p = (T - T_HOP) / (T_TURN - T_HOP);
      o.anim = A.HOP; o.frame = Math.min(2, Math.floor(p * 3));
      o.x = q2(ex + (rx - ex) * p); o.y = q2(ey + (ry - ey) * p); o.z = Math.round(Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 3 + p * 5);
      return o;
    }
    o.anim = A.PUZZLED; o.x = q2(rx); o.y = q2(ry); o.z = 5; o.dir = o.head = 1;   // sits up facing the room
    const c = Math.floor(now * 2.5) % 6;                           // slow tail flick: 3 frames then a rest
    o.frame = c < 3 ? c : 0;
    return o;
  }
  return { A, EARS_UP, EARS_TWITCH, EARS_BACK, END_RUNNING, END_HOME, END_WRONG, END_STOPPED,
    EV_RELEASED, EV_MOVED, EV_DELIVERED, EV_WRONG, EV_STUCK, EV_TUNNEL, FPS, T_NAP, WAKE_LEN, LEAVE_LEN,
    makeTrace, reset, record, recordDestination, runRules, makeOut, pose, makeGateTrace, recordGates, makeGateOut, gatePose };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = BOARDANIM;
// ============================================================================
// 13 DEMO DIRECTOR (pure; Node-exported). The ?demo loop is a small level in
// scene.json (hatch, baskets, dog, turntables) plus 8 cats released on a schedule.
// build() runs every cat through the game's own rules (10_rules via boardanim),
// checks each result against the path stored in scene.json, and reports:
//  - errors:  any cat whose rules path differs from its stored path
//  - shows:   which rules the loop demonstrates (plain turn, blue passing a ginger
//             turntable, dog bounce, edge bounce, ginger turn)
//  - clashes: two cats on one tile at the same moment
//  - basketOverlaps: a cat arriving before the last one has napped and left
