// Each cat naps, then goes home through the cat flap behind its basket, so the
// 48 s schedule wraps seamlessly. Swift: the same checks as XCTest cases.
// ============================================================================
const DEMO = (function () {
  const isNode = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const R = isNode ? require('./10_rules.js') : { grCreate, grTick, GR_DIR, GR_DIRS, GR_COAT, GO_RUNNING };
  const B = isNode ? require('./12_boardanim.js') : BOARDANIM;
  const DIRS = R.GR_DIRS, DX = [1, 0, -1, 0], DY = [0, 1, 0, -1];
  function levelOf(D) {
    return { board: D.board, hatches: [{ x: D.hatch.x, y: D.hatch.y, dir: D.hatch.dir, cats: ['ginger'] }], baskets: D.baskets, dogs: D.dogs };
  }
  function pathOf(tr) {
    const out = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < tr.n; k++) {
      out.push(tr.x1[k] + ',' + tr.y1[k] + ',' + DIRS[tr.d1[k]] + (tr.bn[k] ? ',bounce' : '') +
        (tr.ev[k] === B.EV_DELIVERED ? ',home' : tr.ev[k] === B.EV_WRONG ? ',wrong' : ''));
    }
    return out;
  }
  // Loop time -> the time to pose cat i at: its own time, the previous loop's, or -1 if it isn't out.
  function active(d, t, i) {
    const c = d.cats[i], t0 = c.rel - d.pop;
    if (t >= t0 && t < c.activeEnd) return t;
    if (t + d.loop >= t0 && t + d.loop < c.activeEnd) return t + d.loop;
    return -1;
  }
  function build(scene) {
    const D = scene.demo, L = levelOf(D), tt = new Map(D.turntables.map((t) => [t.x + ',' + t.y, t]));
    const ox = (scene.floor.i + D.board.roomX) * scene.tile, oy = (scene.floor.j + D.board.roomY) * scene.tile;   // board on the stone floor
    const out = { cats: [], traces: [], errors: [], clashes: [], basketOverlaps: [], events: [], loop: D.loop, pop: D.pop,
      shows: { plainTurn: false, gingerPassByBlue: false, dogBounce: false, edgeBounce: false, gingerTurn: false } };
    D.cats.forEach((c, i) => {
      const tr = B.makeTrace(40);
      B.runRules(R, L, D.turntables, c.coat, D.tick, c.rel, tr);
      tr.ox = ox; tr.oy = oy;
      tr.look = c.look | 0; tr.blinkPhase = (i * 11 + 3) % 40; tr.leaveDir = 3;   // home: through the flap behind the basket
      const want = D.paths[c.coat], got = pathOf(tr);
      if (JSON.stringify(want) !== JSON.stringify(got)) out.errors.push(c.id + ': stored ' + JSON.stringify(want) + ', rules give ' + JSON.stringify(got));
      const arrive = tr.rel + tr.n * tr.tick;
      tr.napUntil = arrive + B.T_NAP + D.nap;
      const j = tr.n - 1, hx = tr.ox + tr.x1[j] * 16 + 8, hy = tr.oy + tr.y1[j] * 16 + 8;
      out.cats.push({ id: c.id, coat: c.coat, rel: c.rel, arrive, napUntil: tr.napUntil, leaveEnd: tr.napUntil + B.WAKE_LEN + B.LEAVE_LEN,
        end: tr.end === B.END_HOME ? 'home' : tr.end === B.END_WRONG ? 'wrong' : 'stopped', basket: tr.x1[j] + ',' + tr.y1[j] });
      out.cats[out.cats.length - 1].activeEnd = out.cats[out.cats.length - 1].leaveEnd + 0.6;   // the flap finishes its swing
      out.traces.push(tr);
      for (let k = 0; k < tr.n; k++) {                                 // what this cat's run demonstrates
        const t = tt.get(tr.x1[k] + ',' + tr.y1[k]), turned = tr.d1[k] !== tr.d0[k];
        if (tr.bn[k]) {
          const bx = tr.x0[k] + DX[tr.d0[k]], by = tr.y0[k] + DY[tr.d0[k]];
          if (bx >= 0 && by >= 0 && bx < D.board.w && by < D.board.h) out.shows.dogBounce = true; else out.shows.edgeBounce = true;
        } else if (t) {
          if (t.type === 'plain' && turned) out.shows.plainTurn = true;
          if (t.type === 'ginger' && c.coat === 'blue' && !turned) out.shows.gingerPassByBlue = true;
          if (t.type === 'ginger' && c.coat === 'ginger' && turned) out.shows.gingerTurn = true;
        }
      }
      // particles (analytic, keyed to loop time): a puff as it pops up; a sparkle and a heart once it has curled up
      out.events.push({ kind: 'puff', t: c.rel - 0.1, x: tr.ox + tr.hx * 16 + 8, y: tr.oy + tr.hy * 16 + 8, z: 1, seed: i * 7 + 1 });
      out.events.push({ kind: 'spark', t: arrive + B.T_NAP, x: hx, y: hy, z: 6, seed: i * 7 + 2, coat: c.coat });
      out.events.push({ kind: 'heart', t: arrive + B.T_NAP, x: hx, y: hy, z: 9, seed: i * 7 + 3 });
    });
    // two cats on one tile at once (sampled 20 times a second round the whole loop)
    const o = B.makeOut(), tiles = new Int32Array(out.cats.length);
    for (let s = 0; s < D.loop; s += 0.05) {
      for (let i = 0; i < out.cats.length; i++) {
        const t = active(out, s, i);
        tiles[i] = -1;
        if (t < 0) continue;
        B.pose(out.traces[i], t, o);
        if (o.anim === B.A.HIDDEN) continue;
        tiles[i] = Math.floor((o.x - out.traces[i].ox) / 16) * 16 + Math.floor((o.y - out.traces[i].oy) / 16);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) for (let k = i + 1; k < tiles.length; k++) {
        if (tiles[i] >= 0 && tiles[i] === tiles[k]) out.clashes.push(out.cats[i].id + ' and ' + out.cats[k].id + ' at ' + s.toFixed(2) + ' s');
      }
    }
    // each basket must be empty again before the next cat of that colour arrives (wrapping round the loop)
    const byBasket = new Map();
    for (const c of out.cats) { if (!byBasket.has(c.basket)) byBasket.set(c.basket, []); byBasket.get(c.basket).push(c); }
    for (const [key, list] of byBasket) {
      list.sort((a, b) => a.arrive - b.arrive);
      for (let k = 0; k < list.length; k++) {
        const a = list[k], b = list[(k + 1) % list.length], next = b.arrive + (k + 1 === list.length ? D.loop : 0);
        if (list.length > 1 && next < a.leaveEnd + 0.5) out.basketOverlaps.push(key + ': ' + b.id + ' arrives at ' + next.toFixed(2) + ' before ' + a.id + ' has gone (' + a.leaveEnd.toFixed(2) + ')');
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  return { build, active, pathOf };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = DEMO;
// ============================================================================
// 14 WORLD (pure; Node-exported). Everything in the room that moves, as a pure
// function of loop time: the sorter's routine (take a flat box and open it,
// collect a sleepy cat from its cubby, stamp its box and send it down the chute,
// pick up a flat-pack, shelve it, tea), the Postmistress, the conveyor and the
// cat riding it, the cubby COLLECT empties (and the rider refills), the shelf
// stack, the counter box and chute, lamp, trees, pigeon and camera, plus the
// loop's particle events. step(w, frame) only writes into w and reads nothing
// from earlier steps, so the 48 s loop repeats exactly.
// Swift: struct WorldState, func step(_ w: inout WorldState, frame: Int).
// ============================================================================
const WORLD = (function () {
  const isNode = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const BA = isNode ? require('./12_boardanim.js') : BOARDANIM;
  const DM = isNode ? require('./13_demo.js') : DEMO;
  const FACE = { S: 0, E: 1, W: 2, N: 3 };                           // +y, +x, -x, -y
  const K = { IDLE: 0, WALK: 1, TAKE: 2, COLLECT: 3, STAMP: 4, PICKUP: 5, SHELVE: 6, TEA: 7 };
  const ITEM = { NONE: 0, OPENBOX: 1, CATBOX: 2, CATARMS: 3, FLATBOX: 4, MUG: 5, STAMP: 6 };
  const CS = { SLEEP: 0, STRETCH: 1, WALK: 2, SIT: 3 };
  const KIND = { idle: K.IDLE, walk: K.WALK, take: K.TAKE, collect: K.COLLECT, stamp: K.STAMP, pickup: K.PICKUP, shelve: K.SHELVE, tea: K.TEA };
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v), lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
  const ss = (t) => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
  const fract = (v) => v - Math.floor(v);
  const hash = (a, b) => { let x = Math.imul(a * 73856093 ^ b * 19349663, 2654435761) >>> 0; x ^= x >>> 15; return (x >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
  function routeLen(R) { let d = 0; for (let k = 1; k < R.length; k++) d += Math.abs(R[k][0] - R[k - 1][0]) + Math.abs(R[k][1] - R[k - 1][1]); return d; }
  // Point and facing a distance d along an axis-aligned route.
  function along(R, d, out) {
    for (let k = 1; k < R.length; k++) {
      const dx = R[k][0] - R[k - 1][0], dy = R[k][1] - R[k - 1][1], L = Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy);
      if (d <= L || k === R.length - 1) {
        const f = Math.min(1, d / L);
        out.x = R[k - 1][0] + dx * f; out.y = R[k - 1][1] + dy * f;
        out.face = dx > 0 ? FACE.E : dx < 0 ? FACE.W : dy > 0 ? FACE.S : FACE.N;
        return out;
      }
      d -= L;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function create(scene, opts) {
    const S = scene.sorter, P = scene.postmistress, Rd = scene.rider, cv = scene.conveyor, loop = scene.demo.loop;
    const plan = [];
    let t = 0;
    for (const d of S.plan) {
      const kind = KIND[d[0]], dur = kind === K.WALK ? routeLen(S.routes[d[1]]) / S.walkSpeed : d[1] < 0 ? 0 : d[1];
      plan.push({ kind, t0: t, t1: t + dur, route: kind === K.WALK ? d[1] : -1, face: d[2] ? FACE[d[2]] : 0, x: d[3] | 0, y: d[4] | 0 });
      t += dur;
    }
    const planEnd = plan[plan.length - 1].t0;
    plan[plan.length - 1].t1 = loop;
    const first = [];                                                  // each action's first segment, looked up every step
    for (const p of plan) if (first[p.kind] === undefined) first[p.kind] = p;
    const at = (kind) => first[kind];
    const pmPlan = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < P.plan.length; k++) {
      const d = P.plan[k];
      let t0 = d[1];
      if (t0 < 0) { const pr = pmPlan[k - 1]; t0 = pr.t0 + routeLen(P.routes[pr.arg]) / P.walkSpeed; }
      pmPlan.push({ kind: d[0], t0, arg: d[2] });
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < pmPlan.length; k++) pmPlan[k].t1 = k + 1 < pmPlan.length ? pmPlan[k + 1].t0 : loop;
    const slot0 = cv.x1 - 1 - cv.item.w, slot1 = slot0 - cv.item.w - 1, enter = -cv.item.w - 2;
    const w = {
      loop, t: 0, frame: 0, mode: (opts && opts.mode) || 'demo', planEnd,
      sorter: { x: S.home[0], y: S.home[1], face: FACE.S, action: K.IDLE },
      pose: { face: 0, walk: -1, bob: 0, armF: 0, armB: 0, reach: 0, hold: 0, bend: 0, tilt: 0, sway: 0, item: 0, itemY: 0, itemF: 0,
        stamp: 0, squash: 0, look: 0, scratch: 0 },
      pm: { x: P.bed[0], y: P.bed[1], z: 0, state: CS.SLEEP, frame: 0, face: 0, head: 0, flick: 0 },
      walker: { on: false, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, state: CS.WALK, frame: 0, face: 0 },
      conveyor: { roll: 0, items: new Float32Array(3), riderOn: 1, slot0, slot1, enter, speed: cv.speed },
      cubbyCollectEmpty: false, shelfCount: 5, shelfLift: 0,
      floorBox: { on: false, cat: false, x: S.floorBox[0], y: S.floorBox[1] },
      counter: { boxOn: false, x: S.counterBox[0], y: S.counterBox[1], z: scene.counter.z + 3, stamped: false, eyes: 0, chute: 0, stampOn: true, stampZ: -1 },
      mugInHand: false, lampSX: 0, treeDX: 0,
      pigeon: { on: false, x: -99, y: 0, frame: 0, flip: false },
      camX: 0, camY: 0,
      watch: { n: 0, xs: new Float32Array(16), ys: new Float32Array(16) },   // cats she can watch (game mode: the caller fills this)
      events: [],
      _: { scene, plan, pmPlan, at, P, Rd, S, demo: DM.build(scene), demoOut: BA.makeOut(), tmp: { x: 0, y: 0, face: 0 },
        seen: { x: 0, y: 0 }, sill: pmPlan.find((q) => q.kind === 'hop').arg },
    };
    buildEvents(w);
    return w;
  }

  // ---- the sorter ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function resetPose(p) {
    p.walk = -1; p.bob = 0; p.armF = 0; p.armB = 0; p.reach = 0; p.hold = 0; p.bend = 0; p.tilt = 0; p.sway = 0;
    p.item = ITEM.NONE; p.itemY = 0; p.itemF = 0; p.stamp = 0; p.squash = 0; p.look = 0; p.scratch = 0;
  }
  function segAt(plan, t) { for (let k = 0; k < plan.length; k++) if (t >= plan[k].t0 && t < plan[k].t1) return plan[k]; return plan[plan.length - 1]; }
  const CARRY = [ITEM.NONE, ITEM.OPENBOX, ITEM.CATBOX, ITEM.NONE, ITEM.FLATBOX, ITEM.NONE, ITEM.NONE];   // what each route carries
  function sorterStep(w, t) {
    const X = w._, p = w.pose, s = w.sorter, tq = Math.floor(t * 10 + 1e-6) / 10;
    resetPose(p);
    const seg = segAt(X.plan, t), a = tq - seg.t0;
    s.action = seg.kind;
    if (seg.kind === K.WALK) {
      const d = Math.max(0, a) * X.S.walkSpeed;
      along(X.S.routes[seg.route], d, s);
      p.walk = Math.floor(d / 2) & 3;
      p.bob = (p.walk & 1) ? -1 : 0;
      const carry = CARRY[seg.route];
      if (carry) { p.item = carry; p.hold = 2; }
      else { p.armF = p.walk === 0 ? -1 : p.walk === 2 ? 1 : 0; p.armB = -p.armF; }
      p.sway = p.walk === 1 ? 1 : p.walk === 3 ? -1 : 0;
    } else {
      s.x = seg.x; s.y = seg.y; s.face = seg.face;
      switch (seg.kind) {
        case K.TAKE:                                               // lift the top flat box, pop it open
          if (a < 0.3) p.reach = 1;
          else if (a < 0.6) { p.hold = 3; p.item = ITEM.FLATBOX; }
          else if (a < 1.0) { p.hold = 1; p.item = ITEM.OPENBOX; p.itemF = 1 + Math.min(2, Math.floor((a - 0.6) / 0.14)); }
          else { p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.OPENBOX; }
          break;
        case K.COLLECT:                                            // box down, lift the cat, chin scratch, into the box
          if (a < 0.4) { p.bend = 1; p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.OPENBOX; }
          else if (a < 0.6) { }
          else if (a < 1.6) p.reach = 1;
          else if (a < 2.0) { p.hold = 1; p.item = ITEM.CATARMS; }
          else if (a < 3.0) { p.hold = 1; p.item = ITEM.CATARMS; p.scratch = (Math.floor(a * 10) & 1) + 1; }
          else if (a < 3.2) { p.bend = 1; p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.CATARMS; }
          else if (a < 3.4) { p.bend = 1; p.hold = 2; }
          else if (a < 3.8) { p.bend = a < 3.6 ? 2 : 1; p.hold = 2; if (a >= 3.6) p.item = ITEM.CATBOX; }
          else { p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.CATBOX; }
          if (a >= 1.6 && a < 3.8) s.face = FACE.S;                // turns round with the cat: the scratch faces the camera
          break;
        case K.STAMP: stampPose(p, a); break;
        case K.PICKUP:
          if (a < 0.5) { p.bend = 1; p.hold = 2; }
          else if (a < 0.9) { p.bend = 2; p.hold = 2; if (a >= 0.6) p.item = ITEM.FLATBOX; }
          else if (a < 1.3) { p.bend = 1; p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.FLATBOX; }
          else { p.hold = 2; p.item = ITEM.FLATBOX; }
          break;
        case K.SHELVE:
          if (a < 0.6) { p.hold = 3; p.item = ITEM.FLATBOX; }
          else if (a < 1.0) p.reach = 1;
          break;
        case K.TEA: teaPose(w, p, a); break;
        default: break;
      }
    }
    p.face = s.face;
    // things the routine moves around (pure functions of t as well)
    const tk = X.at(K.TAKE), co = X.at(K.COLLECT), st = X.at(K.STAMP), sh = X.at(K.SHELVE), tea = X.at(K.TEA);
    w.shelfLift = t >= tk.t0 + 0.3 && t < tk.t0 + 0.6 ? (t - tk.t0 - 0.3) / 0.3 : 0;
    w.shelfCount = t >= tk.t0 + 0.6 && t < sh.t0 + 1.0 ? 4 : 5;
    const ca = t - co.t0;
    w.floorBox.on = ca >= 0.4 && ca < 3.6; w.floorBox.cat = ca >= 3.2;
    const sa = t - st.t0, C = w.counter;                             // the box sits on the chute's flap
    C.boxOn = sa >= 0.4 && sa < 3.9;
    C.stamped = sa >= 2.0;
    C.eyes = sa >= 2.0 && sa < 2.3 ? 1 : 0;                         // the cat blinks at the thunk
    C.stampZ = sa >= 1.2 && sa < 2.8 ? (sa >= 2.0 && sa < 2.2 ? 0 : 4) : -1;   // the stamp over the label: raised 4, pressed 0
    C.z = w._.scene.counter.z + 3 - (sa < 3.6 ? 0 : Math.round(ss((sa - 3.6) / 0.3) * 7));
    C.chute = sa >= 3.5 && sa < 4.0 ? 1 : sa >= 4.0 && sa < 4.12 ? 0.5 : 0;
    C.stampOn = !(sa >= 0.8 && sa < 3.1);                            // in the hand or over the box
    w.mugInHand = t >= tea.t0 + 0.6 && t < tea.t0 + 9.2;
  }
  // hold 4: the near hand raised high over the counter. While the stamp is over the box it is
  // drawn with the box (counter.stampZ), so the box in front of the sorter can't hide it.
  function stampPose(p, a) {
    if (a < 0.4) { p.hold = 3; p.item = ITEM.CATBOX; }               // lift the box onto the chute's flap
    else if (a < 0.8) p.armF = 1;
    else if (a < 1.2) { p.hold = 1; p.item = ITEM.STAMP; }           // pick up the paw stamp
    else if (a < 2.0) p.hold = 4;                                    // raise it over the label
    else if (a < 2.2) { p.hold = 4; p.stamp = 3; p.squash = 1; }     // thunk
    else if (a < 2.8) p.hold = 4;
    else if (a < 3.1) { p.hold = 1; p.item = ITEM.STAMP; }           // put it back
    else if (a < 3.6) p.armF = 1;                                    // a pat, then the flap opens
  }
  function teaPose(w, p, a) {
    if (a < 0.6) { p.hold = 2; return; }
    if (a >= 9.6) return;
    if (a >= 9.2) { p.hold = 2; return; }
    p.item = ITEM.MUG;
    const sip = (a >= 2.4 && a < 3.4) || (a >= 5.6 && a < 6.6) || (a >= 8.0 && a < 8.8);
    p.hold = sip ? 3 : 1;
    p.look = (a >= 3.6 && a < 5.4) || (a >= 6.8 && a < 7.8) ? 1 : 0;
  }

  // ---- the Postmistress ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The nearest cat out and moving, into X.seen; false if none is within 110 wu. (No allocation per step.)
  function nearestWatched(w, t) {
    const X = w._, pm = w.pm;
    let best = 1e9, bx = 0, by = 0;
    if (w.mode === 'demo') {
      const d = X.demo, o = X.demoOut;
      for (let i = 0; i < d.cats.length; i++) {
        const ti = DM.active(d, t, i);
        if (ti < 0) continue;
        BA.pose(d.traces[i], ti, o);
        if (o.anim === BA.A.HIDDEN || o.anim === BA.A.NAP) continue;
        const dd = (o.x - pm.x) * (o.x - pm.x) + (o.y - pm.y) * (o.y - pm.y);
        if (dd < best) { best = dd; bx = o.x; by = o.y; }
      }
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < w.watch.n; i++) {
        const dd = (w.watch.xs[i] - pm.x) * (w.watch.xs[i] - pm.x) + (w.watch.ys[i] - pm.y) * (w.watch.ys[i] - pm.y);
        if (dd < best) { best = dd; bx = w.watch.xs[i]; by = w.watch.ys[i]; }
      }
    }
    X.seen.x = bx; X.seen.y = by;
    return best < 110 * 110;
  }
  function pmStep(w, t) {
    const X = w._, P = X.P, pm = w.pm, tq = Math.floor(t * 10 + 1e-6) / 10;
    let seg = X.pmPlan[0], k = 0;
    for (; k < X.pmPlan.length; k++) if (t >= X.pmPlan[k].t0 && t < X.pmPlan[k].t1) { seg = X.pmPlan[k]; break; }
    const a = tq - seg.t0;
    pm.flick = 0; pm.head = 0; pm.z = 0; pm.frame = 0;
    switch (seg.kind) {
      case 'sleep':
        pm.state = CS.SLEEP; pm.x = P.bed[0]; pm.y = P.bed[1]; pm.face = 0;
        pm.flick = fract(t / 4) > 0.85 && fract(t / 4) < 0.95 ? 1 : 0;           // slow tail flick
        break;
      case 'stretch':
        pm.state = a > 0.25 && a < 0.8 ? CS.STRETCH : CS.SIT; pm.x = P.bed[0]; pm.y = P.bed[1]; pm.face = 1;
        break;
      case 'walk': {
        pm.state = CS.WALK;
        const d = Math.max(0, a) * P.walkSpeed;
        along(P.routes[seg.arg], d, X.tmp);
        pm.x = X.tmp.x; pm.y = X.tmp.y; pm.face = (X.tmp.face === FACE.E || X.tmp.face === FACE.N) ? 1 : 0;
        pm.frame = Math.floor(d / 2.4) & 3;
        break;
      }
      case 'sit': {
        let r = 0;
        for (let j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) if (X.pmPlan[j].kind === 'walk') { r = X.pmPlan[j].arg; break; }
        const R = P.routes[r], end = R[R.length - 1];
        pm.state = CS.SIT; pm.x = end[0]; pm.y = end[1];
        if (nearestWatched(w, t)) {                                   // head follows the nearest travelling cat
          const sxL = X.seen.x - X.seen.y, sxC = pm.x - pm.y;
          pm.face = sxL > sxC ? 1 : 0; pm.head = Math.abs(sxL - sxC) < 10 ? 2 : 0;
        }
        else { pm.face = seg.arg === 1 ? 1 : 0; pm.head = fract(t / 6) > 0.8 ? 2 : 0; }
        pm.flick = fract(t / 2) > 0.9 ? 1 : 0;
        break;
      }
      case 'hop': {
        const h = seg.arg, f = clamp(a / h[6], 0, 1);
        pm.state = CS.STRETCH; pm.x = lerp(h[0], h[3], f); pm.y = lerp(h[1], h[4], f);
        pm.z = lerp(h[2], h[5], f) + Math.sin(f * Math.PI) * 1.5; pm.face = h[3] > h[0] || h[4] < h[1] ? 1 : 0;
        break;
      }
      case 'sill': {                                                  // on the window sill beside the sorter, watching the pigeon
        const hp = X.sill;
        pm.state = CS.SIT; pm.x = hp[3]; pm.y = hp[4]; pm.z = hp[5]; pm.face = 0;
        pm.head = w.pigeon.on ? 0 : fract(t / 5) > 0.7 ? 2 : 0;
        pm.flick = fract(t / 2.4) > 0.85 ? 1 : 0;
        break;
      }
      case 'turn': pm.state = CS.SIT; pm.x = P.bed[0]; pm.y = P.bed[1]; pm.face = Math.floor(a * 5) & 1; break;
      case 'curl': pm.state = a < 0.15 ? CS.SIT : CS.SLEEP; pm.x = P.bed[0]; pm.y = P.bed[1]; pm.face = 0; break;
    }
  }

  // ---- conveyor + the cat riding it ----------------------------------------------------------
  function conveyorStep(w, t) {
    const X = w._, c = w.conveyor, pick = X.at(K.PICKUP).t0 + 0.6, entr = X.at(K.SHELVE).t0 + 2.0;
    c.roll = (Math.floor(t * 8) * c.speed / 8) % 4;
    c.items[0] = t < pick ? c.slot0 : NaN;
    const tb = t - (pick + 0.4);
    c.items[1] = tb <= 0 ? c.slot1 : Math.min(c.slot0, c.slot1 + tb * c.speed);
    const tc = t - entr;
    c.items[2] = tc < 0 ? NaN : Math.min(c.slot1, c.enter + tc * c.speed);
    const Rd = X.Rd;
    c.riderOn = t < Rd.hopOff ? 1 : t >= Rd.newRider ? 2 : -1;
  }
  function riderStep(w, t) {
    const X = w._, Rd = X.Rd, wk = w.walker, c = w.conveyor, cv = X.scene.conveyor, tq = Math.floor(t * 10 + 1e-6) / 10;
    const route = Rd.route, walkT = routeLen(route) / Rd.walkSpeed;
    const t0 = Rd.hopOff, t1 = t0 + Rd.hopSecs, t2 = t1 + walkT, t3 = t2 + 0.9, t4 = t3 + 0.3, t5 = t4 + 0.45;
    const co = X.at(K.COLLECT);
    w.cubbyCollectEmpty = t >= co.t0 + 1.6 && t < t5;
    wk.on = t >= t0 && t < t5;
    if (!wk.on) { wk.x = 0; wk.y = 0; wk.z = 0; wk.state = CS.WALK; wk.frame = 0; wk.face = 0; return; }
    wk.frame = 0;
    const bx = Math.round(c.slot0 * 0.5) * 2 + 5, by = cv.y0 + 6, bz = cv.z + cv.item.h;
    if (tq < t1) {                                                    // hop down off the end of the belt
      const f = clamp((tq - t0) / Rd.hopSecs, 0, 1);
      wk.state = CS.STRETCH; wk.face = 1;
      wk.x = lerp(bx, route[0][0], f); wk.y = lerp(by, route[0][1], f); wk.z = Math.max(0, lerp(bz, 0, f) + Math.sin(f * Math.PI) * 2);
    } else if (tq < t2) {                                             // follow the sorter up the corridor
      const d = (tq - t1) * Rd.walkSpeed;
      along(route, d, X.tmp);
      wk.state = CS.WALK; wk.x = X.tmp.x; wk.y = X.tmp.y; wk.z = 0; wk.face = (X.tmp.face === FACE.E || X.tmp.face === FACE.N) ? 1 : 0;
      wk.frame = Math.floor(d / 2.4) & 3;
    } else if (tq < t3) {                                             // hop up onto the plinth ledge
      const f = clamp((tq - t2) / 0.9, 0, 1), end = route[route.length - 1], L = Rd.ledge;
      wk.state = CS.STRETCH; wk.face = 1;
      wk.x = lerp(end[0], L[0], f); wk.y = lerp(end[1], L[1], f); wk.z = lerp(0, L[2], f) + Math.sin(f * Math.PI) * 2;
    } else if (tq < t4) {                                             // step into the cubby bed
      const f = clamp((tq - t3) / 0.3, 0, 1), L = Rd.ledge, Bd = Rd.bed;
      wk.state = CS.WALK; wk.face = 1; wk.frame = Math.floor(f * 4) & 3;
      wk.x = lerp(L[0], Bd[0], f); wk.y = lerp(L[1], Bd[1], f); wk.z = lerp(L[2], Bd[2], f);
    } else {                                                          // turn round and curl up; the cubby takes over after
      const Bd = Rd.bed;
      wk.state = tq < t4 + 0.2 ? CS.SIT : CS.SLEEP; wk.x = Bd[0]; wk.y = Bd[1]; wk.z = Bd[2]; wk.face = 0;
    }
  }

  // ---- lamp, trees, pigeon, camera ---------------------------------------------------------------
  function propsStep(w, t) {
    w.lampSX = Math.round(Math.sin(t / 12 * TAU) * 1.2);
    w.treeDX = Math.round(Math.sin(t / 8 * TAU) * 0.8);
  }
  const sillU = (u) => 81 - Math.round((u - 88) / 2);                  // window 1's outside sill in view coordinates
  function pigeonStep(w, t) {
    const tea = w._.at(K.TEA), T0 = tea.t0 + 2.0, T1 = tea.t0 + 8.0, pg = w.pigeon;
    pg.on = false;
    const a = t - T0;
    if (a < -0.8 || t > T1 + 0.9) { pg.x = -99; pg.y = 0; pg.frame = 0; pg.flip = false; return; }
    pg.on = true;
    if (a < 0) {                                                      // flying in from the right
      const f = 1 + a / 0.8, u = Math.round(lerp(134, 110, f)), v = Math.round(lerp(50, sillU(110) - 6, f));
      pg.x = u - 3; pg.y = v; pg.frame = Math.floor(t * 12) & 1; pg.flip = false;
      return;
    }
    if (t < T1) {                                                     // on the sill: bob and shuffle
      const stp = Math.floor(a / 1.2), u = 110 + ((stp % 4) === 1 ? -2 : (stp % 4) === 2 ? -4 : (stp % 4) === 3 ? -2 : 0);
      pg.x = u - 3; pg.y = sillU(u) - 6 + ((Math.floor(a * 3) % 4) === 0 ? 1 : 0); pg.frame = 0; pg.flip = (stp & 1) === 1;
      return;
    }
    const f = (t - T1) / 0.9, u = Math.round(lerp(110, 74, f)), v = Math.round(lerp(sillU(110) - 6, 38, f));   // off to the left
    pg.x = u - 3; pg.y = v; pg.frame = Math.floor(t * 12) & 1; pg.flip = true;
  }
  function cameraStep(w, t) {
    const K2 = w._.scene.camera.keys;
    let k = 0;
    while (k < K2.length - 2 && t >= K2[k + 1][0]) k++;
    const A = K2[k], B = K2[k + 1], f = ss((t - A[0]) / (B[0] - A[0]));
    w.camX = Math.round(lerp(A[1], B[1], f)); w.camY = Math.round(lerp(A[2], B[2], f));
  }

  // ---- the loop's particle events (analytic: the renderer evaluates them by age) ------------------
  function buildEvents(w) {
    const X = w._, sc = X.scene, E = w.events, tk = X.at(K.TAKE), st = X.at(K.STAMP), pk = X.at(K.PICKUP), sh = X.at(K.SHELVE), tea = X.at(K.TEA);
    const cz = sc.counter.z + 3, cvz = sc.conveyor.z;
    E.push({ kind: 'puff', t: tk.t0 + 0.75, x: 23, y: 21, z: 17, seed: 11 });                                  // box pops open
    E.push({ kind: 'ink', t: st.t0 + 2.0, x: X.S.counterBox[0] + 2, y: X.S.counterBox[1] - 1, z: cz + 7, seed: 12, floor: cz }); // thunk
    E.push({ kind: 'puff', t: st.t0 + 3.9, x: X.S.counterBox[0], y: X.S.counterBox[1], z: cz + 1, seed: 13 });      // down the chute
    E.push({ kind: 'puff', t: pk.t0 + 0.6, x: w.conveyor.slot0 + 5, y: sc.conveyor.y0 + 6, z: cvz + 1, seed: 14 });  // flat-pack lifted
    E.push({ kind: 'puff', t: sh.t0 + 1.0, x: 20, y: 7, z: sc.shelf.stack.z + 8, seed: 15 });                       // onto the stack
    // tea: steam from the mug in hand every 16 frames, a whisper from the sill mug otherwise
    const p = { face: 0, walk: -1, hold: 0, item: 0 };
    for (let f = Math.ceil(tea.t0 * 60); f < tea.t1 * 60; f++) {
      const t = f / 60, a = Math.floor(t * 10 + 1e-6) / 10 - tea.t0, inHand = t >= tea.t0 + 0.6 && t < tea.t0 + 9.2;
      if (inHand && f % 16 === 0) {
        const sip = (a >= 2.4 && a < 3.4) || (a >= 5.6 && a < 6.6) || (a >= 8.0 && a < 8.8);
        E.push({ kind: 'steam', t, x: tea.x - 5, y: tea.y + (sip ? 0 : 1), z: sip ? 23 : 17, seed: f });
      } else if (!inHand && t < tea.t1 - 0.6 && f % 30 === 0) E.push({ kind: 'steam', t, x: X.S.mug[0], y: X.S.mug[1], z: X.S.mug[2] + 3, seed: f });
    }
  }

  function step(w, frame) {
    const t = frame / 60;
    w.t = t; w.frame = frame;
    sorterStep(w, t); conveyorStep(w, t); riderStep(w, t); propsStep(w, t); pigeonStep(w, t); pmStep(w, t); cameraStep(w, t);
    return w;
  }
  // Plain copy of everything observable (for tests and for comparing loops).
  function snapshot(w) {
    const o = {};
    for (const k of Object.keys(w)) {
      if (k === '_' || k === 'events' || k === 't' || k === 'frame' || k === 'watch') continue;
      const v = w[k];
      o[k] = v && typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v, (kk, vv) => (vv instanceof Float32Array ? Array.from(vv) : vv))) : v;
    }
    return o;
  }
  function positions(w) {
    const X = w._, c = w.conveyor, cv = X.scene.conveyor, o = { sorter: [w.sorter.x, w.sorter.y], pm: [w.pm.x, w.pm.y, w.pm.z] };
    if (c.riderOn >= 0) o.belt = [Math.round(c.items[c.riderOn] * 0.5) * 2 + 5, cv.y0 + 6, cv.z + cv.item.h];
    if (w.walker.on) o.walker = [w.walker.x, w.walker.y, w.walker.z];
    return o;
  }
  return { FACE, K, ITEM, CS, create, step, snapshot, positions };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = WORLD;
// ============================================================================
// 15 PROGRESS (pure; Node-exported): each level's best win (its stars, then the
// turntables and ticks it took), the levels unlocked, and the level being
// played, as plain data. The app keeps it as a JSON string in a key-value store
// (app/42b_progress: localStorage in this proof of concept, UserDefaults on iOS).
// Nothing here touches storage.
//  - Best win: the most stars, then the fewest turntables, then the fewest ticks.
//  - Unlocking: the first level is always open; winning a level unlocks the next.
//    A level is also open if the one before it has been won (so progress saved by
//    phase 1, or levels inserted later, stay reachable).
//  - Daily puzzles, by date: each attempt's result, whether the hint was used, and
//    the winning result. Once solved, a day's record stays as it was (the share
//    card and the streak read it).
// Night Shift progress adds weekly/all-time bests and cumulative cats home for the collection.
// Swift: struct Progress: Codable { version, levels: [String: Best], unlocked, current, daily: [String: Day],
//   practice: Practice, nightShift: NightShiftProgress }.
// ============================================================================
const PROGRESS = (function () {
  const KEY = 'catsByPost.progress', VERSION = 5;
  const emptyPractice = () => ({ current: '', records: {}, order: [] });
  const emptyNightShift = () => ({ weeklyBest: {}, allTimeBest: 0, totalCatsHome: 0 });
  const empty = () => ({ version: VERSION, levels: {}, unlocked: [], current: '', daily: {}, practice: emptyPractice(), nightShift: emptyNightShift() });
  const starCount = (s) => (s.delivered ? 1 : 0) + (s.tidy ? 1 : 0) + (s.firstPost ? 1 : 0);
  const isInt = Number.isInteger;
  function readBest(b) {
    if (!b || !b.stars || !isInt(b.turntables) || !isInt(b.ticks)) return null;
    return { stars: { delivered: !!b.stars.delivered, tidy: !!b.stars.tidy, firstPost: !!b.stars.firstPost }, turntables: b.turntables, ticks: b.ticks };
  }
  function readDay(d) {
    if (!d || !Array.isArray(d.attempts) || !d.attempts.every((a) => typeof a === 'boolean')) return null;
    const out = { attempts: d.attempts.slice(), hinted: !!d.hinted, done: !!d.done };
    if (out.done) { const b = readBest(d); if (!b) return null; Object.assign(out, b); }
    return out;
  }
  function validDate(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
    const [year, month, day] = value.split('-').map(Number);
    const date = new Date(0);
    date.setUTCFullYear(year, month - 1, day);
    return date.getUTCFullYear() === year && date.getUTCMonth() + 1 === month && date.getUTCDate() === day;
  }
  function readPractice(value) {
    const out = emptyPractice();
    if (!value || !value.records || typeof value.records !== 'object') return out;
    for (const [key, record] of Object.entries(value.records)) {
      if (!record || !Number.isInteger(record.seed) || record.seed < 0 || record.seed > 0xffffffff ||
          !Number.isInteger(record.weekday) || record.weekday < 0 || record.weekday > 6 ||
          key !== record.weekday + ':' + record.seed || !validDate(record.date)) continue;
      const day = readDay(record);
      if (day) {
        out.records[key] = Object.assign({ seed: record.seed, weekday: record.weekday, date: record.date }, day);
        if (record.level && record.level.board && Array.isArray(record.level.hatches) &&
            Array.isArray(record.level.baskets) && Array.isArray(record.level.solution) && record.level.tray)
          out.records[key].level = record.level;
      }
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value.order)) for (const key of value.order) if (out.records[key] && !out.order.includes(key)) out.order.push(key);
    for (const key of Object.keys(out.records)) if (!out.order.includes(key)) out.order.push(key);
    if (out.records[value.current]) out.current = value.current;
    return out;
  }
  function readNightShift(value) {
    const out = emptyNightShift();
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return out;
    const score = (n) => Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : 0;
    out.allTimeBest = score(value.allTimeBest);
    out.totalCatsHome = score(value.totalCatsHome);
    if (value.weeklyBest && typeof value.weeklyBest === 'object') for (const [key, best] of Object.entries(value.weeklyBest))
      if (/^\d{4}-W(0[1-9]|[1-4]\d|5[0-3])$/.test(key) && Number.isSafeInteger(best) && best >= 0) out.weeklyBest[key] = best;
    return out;
  }
  // Anything unreadable, or from an unknown version, starts afresh. Versions 1–4 carry over.
  function parse(text) {
    let p = null;
    try { p = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { return empty(); }
    if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return empty();
    const out = empty();
    out.current = typeof p.current === 'string' ? p.current : '';
    if (p.version === 1 && p.solved && typeof p.solved === 'object') {
      for (const id of Object.keys(p.solved)) {
        const b = readBest({ stars: { delivered: true }, turntables: p.solved[id] && p.solved[id].turntables, ticks: p.solved[id] && p.solved[id].ticks });
        if (b) { out.levels[id] = b; out.unlocked.push(id); }
      }
      return out;
    }
    if ((p.version !== 2 && p.version !== 3 && p.version !== 4 && p.version !== VERSION) || !p.levels || typeof p.levels !== 'object') return empty();
    for (const id of Object.keys(p.levels)) { const b = readBest(p.levels[id]); if (b) out.levels[id] = b; }
    if (Array.isArray(p.unlocked)) for (const id of p.unlocked) if (typeof id === 'string' && out.unlocked.indexOf(id) < 0) out.unlocked.push(id);
    if (p.daily && typeof p.daily === 'object') for (const key of Object.keys(p.daily)) { const d = readDay(p.daily[key]); if (d) out.daily[key] = d; }
    if (p.version === 4 || p.version === VERSION) out.practice = readPractice(p.practice);
    if (p.version === VERSION) out.nightShift = readNightShift(p.nightShift);
    return out;
  }
  const serialize = (p) => JSON.stringify(p);
  function better(a, b) {                                            // is win a better than b (or b missing)?
    if (!b) return true;
    const ca = starCount(a.stars), cb = starCount(b.stars);
    if (ca !== cb) return ca > cb;
    if (a.turntables !== b.turntables) return a.turntables < b.turntables;
    return a.ticks < b.ticks;
  }
  // A win ({ stars, turntables, ticks }): keep the better of it and the saved one, and unlock the next level.
  function won(p, levels, id, result) {
    const i = levels.findIndex((L) => L.id === id), unlocked = p.unlocked.slice();
    for (const u of [id, i >= 0 && i + 1 < levels.length ? levels[i + 1].id : null]) if (u && unlocked.indexOf(u) < 0) unlocked.push(u);
    const levelsOut = Object.assign({}, p.levels, { [id]: better(result, p.levels[id]) ? result : p.levels[id] });
    return Object.assign({}, p, { version: VERSION, levels: levelsOut, unlocked });
  }
  // A daily attempt ended (won: result is { stars, turntables, ticks }). Nothing changes once the day is solved.
  function dailyAttempt(p, key, isWin, result) {
    const d = p.daily[key] || { attempts: [], hinted: false, done: false };
    if (d.done) return p;
    const next = { attempts: d.attempts.concat([!!isWin]), hinted: d.hinted, done: !!isWin };
    if (isWin) Object.assign(next, { stars: result.stars, turntables: result.turntables, ticks: result.ticks });
    return Object.assign({}, p, { daily: Object.assign({}, p.daily, { [key]: next }) });
  }
  function dailyHinted(p, key) {
    const d = p.daily[key] || { attempts: [], hinted: false, done: false };
    if (d.done || d.hinted) return p;
    return Object.assign({}, p, { daily: Object.assign({}, p.daily, { [key]: Object.assign({}, d, { hinted: true }) }) });
  }
  const dailySolved = (p, key) => !!(p.daily[key] && p.daily[key].done);
  function isUnlocked(p, levels, i) {
    return i === 0 || p.unlocked.indexOf(levels[i].id) >= 0 || !!p.levels[levels[i - 1].id];
  }
  const setCurrent = (p, id) => Object.assign({}, p, { version: VERSION, current: id });
  function nightShiftFinished(p, kind, weekKey, catsHome) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(catsHome) || catsHome < 0) throw new RangeError('invalid Night Shift score');
    if (kind !== 'weekly' && kind !== 'random') throw new RangeError('invalid Night Shift kind');
    if (kind === 'weekly' && !/^\d{4}-W(0[1-9]|[1-4]\d|5[0-3])$/.test(weekKey)) throw new RangeError('invalid Night Shift week');
    const old = p.nightShift || emptyNightShift(), weeklyBest = Object.assign({}, old.weeklyBest);
    if (kind === 'weekly') weeklyBest[weekKey] = Math.max(weeklyBest[weekKey] || 0, catsHome);
    const nightShift = { weeklyBest, allTimeBest: Math.max(old.allTimeBest, catsHome),
      totalCatsHome: Math.min(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, old.totalCatsHome + catsHome) };
    return Object.assign({}, p, { version: VERSION, nightShift });
  }
  function importLegacyNightBest(p, score) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(score) || score < 0) return p;
    const old = p.nightShift || emptyNightShift();
    if (score <= old.allTimeBest && score <= old.totalCatsHome) return p;
    return Object.assign({}, p, { version: VERSION, nightShift: {
      weeklyBest: old.weeklyBest, allTimeBest: Math.max(old.allTimeBest, score), totalCatsHome: Math.max(old.totalCatsHome, score),
    } });
  }
  function collection(p) {
    const total = (p.nightShift || emptyNightShift()).totalCatsHome;
    const cats = ['greyTabby', 'black', 'white', 'cream'];
    for (const [at, coat] of [[50, 'smoke'], [100, 'calico'], [250, 'tortie'], [500, 'siamese']]) if (total >= at) cats.push(coat);
    return cats;
  }
  function practiceOpen(p, seed, weekday, date, level) {
    const key = weekday + ':' + seed, old = p.practice.records[key];
    const record = old ? (!old.level && level ? Object.assign({}, old, { level }) : old) :
      Object.assign({ seed, weekday, date, attempts: [], hinted: false, done: false }, level ? { level } : {});
    return Object.assign({}, p, { practice: {
      current: key, records: Object.assign({}, p.practice.records, { [key]: record }),
      order: old ? p.practice.order : p.practice.order.concat(key),
    } });
  }
  function practiceHinted(p, key) {
    const record = p.practice.records[key];
    if (!record || record.hinted) return p;
    return Object.assign({}, p, { practice: Object.assign({}, p.practice, {
      records: Object.assign({}, p.practice.records, { [key]: Object.assign({}, record, { hinted: true }) }),
    }) });
  }
  function practiceAttempt(p, key, isWin, result) {
    const record = p.practice.records[key];
    if (!record) return p;
    const next = Object.assign({}, record, { attempts: record.attempts.concat(!!isWin), done: record.done || !!isWin });
    if (isWin && better(result, record.done ? record : null)) Object.assign(next, result);
    return Object.assign({}, p, { practice: Object.assign({}, p.practice, {
      records: Object.assign({}, p.practice.records, { [key]: next }),
    }) });
  }
  // Where the game opens: the level being played if it's unlocked, else the first unlocked level not yet won.
  function startIndex(p, levels) {
    const k = levels.findIndex((L) => L.id === p.current);
    if (k >= 0 && isUnlocked(p, levels, k)) return k;
    const u = levels.findIndex((L, i) => isUnlocked(p, levels, i) && !p.levels[L.id]);
    return u >= 0 ? u : 0;
  }
  return { KEY, VERSION, empty, parse, serialize, starCount, better, won, isUnlocked, setCurrent, startIndex, dailyAttempt, dailyHinted, dailySolved,
    practiceOpen, practiceHinted, practiceAttempt, nightShiftFinished, importLegacyNightBest, collection };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = PROGRESS;
// ============================================================================
// 16 SCORE (pure; Node-exported): the stars a win earns, and hints, as plain
// data. A win earns up to 3 stars:
//   delivered  the level is solved
//   tidy       it used no more turntables than the level's minTurntables
//   firstPost  it was won within 3 attempts (Send presses since the level was
//              opened), with no hint
// A hint places the next turntable of the stored solution, the right way round,
// and locks it, so the player can't turn it, pick it up or clear it.
// Swift: struct Stars, func stars(...), func applyHint(...).
// ============================================================================
const SCORE = (function () {
  const FIRST_POST_ATTEMPTS = 3;
  function stars(level, turntables, attempt, hinted) {
    return { delivered: true, tidy: turntables <= level.minTurntables, firstPost: attempt <= FIRST_POST_ATTEMPTS && !hinted };
  }
  const count = (s) => (s.delivered ? 1 : 0) + (s.tidy ? 1 : 0) + (s.firstPost ? 1 : 0);
  const same = (p, q) => p.x === q.x && p.y === q.y && p.type === q.type && p.dir === q.dir;
  const onTile = (p, q) => p.x === q.x && p.y === q.y;
  // The next turntable of the stored solution that isn't already on the board as stored; null when none is left.
  function nextHint(level, placements) {
    for (const s of level.solution) if (!placements.some((p) => same(p, s))) return s;
    return null;
  }
  // The board and tray after a hint ({ placements, tray, hint }, or null if there's nothing left to hint).
  // Whatever stood on the hint's tile goes back to the tray. The hint's turntable comes from the tray or,
  // if the tray has none of its type, off the board: one of that type that isn't part of the solution.
  function applyHint(level, placements, tray) {
    const h = nextHint(level, placements);
    if (!h) return null;
    const P = placements.filter((p) => !onTile(p, h)), T = { plain: tray.plain | 0, ginger: tray.ginger | 0, blue: tray.blue | 0 };
    for (const p of placements) if (onTile(p, h)) T[p.type]++;
    if (T[h.type] > 0) T[h.type]--;
    else {
      const k = P.findIndex((p) => p.type === h.type && !p.locked && !level.solution.some((s) => same(p, s)));
      if (k < 0) return null;                                         // only with a tray too small for the solution
      P.splice(k, 1);
    }
    P.push({ x: h.x, y: h.y, type: h.type, dir: h.dir, locked: true });
    return { placements: P, tray: T, hint: h };
  }
  return { FIRST_POST_ATTEMPTS, stars, count, nextHint, applyHint };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = SCORE;
// ============================================================================
// 17 DAILY (pure; Node-exported): the daily puzzle's calendar, difficulty score,
// share card and streak, as plain data. Shared by tools/daily.js (which writes
// daily/puzzles.json), the page and the tests.
//  - Dates are calendar days written 'YYYY-MM-DD' (the player's local date); day
//    numbers count days since 1970-01-01, so no time zone ever enters.
//  - Puzzle #1 is the file's startDate; #n is the (n - 1)th day after it.
//  - Weekdays: 0 Monday ... 6 Sunday.
// Swift: struct DailyPuzzle, Calendar-free day numbers, the same score and text.
// ============================================================================
const DAILY = (function () {
  const WEEKDAYS = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
  const DAY_MS = 86400000, pad = (n) => (n < 10 ? '0' : '') + n;
  function dayNumber(key) {
    const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(key || '');
    if (!m) return NaN;
    const t = Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]), d = new Date(t);
    return d.getUTCMonth() === +m[2] - 1 && d.getUTCDate() === +m[3] ? t / DAY_MS : NaN;   // rejects 2026-02-30
  }
  function keyOf(day) { const d = new Date(day * DAY_MS); return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getUTCDate()); }
  const localKey = (date) => date.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(date.getDate());
  const weekday = (key) => (((dayNumber(key) + 3) % 7) + 7) % 7;      // 1970-01-01 was a Thursday
  // The puzzle for a date, or null before the first puzzle or after the last.
  function puzzleFor(daily, key) {
    if (!daily || !daily.puzzles) return null;
    const i = dayNumber(key) - dayNumber(daily.startDate);
    return i >= 0 && i < daily.puzzles.length ? daily.puzzles[i] : null;
  }
  // Difficulty: more turntables, bounces, cats and dogs, fewer solutions and a bigger board are harder.
  // stats: { turntables, bounces, cats, dogs, solutions, area }
  function difficulty(st) {
    const v = 10 * st.turntables + 4 * Math.min(st.bounces, 6) + 3 * st.cats + 1.5 * st.dogs + 4 * (3 - Math.min(st.solutions, 3)) + 0.5 * (st.area - 20);
    return Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
  }
  // The range of scores a weekday's targets allow ({ turntables: [lo, hi], ... } from daily/settings.json).
  function difficultyRange(t, minArea, maxArea) {
    return [difficulty({ turntables: t.turntables[0], bounces: t.bounces[0], cats: t.cats[0], dogs: t.dogs[0], solutions: t.solutions[1], area: minArea }),
      difficulty({ turntables: t.turntables[1], bounces: t.bounces[1], cats: t.cats[1], dogs: t.dogs[1], solutions: t.solutions[0], area: maxArea })];
  }
  // The share card: no tiles, no directions, nothing that gives the solution away.
  // attempts: [false, false, true] (each Send: failed or solved); stars: { delivered, tidy, firstPost }
  function shareText(entry, attempts, turntables, stars) {
    const n = (stars.delivered ? 1 : 0) + (stars.tidy ? 1 : 0) + (stars.firstPost ? 1 : 0);
    return 'Cats by Post #' + entry.number + ' · ' + WEEKDAYS[weekday(entry.date)] + '\n' +
      attempts.map((ok) => (ok ? '🟩' : '🟥')).join('') + ' · ' + turntables + (turntables === 1 ? ' turntable' : ' turntables') + ' · ' + '⭐'.repeat(n);
  }
  // Days in a row solved, counting back from today (or from yesterday while today is still to play).
  function streak(isSolved, todayKey) {
    let d = dayNumber(todayKey), n = 0;
    if (!isSolved(keyOf(d))) d--;
    while (isSolved(keyOf(d))) { n++; d--; }
    return n;
  }
  return { WEEKDAYS, dayNumber, keyOf, localKey, weekday, puzzleFor, difficulty, difficultyRange, shareText, streak };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = DAILY;
// ============================================================================
// 18 BOX ROOM (pure; Node-exported): the attic where every generated level is
// played. build(seed, w, h, date, mode, collection) returns plain data and draws
// nothing; the renderer draws from it. Settings: src/data/boxroom.json.
//  - World units as in the scene: 1 tile = 16 wu; x from the left back wall
//    (plane x = 0), y from the right back wall (plane y = 0), z up. Every
//    coordinate in the result is a whole number.
//  - Same inputs, same room: a mulberry32 stream per part, never Math.random.
//    The layout (stacks, gaps, props, slots, lamps, beams) depends only on the
//    seed and the board size. The date picks the dressing items for the fixed
//    slots, and the weekday (or free play) picks the light and the skylights.
//  - What can hide a tile: the view ray is (1, 1, 1), so a point (x, y, z)
//    hides the floor point (x - z, y - z). A box hides a tile only if that swept
//    footprint reaches the tile's 12 x 6 px core (the same core the in-page
//    check uses), which is a diamond |dx - dy| < 6, |dx + dy| < 6 on the floor.
//  - Skylight light is stylised: each patch is the projection, along the day's
//    light, of a virtual opening VZ wu up. Only things standing on the floor
//    margins (props, dressing items, loose boxes, lamps) cast shadows into it;
//    the stacks and walls don't. A point at height z is lit when its drop along
//    the light, (x + a z, y + b z), lands in a patch. The drawn skylight sits in
//    the roof band, upstream of its patch along the light.
// Swift: struct BoxRoom: Codable, the same streams (UInt32 wrapping maths), the
// same checks; tests/golden.json holds reference rooms and digests.
// ============================================================================
const BOXROOM = (function () {
  const isNode = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const DY = isNode ? require('./17_daily.js') : DAILY;
  const CFG = isNode ? require('../data/boxroom.json') : BOXROOM_DATA;
  const T = CFG.tile, D = CFG.stackD, WALL_H = CFG.wallH;
  const PITCH = CFG.roof.pitchNum / CFG.roof.pitchDen, RUN = CFG.roof.run;
  const ROOF_TOP = WALL_H + RUN * CFG.roof.pitchNum / CFG.roof.pitchDen;
  const VZ = CFG.skylights.virtualZ, BAR_W = CFG.skylights.barW, LIGHT_DEN = 16;
  const CORE = 7;                                   // tile core half-size on the floor diagonals: 6 wu + 1 for rounding
  const SETS = ['mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat', 'sun', 'night'];
  const SEASONS = ['spring', 'summer', 'autumn', 'december', 'winter'];
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);

  // ---- random streams --------------------------------------------------------
  function fmix(h) {                                 // murmur3 finaliser: seeds each stream
    h ^= h >>> 16; h = Math.imul(h, 0x85ebca6b); h ^= h >>> 13; h = Math.imul(h, 0xc2b2ae35); h ^= h >>> 16;
    return h >>> 0;
  }
  function rng(seed) {                               // mulberry32, as in render/21_core
    let s = seed >>> 0;
    const r = {
      u32() {
        s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
        let t = s;
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return (t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0;
      },
      int(n) { return Math.floor(r.u32() * n / 4294967296); },        // 0 .. n-1 (exact: u32 * n < 2^53)
      range(lo, hi) { return lo + r.int(hi - lo + 1); },              // lo .. hi
      even(lo, hi) { return lo + 2 * r.int(((hi - lo) >> 1) + 1); },  // even steps from lo
      chance(pct) { return r.int(100) < pct; },
      shuffle(a) { for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = r.int(i + 1), t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; } return a; },
    };
    return r;
  }
  const stream = (seed, k) => rng(fmix((seed ^ Math.imul(k, 0x9E3779B9)) >>> 0));
  const ST = { MARGINS: 1, STACKS: 2, SLOTS: 3, PROPS: 4, ROOF: 5, FRONT: 6, NAPS: 7, LIGHT: 16 };

  // ---- small geometry ----------------------------------------------------------
  const ceilAt = (x, y) => WALL_H + PITCH * Math.min(x, y);           // underside of the two roof slopes
  const overlap2 = (a, b, g) => a[0] < b[3] + g && b[0] < a[3] + g && a[1] < b[4] + g && b[1] < a[4] + g;
  // On wall L (plane x = 0) u runs along y and v along x; on wall R (y = 0) u runs along x and v along y.
  const wallBox = (wall, u0, u1, v0, v1, z0, z1) => (wall === 'L' ? [v0, u0, z0, v1, u1, z1] : [u0, v0, z0, u1, v1, z1]);

  // Does the box [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1] hide the core of any board tile? Returns the first tile [i, j] or null.
  // The floor it hides is the footprint swept by (-z, -z) for z in [z0, z1]: a hexagon. Separating axes:
  // x, y, x + y and x - y (the hexagon's and the core diamond's edge normals).
  function hidesTile(B, bx) {
    const hx0 = bx[0] - bx[5], hx1 = bx[3] - bx[2], hy0 = bx[1] - bx[5], hy1 = bx[4] - bx[2];
    const hs0 = bx[0] + bx[1] - 2 * bx[5], hs1 = bx[3] + bx[4] - 2 * bx[2], hd0 = bx[0] - bx[4], hd1 = bx[3] - bx[1];
    const i0 = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((hx0 - CORE - B.x - 8) / T)), i1 = Math.min(B.w - 1, Math.floor((hx1 + CORE - B.x - 8) / T));
    const j0 = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((hy0 - CORE - B.y - 8) / T)), j1 = Math.min(B.h - 1, Math.floor((hy1 + CORE - B.y - 8) / T));
    for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
      const cx = B.x + 8 + i * T, cy = B.y + 8 + j * T;
      if (!(hx0 < cx + CORE && cx - CORE < hx1 && hy0 < cy + CORE && cy - CORE < hy1)) continue;
      if (!(hs0 < cx + cy + CORE && cx + cy - CORE < hs1)) continue;
      if (!(hd0 < cx - cy + CORE && cx - cy - CORE < hd1)) continue;
      return [i, j];
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ---- polygons (light patches) ----------------------------------------------------
  const patchPoly = (p) => [[p.x, p.y], [p.x + p.e1[0], p.y + p.e1[1]], [p.x + p.e1[0] + p.e2[0], p.y + p.e1[1] + p.e2[1]], [p.x + p.e2[0], p.y + p.e2[1]]];
  function polyArea(P) { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) { const a = P[i], b = P[(i + 1) % P.length]; s += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; } return Math.abs(s) / 2; }
  // Sutherland-Hodgman: clip polygon P against the convex polygon C.
  function clipConvex(P, C) {
    let sgn = 0; for (let i = 0; i < C.length; i++) { const a = C[i], b = C[(i + 1) % C.length]; sgn += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }
    let out = P;
    for (let i = 0; i < C.length && out.length; i++) {
      const a = C[i], b = C[(i + 1) % C.length], inp = out; out = [];
      const side = (q) => ((b[0] - a[0]) * (q[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (q[0] - a[0])) * sgn;
      for (let k = 0; k < inp.length; k++) {
        const p = inp[k], q = inp[(k + 1) % inp.length], sp = side(p), sq = side(q);
        if (sp >= 0) out.push(p);
        if ((sp >= 0) !== (sq >= 0)) { const t = sp / (sp - sq); out.push([p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * t]); }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  const rectPoly = (x0, y0, x1, y1) => [[x0, y0], [x1, y0], [x1, y1], [x0, y1]];

  // A point on the floor: inside patch p and not in the shadow of its frame bars?
  function inPatch(p, x, y) {
    const e1 = p.e1, e2 = p.e2, dx = x - p.x, dy = y - p.y, det = e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0];
    const s = (dx * e2[1] - dy * e2[0]) / det, t = (e1[0] * dy - e1[1] * dx) / det;
    if (s < 0 || s >= 1 || t < 0 || t >= 1) return false;
    const h1 = Math.abs(det) / Math.sqrt(e2[0] * e2[0] + e2[1] * e2[1]);   // patch width across the bars that run along e2
    const h2 = Math.abs(det) / Math.sqrt(e1[0] * e1[0] + e1[1] * e1[1]);
    for (let k = 1; k < p.panes[0]; k++) if (Math.abs(s - k / p.panes[0]) * h1 < BAR_W / 2) return false;
    for (let k = 1; k < p.panes[1]; k++) if (Math.abs(t - k / p.panes[1]) * h2 < BAR_W / 2) return false;
    return true;
  }
  // Is the floor point's path to the light (up along (-a, -b, 1) to height VZ) blocked by a box in occ?
  function shaded(occ, x, y, a, b) {
    for (let k = 0; k < occ.length; k++) {
      const o = occ[k];
      let t0 = Math.max(o[2], 1e-3), t1 = Math.min(o[5], VZ);
      const ax0 = (x - o[3]) / a, ax1 = (x - o[0]) / a; if (ax0 > t0) t0 = ax0; if (ax1 < t1) t1 = ax1;
      const ay0 = (y - o[4]) / b, ay1 = (y - o[1]) / b; if (ay0 > t0) t0 = ay0; if (ay1 < t1) t1 = ay1;
      if (t0 < t1) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  // Fraction of the board in sunlight, by scanlines: exact along x, a row every `dy` wu (default 0.5). Each patch
  // gives an interval on a row, less its own frame bars; shadows are the floor projections of the occluders
  // along the light (convex hulls of their 8 corners).
  function hull(P) {                                 // monotone chain, counter-clockwise
    P = P.slice().sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0] || p[1] - q[1]);
    const cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]), lo = [], up = [];
    for (const p of P) { while (lo.length >= 2 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], p) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p); }
    for (let i = P.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = P[i]; while (up.length >= 2 && cr(up[up.length - 2], up[up.length - 1], p) <= 0) up.pop(); up.push(p); }
    return lo.slice(0, -1).concat(up.slice(0, -1));
  }
  function shadowOf(o, a, b) {
    const z0 = Math.max(o[2], 0), z1 = Math.min(o[5], VZ), pts = [];
    if (z1 <= z0) return null;
    for (const z of [z0, z1]) for (const x of [o[0], o[3]]) for (const y of [o[1], o[4]]) pts.push([x + a * z, y + b * z]);
    return hull(pts);
  }
  // Row maths without allocation: scratch interval buffers (pairs of x0, x1) reused for every row.
  let rx0 = 0, rx1 = 0;
  function polyRow(P, y) {                           // x-interval of convex polygon P on the line at y -> rx0, rx1
    let x0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
      const p = P[i], q = P[(i + 1) % P.length];
      if ((p[1] <= y && y < q[1]) || (q[1] <= y && y < p[1])) { const x = p[0] + (y - p[1]) * (q[0] - p[0]) / (q[1] - p[1]); if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; }
    }
    rx0 = x0; rx1 = x1;
    return x0 < x1;
  }
  function sortIv(buf, n) {                          // insertion sort of n intervals by start (n is small)
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
      const a0 = buf[2 * i], a1 = buf[2 * i + 1];
      let j = i - 1;
      while (j >= 0 && buf[2 * j] > a0) { buf[2 * j + 2] = buf[2 * j]; buf[2 * j + 3] = buf[2 * j + 1]; j--; }
      buf[2 * j + 2] = a0; buf[2 * j + 3] = a1;
    }
  }
  function measure(buf, n) {                         // total length of the union of n intervals
    sortIv(buf, n);
    let tot = 0, c0 = -Infinity, c1 = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a0 = buf[2 * i], a1 = buf[2 * i + 1];
      if (a0 > c1) { if (c1 > c0) tot += c1 - c0; c0 = a0; c1 = a1; } else if (a1 > c1) c1 = a1;
    }
    return tot + (c1 > c0 ? c1 - c0 : 0);
  }
  function prepPatch(p) {
    const e1 = p.e1, e2 = p.e2, det = e1[0] * e2[1] - e1[1] * e2[0];
    return { p, poly: patchPoly(p), det, h1: Math.abs(det) / Math.sqrt(e2[0] * e2[0] + e2[1] * e2[1]), h2: Math.abs(det) / Math.sqrt(e1[0] * e1[0] + e1[1] * e1[1]),
      y0: Math.min(p.y, p.y + e1[1], p.y + e2[1], p.y + e1[1] + e2[1]), y1: Math.max(p.y, p.y + e1[1], p.y + e2[1], p.y + e1[1] + e2[1]) };
  }
  const LIT = new Float64Array(64), CUT = new Float64Array(32), SHD = new Float64Array(64), BOTH = new Float64Array(512);
  // Append to LIT (from index n) the pieces of row y that patch q lights, its frame bars removed. Returns the new n.
  function patchRow(q, y, n) {
    if (y < q.y0 || y >= q.y1 || !polyRow(q.poly, y)) return n;
    const r0 = rx0, r1 = rx1, p = q.p;
    let nc = 0;
    // s(x) = sA x + sB and t(x) = tA x + tB along the row
    const sA = p.e2[1] / q.det, sB = (-p.x * p.e2[1] - (y - p.y) * p.e2[0]) / q.det;
    const tA = -p.e1[1] / q.det, tB = (p.e1[0] * (y - p.y) + p.e1[1] * p.x) / q.det;
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
      const A = pass ? tA : sA, Bc = pass ? tB : sB, np = p.panes[pass], d = BAR_W / 2 / (pass ? q.h2 : q.h1);
      for (let k = 1; k < np; k++) {                 // where |A x + Bc - k / np| < d
        const kk = k / np;
        if (A === 0) { if (Math.abs(Bc - kk) < d) { CUT[2 * nc] = r0; CUT[2 * nc + 1] = r1; nc++; } continue; }
        const u0 = (kk - d - Bc) / A, u1 = (kk + d - Bc) / A;
        CUT[2 * nc] = u0 < u1 ? u0 : u1; CUT[2 * nc + 1] = u0 < u1 ? u1 : u0; nc++;
      }
    }
    sortIv(CUT, nc);
    let x = r0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nc; i++) {
      const c0 = CUT[2 * i], c1 = CUT[2 * i + 1];
      if (c0 > x) { LIT[2 * n] = x; LIT[2 * n + 1] = c0 < r1 ? c0 : r1; n++; }
      if (c1 > x) x = c1;
      if (x >= r1) return n;
    }
    if (x < r1) { LIT[2 * n] = x; LIT[2 * n + 1] = r1; n++; }
    return n;
  }
  function sunlitWith(B, patches, occ, a, b, dy) {
    if (!patches.length) return 0;
    dy = dy || 0.5;
    const PP = patches.map(prepPatch), SH = [];
    for (const o of occ) { const h = shadowOf(o, a, b); if (h) SH.push(h); }
    const xL = B.x, xR = B.x + B.w * T, yT = B.y, yB = B.y + B.h * T;
    let lit = 0, rows = 0;
    for (let y = yT + dy / 2; y < yB; y += dy) {
      rows++;
      let n = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < PP.length; k++) n = patchRow(PP[k], y, n);
      let m = 0;                                     // clip to the board
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const v0 = LIT[2 * i] > xL ? LIT[2 * i] : xL, v1 = LIT[2 * i + 1] < xR ? LIT[2 * i + 1] : xR;
        if (v0 < v1) { LIT[2 * m] = v0; LIT[2 * m + 1] = v1; m++; }
      }
      if (!m) continue;
      let ns = 0;
      for (let k = 0; k < SH.length; k++) if (polyRow(SH[k], y)) { SHD[2 * ns] = rx0; SHD[2 * ns + 1] = rx1; ns++; }
      let nb = 0;                                    // lit and not shaded = all - |lit ∩ shadow|
      for (let i = 0; i < m && ns; i++) for (let j = 0; j < ns; j++) {
        const u0 = LIT[2 * i] > SHD[2 * j] ? LIT[2 * i] : SHD[2 * j], u1 = LIT[2 * i + 1] < SHD[2 * j + 1] ? LIT[2 * i + 1] : SHD[2 * j + 1];
        if (u0 < u1) { BOTH[2 * nb] = u0; BOTH[2 * nb + 1] = u1; nb++; }
      }
      lit += measure(LIT, m) - (nb ? measure(BOTH, nb) : 0);
    }
    return lit / (rows * (xR - xL));
  }
  // The patch lines that run along the tile grid (constant x or constant y) and their positions; none may sit
  // within 3 wu of a tile line on the board, or it would read as a gap between tiles.
  function gridLines(p) {
    const out = [];
    const ax = p.e1[0] === 0 ? 0 : 1;                // e1 runs along y (ax 0: the lines are constant x) or along x
    for (let k = 0; k <= p.panes[1]; k++) {
      const q = [p.x + p.e2[0] * k / p.panes[1], p.y + p.e2[1] * k / p.panes[1]];
      out.push({ axis: ax === 0 ? 'x' : 'y', at: q[ax === 0 ? 0 : 1], from: q[ax === 0 ? 1 : 0], to: q[ax === 0 ? 1 : 0] + p.e1[ax === 0 ? 1 : 0] });
    }
    if (Math.abs(p.e2[ax === 0 ? 1 : 0]) < 4) {      // e2 nearly along the grid too
      for (let k = 0; k <= p.panes[0]; k++) {
        const q = [p.x + p.e1[0] * k / p.panes[0], p.y + p.e1[1] * k / p.panes[0]];
        out.push({ axis: ax === 0 ? 'y' : 'x', at: q[ax === 0 ? 1 : 0], from: q[ax === 0 ? 0 : 1], to: q[ax === 0 ? 0 : 1] + p.e2[ax === 0 ? 0 : 1] });
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function onGrid(B, p) {
    for (const L of gridLines(p)) {
      const base = L.axis === 'x' ? B.x : B.y, n = L.axis === 'x' ? B.w : B.h;
      const o0 = L.axis === 'x' ? B.y : B.x, o1 = o0 + (L.axis === 'x' ? B.h : B.w) * T;
      if (Math.max(L.from, L.to) <= o0 || Math.min(L.from, L.to) >= o1) continue;      // the line misses the board
      for (let m = 0; m <= n; m++) if (Math.abs(L.at - (base + m * T)) < 3) return L;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ---- inputs -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function seasonOf(date) { return CFG.seasons.months[+date.slice(5, 7) - 1]; }
  function lightSetOf(date, mode) {
    if (mode === 'free') return 'night';
    if (mode === 'daily') return SETS[DY.weekday(date)];
    throw new RangeError('mode must be daily or free: ' + mode);
  }
  function isRainy(date) {                           // the weather follows the date, not the seed: every room is wet that day
    const sp = CFG.seasons[seasonOf(date)];
    return !!sp.rainChance && fmix((DY.dayNumber(date) ^ 0x5bd1e995) >>> 0) % 100 < sp.rainChance;
  }

  // ---- layout: seed and board size only ---------------------------------------------------
  function layout(seed, W, H) {
    const rm = stream(seed, ST.MARGINS);
    const mx0 = rm.chance(CFG.margins.back2) ? 2 : 1, my0 = rm.chance(CFG.margins.back2) ? 2 : 1;
    const mx1 = rm.chance(CFG.margins.front2) ? 2 : 1, my1 = rm.chance(CFG.margins.front2) ? 2 : 1;
    const B = { x: D + mx0 * T, y: D + my0 * T, w: W, h: H };
    const L = { B, margins: [mx0, my0, mx1, my1], RX: B.x + (W + mx1) * T, RY: B.y + (H + my1) * T };
    L.boardBox = [B.x, B.y, 0, B.x + W * T, B.y + H * T, 0];
    stacks(L, stream(seed, ST.STACKS));
    roof(L, stream(seed, ST.ROOF));
    L.foot = [];                                     // floor footprints taken on the margins
    frontBoxes(L, stream(seed, ST.FRONT));
    slots(L, stream(seed, ST.SLOTS));
    props(L, stream(seed, ST.PROPS));
    return L;
  }

  function stacks(L, r) {
    const SZ = CFG.boxes;
    const use = [0, 1, 2, 3];
    if (r.chance(50)) use.splice(use.indexOf([0, 2, 3][r.int(3)]), 1);   // 3 or 4 sizes; the medium box always stays
    L.sizes = use.slice();
    // 1 or 2 gaps showing the brick, away from the corner and the open ends
    const gaps = [], nGaps = r.range(CFG.stacks.gaps[0], CFG.stacks.gaps[1]);
    for (let k = 0; k < nGaps; k++) {
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 12; tries++) {
        const wall = r.int(2) ? 'L' : 'R', len = wall === 'L' ? L.RY : L.RX;
        const w = r.even(CFG.stacks.gapW[0], CFG.stacks.gapW[1]), lo = D + 16, hi = len - 16 - w;
        if (hi < lo) continue;
        const u0 = r.even(lo, hi);
        if (gaps.some((g) => g.wall === wall && u0 < g.u1 + 24 && g.u0 < u0 + w + 24)) continue;
        const rr = r.range(CFG.stacks.windowR[0], CFG.stacks.windowR[1]);
        const win = w >= 2 * rr + 6 && r.chance(CFG.stacks.windowChance) ? { u: u0 + (w >> 1), z: CFG.stacks.windowZ, r: rr } : null;
        gaps.push({ wall, u0, u1: u0 + w, window: win });
        break;
      }
    }
    L.gaps = gaps;
    L.boxes = []; L.columns = [];
    for (const wall of ['R', 'L']) {
      const len = wall === 'L' ? L.RY : L.RX, wg = gaps.filter((g) => g.wall === wall);
      let u = wall === 'R' ? 0 : D;                  // the corner square belongs to wall R
      for (;;) {
        const g = wg.filter((q) => q.u1 > u).sort((p, q) => p.u0 - q.u0)[0];
        if (g && u >= g.u0) { u = g.u1 + r.range(0, 2); continue; }
        const limit = g ? g.u0 : len;
        let s = use[r.int(use.length)];
        if (u / len < 0.5 && s === use[0]) s = use[r.int(use.length)];     // bigger boxes near the corner
        if (u + SZ[s].len > limit) { s = -1; for (let k = use.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) if (u + SZ[use[k]].len <= limit) { s = use[k]; break; } }
        if (s < 0) { if (!g) break; u = g.u1 + r.range(0, 2); continue; }   // skip the gap, or the wall is full
        column(L, r, wall, u, s, len);
        u += SZ[s].len + r.range(CFG.stacks.spacing[0], CFG.stacks.spacing[1]);
      }
    }
  }
  function column(L, r, wall, u, s, len) {
    const SZ = CFG.boxes, V = CFG.variants, use = L.sizes;
    const t = (u + SZ[s].len / 2) / len;
    const n = clamp(Math.floor(CFG.stacks.maxBoxes - 3 * t + r.int(100) / 100), CFG.stacks.minBoxes, CFG.stacks.maxBoxes);
    const hmax = CFG.stacks.profile[0] - CFG.stacks.profile[1] * t;      // past the minimum, no box tops out above this
    const col = { wall, u0: u, u1: u + SZ[s].len, boxes: [], top: -1, h: 0 };
    let z = 0, pu0 = u, pu1 = u + SZ[s].len, pv0 = 0, pv1 = SZ[s].dep, ps = s;
    for (let lvl = 0; lvl < n; lvl++) {
      let placed = null;
      const cands = lvl === 0 ? [s] : use.filter((k) => k <= ps).reverse();
      const first = lvl === 0 ? 0 : r.int(Math.min(2, cands.length));          // the same size, or one smaller
      for (let c = first; c < cands.length && !placed; c++) {
        const b = SZ[cands[c]];
        if (b.len > pu1 - pu0 || b.dep > D) continue;
        const need = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((z + b.h + 1 - WALL_H) / PITCH));   // keeps the box under the slopes
        let uk = pu0 + (pu1 - pu0 - b.len > 0 ? r.even(0, pu1 - pu0 - b.len) : 0);
        let vk = lvl === 0 ? r.int(Math.min(2, D - b.dep) + 1) : pv0 + r.int(Math.max(0, Math.min(2, pv1 - pv0 - b.dep)) + 1);
        if (vk < need) vk = need;
        if (wall === 'R' && uk < need) uk = need;
        if (uk + b.len > pu1 || vk + b.dep > D || (lvl > 0 && vk + b.dep > pv1 + 2)) continue;   // overhangs or leaves the band
        if (lvl >= CFG.stacks.minBoxes && z + b.h > hmax) continue;                                    // keeps the silhouette
        placed = { b, k: cands[c], uk, vk };
      }
      if (!placed) break;
      const { b, k, uk, vk } = placed;
      const bx = wallBox(wall, uk, uk + b.len, vk, vk + b.dep, z, z + b.h);
      const label = r.chance(V.label) ? [2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.len - 8)), 2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.h - 6))] : null;
      const box = { x0: bx[0], y0: bx[1], z0: bx[2], x1: bx[3], y1: bx[4], z1: bx[5], size: k, wall, col: L.columns.length, lvl,
        nudge: lvl > 0 && r.chance(V.nudge), flap: 0, string: r.chance(V.string) ? 1 + r.int(3) : 0,
        label, paw: !label && r.chance(V.paw) ? [2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.len - 8)), 2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.h - 6))] : null };
      col.boxes.push(L.boxes.length); L.boxes.push(box);
      z += b.h; pu0 = uk; pu1 = uk + b.len; pv0 = vk; pv1 = vk + b.dep; ps = k;
    }
    if (!col.boxes.length) return;
    const top = L.boxes[col.boxes[col.boxes.length - 1]];
    col.top = col.boxes[col.boxes.length - 1]; col.h = top.z1;
    const flapH = Math.ceil(CFG.boxes[top.size].dep / 2);
    if (r.chance(V.flap) && top.z1 + flapH + 1 <= ceilAt(top.x0, top.y0)) top.flap = 1 + r.int(4);   // which flap stands open
    L.columns.push(col);
  }

  // Rafters on both slopes, a hip rafter, and 1 or 2 cross beams the lamps hang from.
  function roof(L, r) {
    const sp = CFG.roof.rafterSpacing[r.int(CFG.roof.rafterSpacing.length)];
    const raf = (len) => { const out = []; for (let u = r.even(8, sp - 8); u < len - 4; u += sp) out.push(u); return out; };
    L.rafters = { L: raf(L.RY), R: raf(L.RX), w: CFG.roof.rafterW, spacing: sp };
    // lamps: over the back of the board, hung from beams high enough that nothing hides a tile
    const B = L.B, nl = r.range(CFG.lamps.count[0], CFG.lamps.count[1]), LC = CFG.lamps;
    L.beams = []; L.lamps = [];
    const firstAlongY = r.int(2) === 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < nl; k++) {
      const alongY = k === 0 ? firstAlongY : !firstAlongY;                      // the second lamp takes the other axis
      const at = (alongY ? B.x : B.y) + r.even(4, 24);
      const span = alongY ? [B.y + 8, B.y + B.h * T - 8] : [B.x + 8, B.x + B.w * T - 8];
      let pos = -1;
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 8 && pos < 0; tries++) {
        const p = r.even(span[0], span[1]);
        if (L.lamps.every((l) => Math.abs((alongY ? l.y : l.x) - p) + Math.abs((alongY ? l.x : l.y) - at) >= 48)) pos = p;
      }
      if (pos < 0) continue;
      const x = alongY ? at : pos, y = alongY ? pos : at;
      let z0 = LC.z;
      while (z0 <= LC.maxZ && hidesTile(B, [x - LC.r, y - LC.r, z0, x + LC.r, y + LC.r, z0 + LC.h])) z0 += 2;
      if (z0 > LC.maxZ) continue;
      L.beams.push({ alongY, at, z: ROOF_TOP, from: RUN, to: alongY ? L.RY : L.RX });
      L.lamps.push({ x, y, z0, z1: z0 + LC.h, r: LC.r, beam: L.beams.length - 1, pool: LC.pool });
    }
    // string lights along the top edges of the roof band and under each beam (shown on Sundays, at night, in December)
    const st = CFG.string, bulbs = [];
    const run = (x0, y0, x1, y1, z) => {
      const len = Math.abs(x1 - x0) + Math.abs(y1 - y0);
      for (let d = 0, i = 0; d <= len; d += st.step, i++) {
        const f = (d % 24) / 24, sag = Math.round(st.sag * 4 * f * (1 - f));
        bulbs.push([x0 + Math.sign(x1 - x0) * d, y0 + Math.sign(y1 - y0) * d, z - sag, (bulbs.length) % st.colours]);
      }
    };
    run(RUN, RUN + 4, RUN, L.RY - 4, ROOF_TOP - 3);
    run(RUN + 4, RUN, L.RX - 4, RUN, ROOF_TOP - 3);
    for (const b of L.beams) if (b.alongY) run(b.at, RUN + 4, b.at, L.RY - 4, b.z - 3); else run(RUN + 4, b.at, L.RX - 4, b.at, b.z - 3);
    L.bulbs = bulbs;
    const bu = CFG.bunting, flags = [];
    for (let y = RUN + 4; y <= L.RY - 4; y += bu.step) flags.push([RUN, y, ROOF_TOP - 6, flags.length % bu.colours]);
    for (let x = RUN + 4; x <= L.RX - 4; x += bu.step) flags.push([x, RUN, ROOF_TOP - 6, flags.length % bu.colours]);
    L.flags = flags;
  }

  // ---- the floor margins ----------------------------------------------------------------
  // Try to put a footprint w x d (x by y) of height h somewhere on the margins. against: touch a stack.
  function placeFoot(L, r, w, d, h, against, tries) {
    const B = L.B;
    for (let n = 0; n < tries; n++) {
      const swap = r.int(2) === 1, fw = swap ? d : w, fd = swap ? w : d;
      let x0 = r.even(D, L.RX - fw), y0 = r.even(D, L.RY - fd);
      if (against) {                                  // snap to the front of the left or right stacks
        if (r.int(2)) x0 = D; else y0 = D;
        const wall = x0 === D ? 'L' : 'R', u0 = wall === 'L' ? y0 : x0, u1 = u0 + (wall === 'L' ? fd : fw);
        if (!L.columns.some((c) => c.wall === wall && Math.min(c.u1, u1) - Math.max(c.u0, u0) >= (u1 - u0) / 2)) continue;
      }
      const bx = [x0, y0, 0, x0 + fw, y0 + fd, h];
      if (bx[3] > L.RX || bx[4] > L.RY) continue;
      if (overlap2(bx, L.boardBox, 2)) continue;
      if (L.foot.some((f) => overlap2(bx, f, 1))) continue;
      if (hidesTile(B, bx)) continue;
      return bx;
    }
    return null;
  }
  // Facing: towards the board's centre, along the longer axis to it.
  function facing(L, bx) {
    const cx = L.B.x + L.B.w * T / 2 - (bx[0] + bx[3]) / 2, cy = L.B.y + L.B.h * T / 2 - (bx[1] + bx[4]) / 2;
    return Math.abs(cx) >= Math.abs(cy) ? (cx >= 0 ? 'R' : 'L') : (cy >= 0 ? 'D' : 'U');
  }
  function frontBoxes(L, r) {                        // loose boxes on the margins in front of the board: 1 high
    const B = L.B, n = r.range(CFG.frontBoxes[0], CFG.frontBoxes[1]);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const s = r.int(2), b = CFG.boxes[s];          // small or medium
      const swap = r.int(2) === 1, fw = swap ? b.dep : b.len, fd = swap ? b.len : b.dep;
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 16; tries++) {
        const right = r.int(2) === 1;                 // the front-right margin (beyond x1) or the front-left (beyond y1)
        const x0 = right ? r.even(B.x + B.w * T + 2, L.RX - fw) : r.even(D, L.RX - fw);
        const y0 = right ? r.even(D, L.RY - fd) : r.even(B.y + B.h * T + 2, L.RY - fd);
        const bx = [x0, y0, 0, x0 + fw, y0 + fd, b.h];
        if (bx[3] > L.RX || bx[4] > L.RY || x0 < D || y0 < D) continue;
        if (overlap2(bx, L.boardBox, 2) || L.foot.some((f) => overlap2(bx, f, 1)) || hidesTile(B, bx)) continue;
        L.foot.push(bx);
        L.boxes.push({ x0, y0, z0: 0, x1: bx[3], y1: bx[4], z1: b.h, size: s, wall: 'F', col: -1, lvl: 0, nudge: false,
          flap: r.chance(CFG.variants.flap) ? 2 : 0,      // only the flap that hangs down the front: a standing one would add height
          string: r.chance(CFG.variants.string) ? 1 + r.int(3) : 0,
          label: r.chance(CFG.variants.label) ? [2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.len - 8)), 2 + r.int(Math.max(1, b.h - 6))] : null, paw: null });
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  // Fixed places for the seasonal dressing, so a season never moves anything else.
  function slots(L, r) {
    const S = CFG.slots, out = {};
    for (const name of ['floorTall', 'floorLow', 'bucket']) {
      const [w, d, h] = S[name].size, bx = placeFoot(L, r, w, d, h, !!S[name].againstStack, 160);
      out[name] = bx ? { x0: bx[0], y0: bx[1], z0: 0, x1: bx[3], y1: bx[4], z1: bx[5] } : null;
      if (bx) L.foot.push(bx);
    }
    // column tops: two for small things, a few for blankets, the rest are napping spots
    const tops = L.columns.map((c, i) => i).filter((i) => !L.boxes[L.columns[i].top].flap);
    r.shuffle(tops);
    const [sw, sd, sh] = S.stackTop.size, N = CFG.naps;
    // a w x d footprint (along the wall x out from it) on a column top: centred along the wall, at the front edge,
    // where the roof is highest (and where cats like to lie)
    const onTop = (c, w, d, h) => {
      const b = L.boxes[c.top], cu = c.wall === 'L' ? (b.y0 + b.y1) >> 1 : (b.x0 + b.x1) >> 1, v1 = (c.wall === 'L' ? b.x1 : b.y1) - 1;
      const bx = wallBox(c.wall, cu - (w >> 1), cu - (w >> 1) + w, v1 - d, v1, b.z1, b.z1 + h);
      return { x0: bx[0], y0: bx[1], z0: bx[2], x1: bx[3], y1: bx[4], z1: bx[5], wall: c.wall, top: c.top };
    };
    const topFits = (c, w, d, h) => {
      const b = L.boxes[c.top], len = c.wall === 'L' ? b.y1 - b.y0 : b.x1 - b.x0, dep = c.wall === 'L' ? b.x1 - b.x0 : b.y1 - b.y0;
      if (len < w || dep < d + 1) return false;
      const f = onTop(c, w, d, h);
      return f.z1 + 1 <= ceilAt(f.x0, f.y0);
    };
    out.stackTop = [];
    L.napSpots = [];
    for (const i of tops) {
      const c = L.columns[i];
      if (out.stackTop.length < S.stackTop.count && topFits(c, sw, sd, sh)) { out.stackTop.push(onTop(c, sw, sd, sh)); continue; }
      if (topFits(c, N.len, N.dep, N.h)) {
        const s = onTop(c, N.len, N.dep, N.h);
        L.napSpots.push({ x: (s.x0 + s.x1) >> 1, y: (s.y0 + s.y1) >> 1, z: s.z0, wall: c.wall, top: c.top,
          dir: c.wall === 'L' ? (r.int(2) ? 'D' : 'U') : (r.int(2) ? 'R' : 'L') });
      }
    }
    const nb = r.range(S.blankets[0], S.blankets[1]);
    out.blankets = r.shuffle(L.columns.map((c) => c.top)).slice(0, nb).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    L.slots = out;
  }
  function props(L, r) {
    const kinds = r.shuffle(Object.keys(CFG.props).sort());
    const want = r.range(CFG.propCount[0], CFG.propCount[1]);
    L.props = [];
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {             // a second, more thorough pass if fewer than the minimum fit
      for (const kind of kinds) {
        if (L.props.length >= (pass === 0 ? want : CFG.propCount[0])) break;
        if (L.props.some((p) => p.kind === kind)) continue;
        const [w, d, h] = CFG.props[kind].size, bx = placeFoot(L, r, w, d, h, !!CFG.props[kind].againstStack, pass === 0 ? 40 : 400);
        if (!bx) continue;
        L.foot.push(bx);
        L.props.push({ kind, x0: bx[0], y0: bx[1], z0: 0, x1: bx[3], y1: bx[4], z1: bx[5], dir: facing(L, bx) });
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- dressing: the date only, into the fixed slots ----------------------------------------
  function dressing(L, date) {
    const season = seasonOf(date), S = CFG.seasons[season], rain = isRainy(date), items = [];
    const put = (kind, slot) => {
      if (!slot) return;
      const [w, d, h] = CFG.items[kind].size, sw = slot.x1 - slot.x0, sd = slot.y1 - slot.y0;
      const swap = (sw >= sd) !== (w >= d), iw = swap ? d : w, id = swap ? w : d;     // lie the long way along the slot
      const x0 = slot.x0 + ((sw - iw) >> 1), y0 = slot.y0 + ((sd - id) >> 1);
      items.push({ kind, x0, y0, z0: slot.z0, x1: x0 + iw, y1: y0 + id, z1: slot.z0 + h });
    };
    if (S.floorTall) put(S.floorTall, L.slots.floorTall);
    if (S.floorLow) put(S.floorLow, L.slots.floorLow);
    if (S.stackTop) S.stackTop.forEach((k, i) => put(k, L.slots.stackTop[i]));
    if (rain) put('bucket', L.slots.bucket);
    return { season, rain, items, skylights: rain ? 'rain' : S.skylights || null, openSkylight: !!S.openSkylight,
      blankets: S.blankets ? L.slots.blankets.slice() : [], bunting: !!S.bunting, string: !!S.string };
  }

  // ---- light: the weekday (or night), the skylights and their patches ------------------------
  function occluders(L, dress) {
    const occ = [];
    for (const b of L.boxes) if (b.wall === 'F') occ.push([b.x0, b.y0, b.z0, b.x1, b.y1, b.z1]);
    for (const p of L.props) occ.push([p.x0, p.y0, p.z0, p.x1, p.y1, p.z1]);
    for (const it of dress.items) if (it.z0 === 0) occ.push([it.x0, it.y0, it.z0, it.x1, it.y1, it.z1]);
    for (const l of L.lamps) if (l.z0 < VZ) occ.push([l.x - l.r, l.y - l.r, l.z0, l.x + l.r, l.y + l.r, l.z1]);
    return occ;
  }
  function bays(L, wall) {                          // the gaps between rafters where the roof band is full height
    const R = L.rafters[wall], len = wall === 'L' ? L.RY : L.RX, out = [];
    const starts = R.concat([len]);
    for (let k = 0; k < starts.length; k++) {
      const u0 = (k === 0 ? 0 : R[k - 1] + L.rafters.w) + 3, u1 = starts[k] - 3;
      if (u0 >= RUN + 2 && u1 - u0 >= 16) out.push({ wall, u0, u1 });
    }
    return out;
  }
  function lighting(L, dress, seed, set) {
    const S = CFG.lights[set], a = S.a / LIGHT_DEN, b = S.b / LIGHT_DEN, B = L.B, SK = CFG.skylights;
    const area = B.w * B.h;
    let n = 3; for (const [lim, k] of SK.byArea) if (area <= lim) { n = k; break; }   // more only if the light falls short
    const free = { L: bays(L, 'L'), R: bays(L, 'R') };
    const takeBay = (wall, u) => {                     // the free bay nearest u on the wall, else on the other wall
      for (const w of [wall, wall === 'L' ? 'R' : 'L']) {
