        const list = free[w]; if (!list.length) continue;
        let best = 0;
        for (let i = 1; i < list.length; i++) if (Math.abs((list[i].u0 + list[i].u1) / 2 - u) < Math.abs((list[best].u0 + list[best].u1) / 2 - u)) best = i;
        return list.splice(best, 1)[0];
      }
      return null;
    };
    const sky = (bay, vc, panes) => {
      const v0 = clamp(2 * Math.round(vc / 2) - 12, 4, RUN - 20), v1 = Math.min(RUN - 4, v0 + 24);   // even, so z is whole
      return { wall: bay.wall, u0: bay.u0, u1: bay.u1, v0, v1, z0: WALL_H + v0 * PITCH, z1: WALL_H + v1 * PITCH, panes, open: false, patch: -1 };
    };
    const r = stream(seed, ST.LIGHT + SETS.indexOf(set));
    const skylights = [], patches = [];
    if (!S.sun) {                                     // night: the skylights show the sky, no patches
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const wall = r.int(2) ? 'L' : 'R', bay = takeBay(wall, r.int(wall === 'L' ? L.RY : L.RX));
        if (bay) skylights.push(sky(bay, r.range(14, RUN - 14), [bay.u1 - bay.u0 >= 24 ? 2 : 1, 2]));
      }
      return { set, a: S.a, b: S.b, sun: false, skylights, patches, sunlit: 0 };
    }
    const occ = occluders(L, dress), boardPoly = rectPoly(B.x, B.y, B.x + B.w * T, B.y + B.h * T);
    const floorPoly = rectPoly(D, D, L.RX, L.RY), need = SK.coverTarget / 100 * area * T * T;
    const shadows = [];                               // the shadows on the board, for scoring places
    for (const o of occ) { const h = shadowOf(o, a, b); if (h) { const c = clipConvex(h, boardPoly); if (c.length >= 3) shadows.push(c); } }
    let best = null;
    for (let round = 0, scale = 1; round < 24; round++, scale *= 1.15) {
      if (round % 8 === 0 && round) { if (n === 3) break; n++; scale = 1; }   // falling short: one more skylight
      const ps = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const wall = r.int(Math.round((a + b) * 16)) < Math.round(a * 16) ? 'L' : 'R';   // mostly through the slope the light crosses
        const la = wall === 'L' ? a : b, lb = wall === 'L' ? b : a;
        const stretch = 1 + PITCH * la, shear = lb * PITCH / stretch;
        const aspect = clamp(0.8 * stretch / (1 + 0.25 * PITCH), 0.7, 2.2) * (0.85 + r.int(31) / 100);
        const want = need / n * scale;
        const along = wall === 'L' ? B.h * T : B.w * T, across = wall === 'L' ? B.w * T : B.h * T;
        const Wd = Math.min(along, Math.max(16, Math.round(Math.sqrt(want / aspect))));
        const Hd = Math.min(across, Math.max(16, Math.round(want / Wd)));
        const e1 = wall === 'L' ? [0, Wd] : [Wd, 0];
        const e2 = wall === 'L' ? [Hd, Math.round(Hd * shear)] : [Math.round(Hd * shear), Hd];
        const panes = [Wd >= 40 ? 2 : 1, Hd >= 40 ? 2 : 1];
        let pick = null, pickScore = -Infinity;
        for (let c = 0; c < 24; c++) {
          const cx = r.range(B.x, B.x + B.w * T), cy = r.range(B.y, B.y + B.h * T);
          const p = { x: Math.round(cx - (e1[0] + e2[0]) / 2), y: Math.round(cy - (e1[1] + e2[1]) / 2), e1, e2, panes, wall };
          if (onGrid(B, p)) continue;
          const poly = patchPoly(p), on = clipConvex(poly, boardPoly);
          let score = polyArea(on) - 0.5 * (polyArea(poly) - polyArea(clipConvex(poly, floorPoly)));
          if (on.length >= 3) for (const sh of shadows) score -= polyArea(clipConvex(sh, on));
          for (const q of ps) score -= 1.5 * polyArea(clipConvex(poly, patchPoly(q)));
          if (score > pickScore) { pickScore = score; pick = p; }
        }
        if (pick && pickScore > 0) ps.push(pick);
      }
      const f = sunlitWith(B, ps, occ, a, b, 1);
      if (!best || f > best.f) best = { ps, f };
      if (f * 100 >= SK.minSunlit) break;
    }
    for (const p of best.ps) {                        // the drawn skylight: upstream of the patch's centre, in the roof band
      const cx = p.x + (p.e1[0] + p.e2[0]) / 2, cy = p.y + (p.e1[1] + p.e2[1]) / 2;
      const la = p.wall === 'L' ? a : b, c0 = p.wall === 'L' ? cx : cy;
      const t = (WALL_H + PITCH * c0) / (1 + PITCH * la);
      const v = p.wall === 'L' ? cx - a * t : cy - b * t, u = p.wall === 'L' ? cy - b * t : cx - a * t;
      const bay = takeBay(p.wall, u);
      const out = { x: p.x, y: p.y, e1: p.e1.slice(), e2: p.e2.slice(), panes: p.panes.slice(), sky: -1 };
      if (bay) { const s = sky(bay, v, p.panes.slice()); s.patch = patches.length; out.sky = skylights.length; skylights.push(s); }
      patches.push(out);
    }
    return { set, a: S.a, b: S.b, sun: true, skylights, patches, sunlit: Math.round(sunlitWith(B, best.ps, occ, a, b) * 1000) };   // the 0.5 wu measure
  }

  // ---- the collection, napping on the stacks ---------------------------------------------------
  function napping(L, seed, collection) {
    const r = stream(seed, ST.NAPS), cats = r.shuffle(collection.slice()), N = CFG.naps;
    const n = Math.min(N.max, cats.length, L.napSpots.length), out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const s = L.napSpots[i];
      const b = L.boxes[s.top], len = s.wall === 'L' ? b.y1 - b.y0 : b.x1 - b.x0;
      const pose = r.int(len >= N.flatLen ? N.poses : N.poses - 1);   // 0 curled, 1 a loaf, 2 stretched out (long tops only)
      out.push({ x: s.x, y: s.y, z: s.z, wall: s.wall, dir: s.dir, top: s.top, cat: cats[i], pose, phase: r.int(N.loopFrames) });
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---- the room ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  function build(seed, boardW, boardH, date, mode, collection) {
    const CB = CFG.board;
    if (!Number.isInteger(boardW) || !Number.isInteger(boardH) || boardW < CB.minW || boardW > CB.maxW || boardH < CB.minH || boardH > CB.maxH)
      throw new RangeError('board must be ' + CB.minW + '-' + CB.maxW + ' x ' + CB.minH + '-' + CB.maxH + ': ' + boardW + ' x ' + boardH);
    if (Number.isNaN(DY.dayNumber(date))) throw new RangeError('date must be YYYY-MM-DD: ' + date);
    seed = seed >>> 0;
    const set = lightSetOf(date, mode);
    const L = layout(seed, boardW, boardH), dress = dressing(L, date), light = lighting(L, dress, seed, set);
    if (dress.openSkylight && light.skylights.length) light.skylights[0].open = true;
    const naps = napping(L, seed, collection || []), S = CFG.lights[set];
    for (const it of dress.items) if (it.kind === 'sleepingCat') {       // the summer cat stretched out flat: one of the collection too
      const col = collection || [], spare = col.length > naps.length ? stream(seed, ST.NAPS + 1).int(col.length - naps.length) : -1;
      const left = col.slice(); for (const n of naps) left.splice(left.indexOf(n.cat), 1);
      it.cat = spare >= 0 ? left[spare] : col.length ? col[0] : null;
    }
    const room = {
      version: 1,
      inputs: { seed, w: boardW, h: boardH, date, mode },
      season: dress.season, rain: dress.rain,
      light: { set, a: light.a, b: light.b, den: LIGHT_DEN, sun: light.sun, virtualZ: VZ, sunlit: light.sunlit,
        lamps: Math.min(S.lamps || 0, L.lamps.length), string: !!S.string || dress.string },
      room: { w: L.RX, d: L.RY, wallH: WALL_H, stackD: D, roofRun: RUN, roofTop: ROOF_TOP, pitch: [CFG.roof.pitchNum, CFG.roof.pitchDen] },
      board: { x: L.B.x, y: L.B.y, w: boardW, h: boardH },
      margins: L.margins,
      sizes: L.sizes,
      boxes: L.boxes,
      columns: L.columns.map((c) => ({ wall: c.wall, u0: c.u0, u1: c.u1, boxes: c.boxes, top: c.top, h: c.h })),
      gaps: L.gaps,
      rafters: L.rafters,
      beams: L.beams.map((b) => ({ axis: b.alongY ? 'y' : 'x', at: b.at, z: b.z, from: b.from, to: b.to })),
      lamps: L.lamps,
      skylights: light.skylights, patches: light.patches,
      props: L.props,
      slots: L.slots,
      items: dress.items,
      dressing: { skylights: dress.skylights, openSkylight: dress.openSkylight, blankets: dress.blankets, bunting: dress.bunting },
      bulbs: L.bulbs, flags: L.flags,
      naps,
    };
    room.bounds = bounds(room);
    return room;
  }

  // Everything solid in the room, as boxes [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1, what].
  function solids(room) {
    const out = [], P = room.room;
    const add = (o, what) => out.push([o.x0, o.y0, o.z0, o.x1, o.y1, o.z1, what]);
    room.boxes.forEach((b, i) => {
      add(b, 'box ' + i + (b.wall === 'F' ? ' (front)' : ''));
      if (b.flap && b.flap !== 2) {                   // a standing flap rises half the box's depth above its top
        const dep = b.wall === 'L' ? b.x1 - b.x0 : b.y1 - b.y0;
        out.push([b.x0, b.y0, b.z1, b.x1, b.y1, b.z1 + Math.ceil(dep / 2), 'flap of box ' + i]);
      }
    });
    room.props.forEach((p) => add(p, p.kind));
    room.items.forEach((it) => add(it, it.kind));
    for (const l of room.lamps) {
      out.push([l.x - l.r, l.y - l.r, l.z0, l.x + l.r, l.y + l.r, l.z1, 'lamp']);
      out.push([l.x, l.y, l.z1, l.x + 1, l.y + 1, room.room.roofTop, 'lamp cord']);
    }
    for (const b of room.beams) out.push(b.axis === 'y' ? [b.at - 2, b.from, b.z - 2, b.at + 2, b.to, b.z + 2, 'beam'] : [b.from, b.at - 2, b.z - 2, b.to, b.at + 2, b.z + 2, 'beam']);
    for (const u of room.rafters.L) out.push([0, u, P.wallH, Math.min(P.roofRun, u + 3), u + room.rafters.w, P.roofTop, 'rafter L']);
    for (const u of room.rafters.R) out.push([u, 0, P.wallH, u + room.rafters.w, Math.min(P.roofRun, u + 3), P.roofTop, 'rafter R']);
    for (const s of room.skylights) out.push(s.wall === 'L' ? [s.v0, s.u0, s.z0, s.v1, s.u1, s.z1, 'skylight'] : [s.u0, s.v0, s.z0, s.u1, s.v1, s.z1, 'skylight']);
    for (const c of room.naps) {
      const along = CFG.naps.len >> 1, out2 = CFG.naps.dep >> 1;
      out.push(c.wall === 'L' ? [c.x - out2, c.y - along, c.z, c.x + out2, c.y + along, c.z + CFG.naps.h, 'napping cat'] : [c.x - along, c.y - out2, c.z, c.x + along, c.y + out2, c.z + CFG.naps.h, 'napping cat']);
    }
    for (const b of room.bulbs) out.push([b[0], b[1], b[2] - 1, b[0] + 1, b[1] + 1, b[2] + 1, 'string light']);
    for (const f of room.flags) out.push([f[0], f[1], f[2] - 4, f[0] + 4, f[1] + 4, f[2], 'bunting']);
    return out;
  }
  // Every board tile something hides: [{ what, tile: [i, j] }]. Empty is the rule.
  function hidden(room) {
    const out = [];
    for (const s of solids(room)) { const t = hidesTile(room.board, s); if (t) out.push({ what: s[6], tile: t }); }
    return out;
  }
  // Pixel bounds of the room and its base relative to the projection of world (0, 0, 0).
  function bounds(room) {
    let sx0 = Infinity, sx1 = -Infinity, sy0 = Infinity, sy1 = -Infinity;
    const pt = (x, y, z) => { const sx = x - y, sy = (x + y) / 2 - z; if (sx < sx0) sx0 = sx; if (sx > sx1) sx1 = sx; if (sy < sy0) sy0 = sy; if (sy > sy1) sy1 = sy; };
    const pad = 8, baseH = 16;
    for (const [x, y] of [[-pad, -pad], [room.room.w + pad, -pad], [-pad, room.room.d + pad], [room.room.w + pad, room.room.d + pad]]) { pt(x, y, 0); pt(x, y, -baseH); }
    pt(0, 0, room.room.roofTop);
    for (const s of solids(room)) for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) pt(k & 1 ? s[3] : s[0], k & 2 ? s[4] : s[1], k & 4 ? s[5] : s[2]);
    return { sx0: Math.floor(sx0), sx1: Math.ceil(sx1), sy0: Math.floor(sy0), sy1: Math.ceil(sy1) };
  }
  function occludersOf(room) {
    const occ = [];
    for (const b of room.boxes) if (b.wall === 'F') occ.push([b.x0, b.y0, b.z0, b.x1, b.y1, b.z1]);
    for (const p of room.props) occ.push([p.x0, p.y0, p.z0, p.x1, p.y1, p.z1]);
    for (const it of room.items) if (it.z0 === 0) occ.push([it.x0, it.y0, it.z0, it.x1, it.y1, it.z1]);
    for (const l of room.lamps) if (l.z0 < VZ) occ.push([l.x - l.r, l.y - l.r, l.z0, l.x + l.r, l.y + l.r, l.z1]);
    return occ;
  }
  // Fraction of the board in sunlight (0 at night): scanlines every dy wu (default 0.5).
  function sunlit(room, dy) {
    const L = room.light;
    return L.sun ? sunlitWith(room.board, room.patches, occludersOf(room), L.a / L.den, L.b / L.den, dy) : 0;
  }
  // Is the floor point (x, y) sunlit, shadows included? A plain point test, for cross-checking sunlit().
  function litAt(room, x, y) {
    const L = room.light; if (!L.sun) return false;
    if (!room.patches.some((p) => inPatch(p, x, y))) return false;
    return !shaded(occludersOf(room), x, y, L.a / L.den, L.b / L.den);
  }
  // Is the point (x, y, z) in a sunlight patch (ignoring shadows)? Used for dust and for lighting tops.
  function inLight(room, x, y, z) {
    const L = room.light; if (!L.sun) return false;
    const fx = x + z * L.a / L.den, fy = y + z * L.b / L.den;
    for (const p of room.patches) if (inPatch(p, fx, fy)) return true;
    return false;
  }
  function onGridLines(room) { const out = []; room.patches.forEach((p, i) => { const L = onGrid(room.board, p); if (L) out.push({ patch: i, line: L }); }); return out; }

  // Canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) and its FNV-1a digest: the same bytes in Swift.
  function canonical(v) {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return '[' + v.map(canonical).join(',') + ']';
    if (v && typeof v === 'object') return '{' + Object.keys(v).sort().map((k) => JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + canonical(v[k])).join(',') + '}';
    return JSON.stringify(v);
  }
  function digest(room) {
    const s = canonical(room);
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193); }
    return (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
  }
  // Seed for a daily date: the same attic for everyone that day.
  const seedForDate = (date) => fmix(Math.imul(DY.dayNumber(date), 0x9E3779B1) >>> 0);

  return { build, hidden, sunlit, litAt, inLight, onGridLines, solids, canonical, digest, rng, seedForDate, seasonOf, lightSetOf, isRainy,
    SETS, SEASONS, CFG, ceilAt };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = BOXROOM;
// ============================================================================
// 19 BACKDROP: a repeatable skyline strip as plain data. Independent mulberry32 streams per named layer;
// geometry takes no light or date. Swift: UInt32 wrapping arithmetic, the same JSON profile and records.
// A layer has buildings [{x,w,top,eaves,roof,chimney,windows}], with local integer strip coordinates.
// ============================================================================
const BACKDROP = (function () {
  const CFG = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports ? require('../data/backdrops.json') : BACKDROP_DATA;
  function stream(seed, name) {
    let s = seed >>> 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) s = Math.imul(s ^ name.charCodeAt(i), 16777619) >>> 0;
    return () => {
      s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), s | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function build(seed, profile) {
    const p = profile || CFG.town;
    if (p.treatment !== 'cutaway' && p.treatment !== 'floating') throw new Error('bad backdrop treatment');
    if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff) throw new Error('backdrop seed must be UInt32');
    if (!Number.isInteger(p.width) || p.width < 64 || p.width > 4096) throw new Error('backdrop strip width must be 64..4096');
    if (!Array.isArray(p.layers) || p.layers.length > 4) throw new Error('backdrop needs 0..4 layers');
    const ids = new Set();
    const layers = p.layers.map(l => {
      if (!l.id || ids.has(l.id)) throw new Error('backdrop layers need distinct ids');
      ids.add(l.id);
      if(l.shapes) {
        validateShapes(l.shapes,l.colours);
        if(!Number.isFinite(l.parallax) || l.parallax<0 || l.parallax>1 || !Number.isInteger(l.offset) || !Number.isInteger(l.scroll) || !Number.isInteger(l.level) || l.level<0 || l.level>4)throw new Error('bad shape layer');
        for(const m of l.motions || []) {
          if(!['mist','train'].includes(m.kind) || ![m.w,m.h,m.y].every(Number.isInteger) || m.w<=0 || m.h<=0 || m.w>4096 || m.h>4096)throw new Error('bad backdrop motion');
          if(m.kind==='mist') {
            if(!Number.isInteger(m.period) || m.period<=0 || 2880%m.period)throw new Error('mist period must divide the loop');
            if(!Number.isInteger(m.phase) || !Number.isInteger(m.density) || m.density<0 || m.density>8 || !l.colours[m.colour])throw new Error('bad mist band');
          } else {
            if(![m.fromFrame,m.toFrame,m.fromX,m.toX].every(Number.isInteger) || !(m.fromFrame>=0 && m.toFrame>m.fromFrame && m.toFrame<=2880))throw new Error('bad train interval');
            validateShapes(m.shapes,l.colours);
          }
        }
        return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(l));
      }
      for (const range of [l.width, l.height]) if (!Array.isArray(range) || range.length !== 2 || !range.every(Number.isInteger) || range[0] < 1 || range[1] < range[0] || range[1] > 256) throw new Error('bad backdrop range');
      if (!l.roofs.length || l.roofs.some(r => r !== 'hip' && r !== 'gable')) throw new Error('bad backdrop roof');
      const rand = stream(seed, l.id), int = (lo, hi) => lo + Math.floor(rand() * (hi - lo + 1));
      const buildings = [];
      for (let x = 0; x < p.width;) {
        const w = Math.min(int(...l.width), p.width - x), top = -int(...l.height), rise = Math.max(3, Math.floor(w / 4));
        const roof = l.roofs[int(0, l.roofs.length - 1)], chimney = rand() < l.chimneys ? { x: Math.min(w - 3, int(3, Math.max(3, w - 7))), h: int(4, 8) } : null;
        const windows = [];
        // The same finite pattern repeats below the visible skyline; each position has a stable lit choice.
        for (let row = 0; row < 8; row++) for (let u = 5; u + 3 < w - 3; u += 9) {
          const on = rand(), lit = rand();
          if (on < l.windows) windows.push({ x: u, y: row * 16 + 10, lit: lit < l.litWindows });
        }
        buildings.push({ x, w, top, eaves: top + rise + 3, roof, chimney, windows });
        x += w;
      }
      return { ...l, buildings };
    });
    const result={ seed, treatment: p.treatment, width: p.width, horizon: p.horizon, sky: p.sky, clear: p.clear, snow: !!p.snow, cutaway: p.cutaway, layers };
    if(p.id)result.id=p.id;
    if(p.openings)result.openings=true;
    return result;
  }
  function validateShapes(shapes,colours) {
    if(!Array.isArray(shapes))throw new Error('bad backdrop shapes');
    for(const s of shapes) {
      if(!['rect','polygon','line','cobbles'].includes(s.kind) || typeof s.colour!=='string' || !colours || !colours[s.colour])throw new Error('bad backdrop shape');
      if(s.kind==='polygon' || s.kind==='line') {
        if(!Array.isArray(s.points) || s.points.length<(s.kind==='polygon'?3:2) || s.points.some(p=>!Array.isArray(p) || p.length!==2 || p.some(n=>!Number.isInteger(n)||Math.abs(n)>4096)))throw new Error('bad backdrop shape points');
      } else if(s.points || ![s.x,s.y,s.w,s.h].every(Number.isInteger) || Math.abs(s.x)>4096 || Math.abs(s.y)>4096 || s.w<=0 || s.h<=0 || s.w>4096 || s.h>4096)throw new Error('bad backdrop shape bounds');
      if(s.kind==='cobbles' && (!Array.isArray(s.tile) || s.tile.length!==2 || s.tile.some(n=>!Number.isInteger(n) || n<2 || n>64) || !colours[s.joint] || !colours[s.fleck]))throw new Error('bad cobble shape');
    }
  }
  // Integer loop-frame evaluation into reusable storage: x,y,visible,dither phase.
  function motionAt(m,frame,out) {
    const f=((Math.floor(frame)%2880)+2880)%2880;
    if(m.kind==='train') {
      out[0]=Math.floor(m.fromX+(m.toX-m.fromX)*(f-m.fromFrame)/(m.toFrame-m.fromFrame));out[1]=m.y;
      out[2]=f>=m.fromFrame && f<m.toFrame?1:0;out[3]=0;
    } else {
      out[0]=Math.floor((f%m.period)*m.w/m.period+(m.phase||0));out[1]=m.y;out[2]=1;out[3]=Math.floor(f/6)%16;
    }
    return out;
  }
  return { CFG, build, motionAt };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = BACKDROP;
// ============================================================================
// 19 PUZZLE GENERATOR: shared daily/Practice construction and solver checks.
// The same seed, weekday and daily settings produce the same Practice level.
// Node uses this for the daily generator; the self-contained page runs it in a
// worker for on-demand Practice puzzles.
// ============================================================================
const PUZZLEGEN = (function () {
  const isNode = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const R = isNode ? require('./10_rules.js') : {
    grCreate, grRun, grTick, GR_DX, GR_DY, GR_DIRS, GR_DIR, GL_WAIT, GE_MOVED, GO_RUNNING, GO_WON,
  };
  const S = isNode ? require('./11_solver.js') : SOLVER;
  const P = isNode ? require('./10a_piece_permissions.js') : PIECE_PERMISSIONS;
  const CAL = isNode ? require('./17_daily.js') : DAILY;
  const DX = R.GR_DX, DY = R.GR_DY, DIRS = R.GR_DIRS;
const targetsFor = (s, wd) => s.weekdays[CAL.WEEKDAYS[wd]];
function rng(seed) { let x = seed >>> 0; return () => { x = (Math.imul(x, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return x / 4294967296; }; }
const between = (rnd, [lo, hi]) => lo + Math.floor(rnd() * (hi - lo + 1));

// ---- one puzzle --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Board size: from minBoard on Mondays to maxBoard on Sundays, each side rounded up or down at random so
// the weekday's average is right ("about 5 x 4 on Mondays").
function boardFor(s, wd, rnd) {
  const t = wd / 6, f = (lo, hi) => { const v = lo + (hi - lo) * t, b = Math.floor(v); return b + (rnd() < v - b ? 1 : 0); };
  return { w: f(s.minBoard.w, s.maxBoard.w), h: f(s.minBoard.h, s.maxBoard.h) };
}
const UNDEC = 0, FLOOR = 1, DOG = 2, BASKET = 3, TURN = 4, HATCH = 5;
function construct(s, wd, rnd) {
  const permissions = P.read(s);
  const T = targetsFor(s, wd), { w: W, h: H } = boardFor(s, wd, rnd), N = W * H;
  const nCats = between(rnd, T.cats), nTurn = between(rnd, T.turntables), dogMax = T.dogs[1], bounceAim = T.bounces[0];
  const nHatch = nCats >= 4 ? (rnd() < 0.8 ? 2 : 1) : nCats === 3 ? (rnd() < 0.4 ? 2 : 1) : 1;
  const kind = new Uint8Array(N), info = new Array(N).fill(null), at = (x, y) => y * W + x, inside = (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < W && y < H;
  // Coats: cats from one hatch tend to share a coat (settings.sameCoat), so they share a route and leave more
  // of the board untouched for the dogs that rule other solutions out.
  const coats = [], hatchCoat = [0, 1].map(() => (rnd() < 0.5 ? 'ginger' : 'blue'));
  for (let k = 0; k < nCats; k++) coats.push(rnd() < (s.sameCoat || 0) ? hatchCoat[k % nHatch] : rnd() < 0.5 ? 'ginger' : 'blue');
  if (nCats >= 3 && coats.every((c) => c === coats[0])) coats[1] = coats[0] === 'ginger' ? 'blue' : 'ginger';
  const hatches = [];
  for (let h = 0; h < nHatch; h++) {
    let ok = false;
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 40 && !ok; tries++) {
      const x = Math.floor(rnd() * W), y = Math.floor(rnd() * H), d = Math.floor(rnd() * 4);
      if (kind[at(x, y)] !== UNDEC || !inside(x + DX[d], y + DY[d]) || kind[at(x + DX[d], y + DY[d])] === HATCH) continue;
      kind[at(x, y)] = HATCH; hatches.push({ x, y, dir: DIRS[d], cats: [] }); ok = true;
    }
    if (!ok) return null;
  }
  coats.forEach((c, k) => hatches[k % nHatch].cats.push(c));
  // the cats, in the order the rules number them: hatch by hatch, then queue order
  const cats = [];
  hatches.forEach((h) => h.cats.forEach((c, j) => cats.push({ coat: c, h, j, st: 0, x: h.x, y: h.y, d: R.GR_DIR[h.dir], turns: 0, steps: 0 })));
  const turntables = [], dogs = [], baskets = [];
  let bounces = 0;
  function decide(c, k, allowDog) {                               // what stands on tile k, which cat c is about to enter
    const options = [];
    const wantTurn = c.turns === 0 || c.steps > 4;
    const sameCoat = baskets.filter((b) => b.coat === c.coat).length;
    if (c.turns >= 1 && c.steps >= 3 && sameCoat < 2) options.push(['basket', c.turns >= 2 ? 3 : 1.2]);
    if (allowDog && dogs.length < dogMax && !inLine(k)) options.push(['dog', bounces < bounceAim ? 1.6 : 0.5]);
    if (turntables.length < nTurn) options.push(['turn', wantTurn ? 2 : 1]);
    options.push(['floor', 1.4]);
    let sum = 0; for (const o of options) sum += o[1];
    let r = rnd() * sum, pick = 'floor';
    for (const o of options) { r -= o[1]; if (r <= 0) { pick = o[0]; break; } }
    const x = k % W, y = (k / W) | 0;
    if (pick === 'dog') { kind[k] = DOG; dogs.push({ x, y }); }
    else if (pick === 'basket') { kind[k] = BASKET; info[k] = c.coat; baskets.push({ x, y, coat: c.coat }); }
    else if (pick === 'turn') {
      // Any new heading but the cat's own, with nothing blocked in line with it: a turntable pointing into a wall
      // or dog acts exactly like one pointing away (the cat bounces straight back), and that twin would be a
      // second solution.
      const dirs = [0, 1, 2, 3].filter((d) => d !== c.d && !blocked(x + DX[d], y + DY[d]) && !blocked(x - DX[d], y - DY[d]));
      if (!dirs.length) { kind[k] = FLOOR; return; }
      const d = dirs[Math.floor(rnd() * dirs.length)], type = rnd() < 0.55 ? 'plain' : c.coat;
      kind[k] = TURN; info[k] = { type, d, coats: new Set() }; turntables.push({ x, y, type, dir: DIRS[d] });
    } else kind[k] = FLOOR;
  }
  const blocked = (x, y) => !inside(x, y) || kind[at(x, y)] === DOG;
  const inLine = (k) => turntables.some((p) => { const d = R.GR_DIR[p.dir]; return k === at(p.x + DX[d], p.y + DY[d]) || k === at(p.x - DX[d], p.y - DY[d]); });
  function enter(c) {
    c.steps++;
    const k = at(c.x, c.y), t = kind[k];
    if (t === BASKET) { c.st = info[k] === c.coat ? 2 : 3; return; }
    if (t === TURN) {
      info[k].coats.add(c.coat);
      if ((info[k].type === 'plain' || info[k].type === c.coat) && info[k].d !== c.d) { c.d = info[k].d; c.turns++; }
    }
  }
  function move(c) {
    let nx = c.x + DX[c.d], ny = c.y + DY[c.d];
    if (inside(nx, ny) && kind[at(nx, ny)] === UNDEC) decide(c, at(nx, ny), true);
    if (blocked(nx, ny)) {
      c.d = (c.d + 2) & 3; bounces++;
      nx = c.x + DX[c.d]; ny = c.y + DY[c.d];
      if (inside(nx, ny) && kind[at(nx, ny)] === UNDEC) decide(c, at(nx, ny), false);
      if (blocked(nx, ny)) return false;                                     // boxed in: no puzzle here
    }
    c.x = nx; c.y = ny; enter(c);
    return c.st !== 3;                                                       // a wrong basket: start again
  }
  for (let t = 0; t < s.timeLimit; t++) {
    for (const c of cats) if (c.st === 1 && !move(c)) return null;
    if (t % 2 === 0) for (const c of cats) if (c.st === 0 && c.j === t / 2) c.st = 1;
    if (cats.every((c) => c.st === 2)) {
      if (turntables.length < T.turntables[0]) return null;
      // A coloured turntable no cat of the other coat crosses works the same as a plain one: make it plain,
      // so swapping the two isn't a second solution.
      for (const p of turntables) { const q = info[at(p.x, p.y)]; if (p.type !== 'plain' && ![...q.coats].some((co) => co !== p.type)) p.type = 'plain'; }
      const level = { board: { w: W, h: H, roomX: 0, roomY: 0 }, timeLimit: s.timeLimit, hatches, baskets, dogs, solution: turntables,
        tray: { plain: 0, ginger: 0, blue: 0 } };
      for (const p of turntables) level.tray[p.type]++;
      const used = new Set(); for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) if (kind[k] !== UNDEC) used.add(k);
      if (permissions.flaps && !addFlap(level, rnd)) return null;
      if (permissions.points) {
        if (!addPoints(level, rnd)) return null;
        for (const k of pathTiles(level, turntables)) used.add(k);
      }
      if (permissions.tunnels) {
        if (!addTunnel(level, rnd)) return null;
        for (const k of pathTiles(level, turntables)) used.add(k);
        for (const t of level.tunnels) { used.add(t.a.y * W + t.a.x); used.add(t.b.y * W + t.b.x); }
      }
      if (permissions.bigCats) {
        if (!addBigCats(level, rnd)) return null;
        for (const k of pathTiles(level, turntables)) used.add(k);
      }
      return { level, untouched: Array.from({ length: N }, (_, k) => k).filter((k) => !used.has(k)) };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
// Convert an intended edge delivery into a true outward exit. All users of that
// basket must already face the same outer side. finish() then certifies the new
// free floor and extra step with the real rules/solver; no default RNG is consumed.
function addFlap(level, rnd) {
  const s = R.grRun(level, level.solution), candidates = [];
  for (let b = 0; b < level.baskets.length; b++) {
    const basket = level.baskets[b]; let direction = -1, valid = true, users = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) if (s.x[i] === basket.x && s.y[i] === basket.y) {
      const d = s.dir[i], nx = basket.x + DX[d], ny = basket.y + DY[d]; users++;
      if ((direction >= 0 && direction !== d) || (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < s.W && ny < s.H)) valid = false;
      direction = d;
    }
    if (valid && users) candidates.push({ b, direction });
  }
  if (!candidates.length) return false;
  const selected = candidates[Math.floor(rnd() * candidates.length)], basket = level.baskets.splice(selected.b, 1)[0];
  level.flaps = [{ x: basket.x, y: basket.y, side: DIRS[selected.direction], coat: basket.coat }];
  return true;
}
// Try visited free floor, then replay the shared state rather than predicting a
// second cat's route. The new opposite exit must actually be used. Candidate
// count is bounded by board area; finish() still certifies count and minimum.
function addPoints(level, rnd) {
  const W=level.board.w,occupied=new Set(level.hatches.concat(level.baskets,level.dogs,level.solution,level.flaps||[]).map(p=>p.y*W+p.x));
  const base=R.grCreate(level,level.solution),seen=new Set(),candidates=[];
  while(base.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){
    R.grTick(base);
    for(const i of base.moveOrder){
      const k=base.y[i]*W+base.x[i];
      if(base.ev[i]!==R.GE_MOVED||occupied.has(k)||seen.has(k))continue;
      seen.add(k);candidates.push({x:base.x[i],y:base.y[i],dir:base.dir[i]});
    }
  }
  if(!candidates.length)return false;
  const first=Math.floor(rnd()*candidates.length);
  for(let n=0;n<candidates.length;n++){
    const p=candidates[(first+n)%candidates.length];
    level.gates=[{x:p.x,y:p.y,exits:[DIRS[p.dir],DIRS[(p.dir+2)&3]]}];
    const s=R.grCreate(level,level.solution);let flips=0;
    while(s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){R.grTick(s);flips+=s.flipCount;}
    if(s.outcome===R.GO_WON&&flips>=2)return true;
  }
  delete level.gates;return false;
}
// Bounded candidate pairs: visited empty entrance, then any other free exit.
// A full shared replay must still win, use the link and use every intended turn.
// Disabled permissions never call this function or consume its random number.
function addTunnel(level, rnd) {
  const W=level.board.w,H=level.board.h,occupied=new Set(level.hatches.concat(level.baskets,level.dogs,level.solution,level.gates||[],level.flaps||[]).map(p=>p.y*W+p.x));
  for(const h of level.hatches){const d=R.GR_DIR[h.dir];occupied.add((h.y+DY[d])*W+h.x+DX[d]);}
  const base=R.grCreate(level,level.solution),entries=[],seen=new Set(),free=[];
  for(let k=0;k<W*H;k++)if(!occupied.has(k))free.push(k);
  while(base.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){R.grTick(base);for(let i=0;i<base.n;i++){
    const k=base.y[i]*W+base.x[i];if(base.ev[i]!==R.GE_MOVED||occupied.has(k)||seen.has(k))continue;
    seen.add(k);entries.push(k);
  }}
  if(!entries.length||free.length<2)return false;
  const start=Math.floor(rnd()*entries.length*free.length),total=entries.length*free.length;
  for(let n=0;n<total;n++){
    const q=(start+n)%total,a=entries[Math.floor(q/free.length)],b=free[q%free.length];if(a===b)continue;
    level.tunnels=[{a:{x:a%W,y:Math.floor(a/W)},b:{x:b%W,y:Math.floor(b/W)},symbol:'circle'}];
    const s=R.grRun(level,level.solution);
    if(s.outcome===R.GO_WON&&s.tunnelUses[0]>0&&level.solution.every(p=>s.turns[p.y*W+p.x]>0))return true;
  }
  delete level.tunnels;return false;
}
// Size conversion is opt-in only, after shared-piece construction. A bounded
// rotation tries one big member in a mixed queue; real replay verifies its route.
function addBigCats(level, rnd) {
  const members = []; for (const h of level.hatches) for (let j=0;j<h.cats.length;j++) members.push({h,j,cat:h.cats[j]});
  const start = Math.floor(rnd()*members.length);
  for (let k=0;k<members.length;k++) {
    for (const m of members) m.h.cats[m.j]=m.cat;
    const m=members[(start+k)%members.length];m.h.cats[m.j]=typeof m.cat==='object'?{...m.cat,big:true}:{coat:m.cat,big:true};
    const s=R.grRun(level,level.solution);
    if(s.outcome===R.GO_WON&&level.solution.every(p=>s.turns[p.y*s.W+p.x]>0))return true;
  }
  for (const m of members) m.h.cats[m.j]=m.cat;return false;
}
// Every tile a layout's cats step on.
function pathTiles(level, placements) {
  const s = R.grCreate(level, placements), seen = new Set();
  while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING) { R.grTick(s); for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) if (s.st[i] !== R.GL_WAIT) seen.add(s.y[i] * s.W + s.x[i]); }
  return seen;
}
// Bounces a layout makes (edges and dogs), summed over every cat and tick.
function bounceCount(level, placements) {
  const s = R.grCreate(level, placements);
  let n = 0;
  while (s.outcome === R.GO_RUNNING) { R.grTick(s); for (let i = 0; i < s.n; i++) n += s.bounced[i]; }
  return n;
}
function statsOf(level, r) {
  return { turntables: r.minTurntables, bounces: Math.min(...r.solutions.map((sol) => bounceCount(level, sol))), cats: level.hatches.reduce((n, h) => n + h.cats.length, 0),
    dogs: level.dogs.length, solutions: r.count, area: level.board.w * level.board.h, hatches: level.hatches.length };
}
function within(st, T, s) {
  const [lo, hi] = CAL.difficultyRange(T, s.minBoard.w * s.minBoard.h, s.maxBoard.w * s.maxBoard.h), score = CAL.difficulty(st);
  return st.turntables >= T.turntables[0] && st.turntables <= T.turntables[1] && st.bounces >= T.bounces[0] && st.cats >= T.cats[0] && st.cats <= T.cats[1] &&
    st.dogs >= T.dogs[0] && st.dogs <= T.dogs[1] && st.solutions >= T.solutions[0] && st.solutions <= T.solutions[1] && score >= lo && score <= hi;
}
const MAX_NODES = 400000;
function finish(s, wd, built, rnd, why) {
  const T = targetsFor(s, wd), L = built.level, W = L.board.w, need = L.solution.length, intended = S.key(L.solution);
  if (R.grRun(L, L.solution).outcome !== R.GO_WON) { why.replay++; return null; }
  // Added dogs stay off the intended route, so they cannot raise its bounce
  // count. Reject an impossible weekday target before certifying other answers.
  if (T.bounces[0] > 0 && bounceCount(L, L.solution) < T.bounces[0]) { why.targets++; return null; }
  // Count solutions, stopping early while there are too many: enough of the others to see which tiles they need.
  const count = () => S.solve(L, { maxNodes: MAX_NODES, stopAfter: T.solutions[1] + 24 });
  let r = count();
  if (r.truncated || !r.solvable) { why.solver++; return null; }
  // Dogs never go in line with an intended turntable's arrow (that would make its reversed twin a solution too).
  const inLine = new Set();
  for (const p of L.solution) { const d = R.GR_DIR[p.dir]; for (const sgn of [1, -1]) { const x = p.x + sgn * DX[d], y = p.y + sgn * DY[d]; if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < W && y < L.board.h) inLine.add(y * W + x); } }
  const untouched = new Set(built.untouched.filter((k) => !inLine.has(k)));
  // Too many solutions, or a shorter one: a dog on the untouched tile the most other solutions need.
  while ((r.stopped || r.count > T.solutions[1] || r.minTurntables < need) && L.dogs.length < T.dogs[1]) {
    const votes = new Map(), vote = (k, n) => { if (untouched.has(k)) votes.set(k, (votes.get(k) || 0) + n); };
    for (const sol of r.solutions) {
      if (S.key(sol) === intended) continue;
      for (const p of sol) vote(p.y * W + p.x, 3);                          // a dog here rules this one out
      for (const k of pathTiles(L, sol)) vote(k, 1);                         // or sends its cats elsewhere
    }
    if (!votes.size) { why.inseparable++; return null; }                    // the others only use tiles the intended run needs
    let k = -1, best = 0;
    for (const [tile, n] of votes) if (n > best || (n === best && rnd() < 0.5)) { k = tile; best = n; }
    untouched.delete(k); L.dogs.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0 });
    // With no dogs left, surviving known answers can already prove failure.
    // Drop idle turns and deduplicate before counting these lower-bound witnesses.
    // Acceptance still needs a complete count: a new dog can create new answers.
    if (L.dogs.length === T.dogs[1]) {
      const surviving = new Set();
      for (const sol of r.solutions) {
        const state = R.grRun(L, sol);
        if (state.outcome !== R.GO_WON) continue;
        const active = sol.filter((p) => state.turns[p.y * W + p.x] > 0);
        surviving.add(S.key(active));
        if (active.length < need || surviving.size > T.solutions[1]) { why.tooMany++; return null; }
      }
    }
    r = count();
    if (r.truncated || !r.solvable) { why.solver++; return null; }
  }
  if (r.stopped || r.count > T.solutions[1] || r.minTurntables < need) { why.tooMany++; return null; }
  // Too few dogs for the weekday: add ones the solution count can live with.
  const spare = [...untouched];
  while (L.dogs.length < T.dogs[0] && spare.length) {
    const k = spare.splice(Math.floor(rnd() * spare.length), 1)[0];
    L.dogs.push({ x: k % W, y: (k / W) | 0 });
    const r2 = S.solve(L, { maxNodes: MAX_NODES });
    if (r2.truncated || r2.stopped || !r2.solvable || r2.count > T.solutions[1] || r2.minTurntables < need) L.dogs.pop(); else r = r2;
  }
  const st = statsOf(L, r);
  if (!within(st, T, s)) { why.targets++; return null; }
  L.minTurntables = r.minTurntables;
  return { level: L, stats: st, difficulty: CAL.difficulty(st) };
}
  function practice(settings, seed, weekday, maxTries, onProgress) {
    P.read(settings);
    if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff) throw new RangeError('seed must be a 32-bit unsigned integer');
    if (!Number.isInteger(weekday) || weekday < 0 || weekday > 6) throw new RangeError('weekday must be 0..6');
    const limit = maxTries === undefined ? 120000 : maxTries;
    if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw new RangeError('maxTries must be positive');
    const random = rng(seed), why = { built: 0, replay: 0, solver: 0, inseparable: 0, tooMany: 0, targets: 0 };
    for (let tries = 1; tries <= limit; tries++) {
      const built = construct(settings, weekday, random);
      if (built) {
        why.built++;
        const p = finish(settings, weekday, built, random, why);
        if (p) return {
          seed, weekday, tries, difficulty: p.difficulty, stats: p.stats,
          level: Object.assign({ id: 'practice-' + weekday + '-' + seed, title: 'Practice · ' + CAL.WEEKDAYS[weekday] }, p.level),
        };
      }
      if (onProgress && tries % 1000 === 0) onProgress(tries);
    }
    throw new Error('No ' + CAL.WEEKDAYS[weekday] + ' puzzle found for seed ' + seed + ' in ' + limit + ' tries');
  }
  function dateForWeekday(todayKey, weekday) {
    if (Number.isNaN(CAL.dayNumber(todayKey)) || !Number.isInteger(weekday) || weekday < 0 || weekday > 6)
      throw new RangeError('expected a valid date and weekday 0..6');
    return CAL.keyOf(CAL.dayNumber(todayKey) + weekday - CAL.weekday(todayKey));
  }
  return { rng, targetsFor, construct, finish, statsOf, bounceCount, within, practice, dateForWeekday };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = PUZZLEGEN;
// ============================================================================
// 19b DEPOT (pure; Node-exported). Geometry, sunlight and analytic room motion.
// Whole world units and integer frames in data; 1 tile = 16 wu. The view ray,
// swept-hexagon coverage test and 1 wu rounding guard match 18_boxroom.js.
// Sun rays enter the east wall: the office's windowAmt model with arched heads.
// build/checks allocate once. sunAmt is an allocation-free point query for the
// future bake and actors. No clock, DOM, randomness or drawing lives here.
// Swift: DepotData: Codable; the same interval/ray checks in Double at loading.
// ============================================================================
const DEPOT = (function () {
  const CFG = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports ? require('../data/depot.json') : DEPOT_DATA;
  const T = 16, CORE = 7;
  const ratio = q => q[0] / q[1];
  const clamp = (v,a,b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;

  function hidesTile(B, bx) {
    const hx0=bx[0]-bx[5], hx1=bx[3]-bx[2], hy0=bx[1]-bx[5], hy1=bx[4]-bx[2];
    const hs0=bx[0]+bx[1]-2*bx[5], hs1=bx[3]+bx[4]-2*bx[2], hd0=bx[0]-bx[4], hd1=bx[3]-bx[1];
    for(let j=0;j<B.h;j++) for(let i=0;i<B.w;i++) {
      const x=B.x+8+i*T, y=B.y+8+j*T;
      if(hx0<x+CORE && x-CORE<hx1 && hy0<y+CORE && y-CORE<hy1 &&
        hs0<x+y+CORE && x+y-CORE<hs1 && hd0<x-y+CORE && x-y-CORE<hd1) return [i,j];
    }
    return null;
  }
  function routeBoxes(route) {
    const out=[], r=route.radius, p=route.points;
    for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++) {
      const a=p[i-1], b=p[i];
      out.push([Math.min(a[0],b[0])-r,Math.min(a[1],b[1])-r,Math.min(a[2],b[2]),
        Math.max(a[0],b[0])+r,Math.max(a[1],b[1])+r,Math.max(a[2],b[2])+route.height,route.id]);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function solids(room) {
    const out=[];
    for(const f of room.furniture) for(const b of f.parts) out.push(b.concat(f.id));
    for(const w of room.walls) out.push(w.bounds.concat(w.id));
    for(const b of room.roof.bands) out.push(b.concat('roof'));
    for(const o of room.openings) for(const b of o.doors || []) out.push(b.concat(o.id+' door'));
    for(const l of room.lamps) {
      out.push([l.x-l.r-1,l.y-l.r-1,l.z,l.x+l.r+1,l.y+l.r+1,l.z+l.height,l.id+' lamp']);
      out.push([l.x-1,l.y-1,l.z+l.height,l.x+1,l.y+1,l.hangZ,l.id+' flex']);
    }
    for(const r of room.routes) out.push(...routeBoxes(r));
    for(const e of room.motionEnvelopes) out.push(e.bounds.concat(e.id));
    return out;
  }
  function hidden(room) {
    const out=[];
    for(const s of solids(room)) { const tile=hidesTile(room.board,s); if(tile) out.push({what:s[6],tile}); }
    return out;
  }
  function footprintIssues(room) {
    const out=[], B=room.board;
    for(const f of room.furniture) for(const p of f.parts) {
      const z=f.zone==='interior' ? [0,0,room.room.w,room.room.d] : room.exterior;
      if(p.length!==6 || p[0]>=p[3] || p[1]>=p[4] || p[2]>=p[5]) out.push({what:f.id,reason:'invalid volume'});
      if(p[0]<z[0] || p[1]<z[1] || p[3]>z[2] || p[4]>z[3]) out.push({what:f.id,reason:'outside '+f.zone});
      if(p[0]<B.x+B.w*T && p[3]>B.x && p[1]<B.y+B.h*T && p[4]>B.y) out.push({what:f.id,reason:'sorting floor'});
      if((p[0]>=B.x+B.w*T || p[1]>=B.y+B.h*T) && p[5]>12 && p[3]>B.x && p[4]>B.y)
        out.push({what:f.id,reason:'front item taller than one box'});
    }
    return out;
  }
  function routeIssues(room) {
    const out=[], B=room.board;
    for(const r of room.routes) for(const s of routeBoxes(r)) {
      if(s[3]>B.x && s[4]>B.y) out.push({what:r.id,reason:'route leaves back/left margins'});
      if(s[0]<0 || s[1]<0 || s[3]>room.room.w || s[4]>room.room.d) out.push({what:r.id,reason:'route outside room'});
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Ray from P to x=0, along (-1,m,k). Slabs, no temporary vectors per query.
  function blocked(room,x,y,z,m,k) {
    for(let f=0;f<room.furniture.length;f++) {
      const item=room.furniture[f]; if(item.castsShadow===false || item.zone==='exterior') continue;
      const solids=item.occluders || item.parts;
      for(let n=0;n<solids.length;n++) {
        const b=solids[n]; let lo=0.001, hi=x;
        for(let a=0;a<3 && lo<hi;a++) {
          const p=a===0?x:a===1?y:z, d=a===0?-1:a===1?m:k;
          if(d===0) { if(p<b[a] || p>b[a+3]) hi=-1; continue; }
          const u=(b[a]-p)/d, v=(b[a+3]-p)/d;
          lo=Math.max(lo,Math.min(u,v)); hi=Math.min(hi,Math.max(u,v));
        }
        if(lo<hi) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  // Orthographic sun rays share wall-space y/z. Reject disjoint solid silhouettes before
  // the exact slab test. This loading-time index changes neither pixels nor shadow edges.
  function compileSun(room){
    const m=-room.sun.direction[1]/room.sun.direction[0],k=-room.sun.direction[2]/room.sun.direction[0],a=[];
    for(const item of room.furniture){
      if(item.castsShadow===false||item.zone==='exterior')continue;
      for(const b of item.occluders||item.parts)a.push(...b,
        b[1]+Math.min(m*b[0],m*b[3]),b[4]+Math.max(m*b[0],m*b[3]),
        b[2]+Math.min(k*b[0],k*b[3]),b[5]+Math.max(k*b[0],k*b[3]));
    }
    return Float64Array.from(a);
  }
  function indexedBlocked(a,x,y,z,m,k){
    const yw=y+m*x,zw=z+k*x;
    for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=10){
      if(x<=a[i]||yw<a[i+6]-1e-9||yw>a[i+7]+1e-9||zw<a[i+8]-1e-9||zw>a[i+9]+1e-9)continue;
      let lo=.001,hi=x;
      for(let axis=0;axis<3&&lo<hi;axis++){
        const p=axis===0?x:axis===1?y:z,d=axis===0?-1:axis===1?m:k;
        if(d===0){if(p<a[i+axis]||p>a[i+axis+3])hi=-1;continue;}
        const u=(a[i+axis]-p)/d,v=(a[i+axis+3]-p)/d;
        lo=Math.max(lo,Math.min(u,v));hi=Math.min(hi,Math.max(u,v));
      }
      if(lo<hi)return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  function sunAmt(room,x,y,z,index) {
    const S=room.sun, m=-S.direction[1]/S.direction[0], k=-S.direction[2]/S.direction[0];
    const yw=y+m*x, zw=z+k*x, frame=ratio(S.frame), bar=ratio(S.bar), rail=ratio(S.rail);
    let amount=0;
    for(let i=0;i<room.windows.length;i++) {
      const w=room.windows[i], yg=yw+w.depth*m, zg=zw+w.depth*k, mid=(w.u0+w.u1)/2;
      if(yw<=w.u0 || yw>=w.u1 || zw<=w.z0 || zw>=w.z1) continue;
      if(zw>w.springZ && Math.hypot(yw-mid,zw-w.springZ)>=w.radius) continue;
      let edge=Math.min(yw-w.u0,w.u1-yw,zw-w.z0,w.z1-zw,
        yg-w.u0-frame,w.u1-frame-yg,zg-w.z0-frame,w.z1-frame-zg);
      if(zw>w.springZ) edge=Math.min(edge,w.radius-Math.hypot(yw-mid,zw-w.springZ));
      if(zg>w.springZ) edge=Math.min(edge,w.radius-frame-Math.hypot(yg-mid,zg-w.springZ));
      for(let j=0;j<w.mullions.length;j++) edge=Math.min(edge,Math.abs(yg-w.mullions[j])-bar);
      for(let j=0;j<w.rails.length;j++) edge=Math.min(edge,Math.abs(zg-w.rails[j])-rail);
      amount=Math.max(amount,clamp(edge/ratio(S.soft)+ratio(S.bias),0,1));
    }
    return amount && !(index?indexedBlocked(index,x,y,z,m,k):blocked(room,x,y,z,m,k)) ? amount : 0;
  }

  // Convex shadows as in the Box Room. This is loading/review maths only.
  function hull(P) {
    P.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0] || a[1]-b[1]); const lo=[], up=[];
    const cross=(a,b,c)=>(b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(b[1]-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0]);
    for(const p of P) { while(lo.length>1 && cross(lo.at(-2),lo.at(-1),p)<=0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p); }
    for(let i=P.length-1;i>=0;i--) { const p=P[i]; while(up.length>1 && cross(up.at(-2),up.at(-1),p)<=0) up.pop(); up.push(p); }
    return lo.slice(0,-1).concat(up.slice(0,-1));
  }
  function shadows(room,m,k) {
    const out=[];
    for(const f of room.furniture) if(f.castsShadow!==false && f.zone!=='exterior') for(const b of f.occluders || f.parts) {
      const p=[];
      for(const x of [b[0],b[3]]) for(const y of [b[1],b[4]]) for(const z of [b[2],b[5]]) p.push([x+z/k,y-m*z/k]);
      out.push(hull(p));
    }
    return out;
  }
  // Full-strength fraction (a stricter threshold than merely nonzero light).
  // Exact along each x scanline: partition at every frame/bar/arch/shadow edge,
  // then classify an interior point. Midpoint quadrature only between y rows.
  function sunlit(room,dy) {
    dy=dy===undefined?0.5:dy;
    if(!(dy>0 && Number.isFinite(dy))) throw new RangeError('scanline step must be positive');
    const B=room.board,S=room.sun,m=-S.direction[1]/S.direction[0],k=-S.direction[2]/S.direction[0];
    const sh=shadows(room,m,k), e=(1-ratio(S.bias))*ratio(S.soft), frame=ratio(S.frame), bar=ratio(S.bar),rail=ratio(S.rail);
    let area=0;
    for(let row=B.y;row<B.y+B.h*T;row+=dy) {
      const h=Math.min(dy,B.y+B.h*T-row),y=row+h/2,x0=B.x,x1=B.x+B.w*T, cuts=[x0,x1];
      const add=x=>{if(x>x0 && x<x1) cuts.push(x);};
      const linear=(a,b,target)=>{if(a) add((target-b)/a);};
      for(const w of room.windows) {
        for(const depth of [0,w.depth]) {
          const inset=depth?frame:0;
          for(const u of [w.u0+inset+e,w.u1-inset-e]) linear(m,y+m*depth,u);
          for(const z of [w.z0+inset+e,w.z1-inset-e,w.springZ]) linear(k,k*depth,z);
          const u=y+m*depth-(w.u0+w.u1)/2, v=k*depth-w.springZ, r=w.radius-inset-e;
          const a=m*m+k*k,b=2*(m*u+k*v),c=u*u+v*v-r*r, d=b*b-4*a*c;
          if(d>=0) { add((-b-Math.sqrt(d))/(2*a)); add((-b+Math.sqrt(d))/(2*a)); }
        }
        for(const u of w.mullions) for(const sign of [-1,1]) linear(m,y+m*w.depth,u+sign*(bar+e));
        for(const z of w.rails) for(const sign of [-1,1]) linear(k,k*w.depth,z+sign*(rail+e));
      }
      for(const p of sh) for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++) {
        const a=p[i],b=p[(i+1)%p.length];
        if((a[1]<=y && y<b[1]) || (b[1]<=y && y<a[1])) add(a[0]+(y-a[1])*(b[0]-a[0])/(b[1]-a[1]));
      }
      cuts.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      for(let i=1;i<cuts.length;i++) if(sunAmt(room,(cuts[i-1]+cuts[i])/2,y,0)>=1) area+=(cuts[i]-cuts[i-1])*h;
    }
    return area/(B.w*B.h*T*T);
  }
  // Only horizontal window members cast grid-parallel edges. Vertical members
  // follow the oblique sun direction. Keep hard edges >=3 wu from a tile line.
  function onGridLines(room) {
    const out=[],B=room.board,S=room.sun,m=-S.direction[1]/S.direction[0],k=-S.direction[2]/S.direction[0];
    for(const w of room.windows) {
      const lines=[[w.z0,0],[w.z1,0],[w.z0+ratio(S.frame),w.depth],[w.z1-ratio(S.frame),w.depth]];
      for(const z of w.rails) lines.push([z-ratio(S.rail),w.depth],[z+ratio(S.rail),w.depth]);
      for(const [z,depth] of lines) {
        const x=z/k-depth, y0=w.u0-m*(x+depth), y1=w.u1-m*(x+depth);
        if(y1<=B.y || y0>=B.y+B.h*T) continue;
        for(let i=0;i<=B.w;i++) if(Math.abs(x-B.x-i*T)<3) out.push({window:w.id,at:x,tileLine:B.x+i*T});
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function bounds(room) {
    let sx0=Infinity,sx1=-Infinity,sy0=Infinity,sy1=-Infinity;
    for(const b of solids(room).concat(room.bases.map(q=>q.bounds)))
      for(const x of [b[0],b[3]]) for(const y of [b[1],b[4]]) for(const z of [b[2],b[5]]) {
        sx0=Math.min(sx0,x-y);sx1=Math.max(sx1,x-y);sy0=Math.min(sy0,(x+y)/2-z);sy1=Math.max(sy1,(x+y)/2-z);
      }
    return {sx0:Math.floor(sx0),sx1:Math.ceil(sx1),sy0:Math.floor(sy0),sy1:Math.ceil(sy1)};
  }
  function build(data) {
    const room=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data || CFG));
    const integers=(v,at)=>{
      if(typeof v==='number' && !Number.isInteger(v)) throw new RangeError(at+' must be an integer');
      if(v && typeof v==='object') for(const key of Object.keys(v)) integers(v[key],at+'.'+key);
    };
    integers(room,'depot');
    const B=room.board,R=room.room;
    if(room.version!==1 || room.tile!==T || room.loopFrames!==2880) throw new RangeError('unsupported depot data');
    if(B.w!==7 || B.h!==5 || B.x<3*T || B.y<3*T || R.w-B.x-B.w*T<2*T || R.d-B.y-B.h*T<2*T) throw new RangeError('sorting floor margins');
    const S=room.sun;if(S.direction[0]<=0 || S.direction[2]>=0) throw new RangeError('sun must enter the left wall and descend');
    for(const w of room.windows) if(w.wall!=='L' || w.u0<0 || w.u1>R.d || w.z0<0 || w.z1>R.wallH || w.radius<=0 || w.u1-w.u0!==2*w.radius || w.z1-w.springZ!==w.radius) throw new RangeError('invalid window '+w.id);
    const foot=footprintIssues(room);if(foot.length) throw new RangeError(foot[0].what+': '+foot[0].reason);
    if(!room.bases.some(b=>b.id===room.baseTreatment))throw new RangeError('invalid base treatment');
    for(const f of room.furniture)for(const b of f.occluders || []) {
      if(b.length!==6 || b.slice(0,3).some((v,i)=>v>=b[i+3]) || !f.parts.some(a=>b.slice(0,3).every((v,i)=>v>=a[i] && b[i+3]<=a[i+3])))throw new RangeError(f.id+': occluder outside envelope');
    }
    const routes=routeIssues(room);if(routes.length) throw new RangeError(routes[0].what+': '+routes[0].reason);
    const grid=onGridLines(room);if(grid.length) throw new RangeError(grid[0].window+': sun edge on a tile line');
    const hid=hidden(room);if(hid.length) throw new RangeError(hid[0].what+' hides tile '+hid[0].tile);
    if(sunlit(room)<0.5) throw new RangeError('less than half the board in full sunlight');
    room.bounds=bounds(room);
    if(room.bounds.sx1-room.bounds.sx0+24>720 || room.bounds.sy1-room.bounds.sy0+24>400) throw new RangeError('depot exceeds world layer');
    const C=room.camera;
    for(const key of C.keys) {
      const p=key.focus;
      key.offset=p ? [Math.round(clamp((p[0]-p[1]-C.centre[0])*ratio(C.strength),-C.maxShift,C.maxShift)),
        Math.round(clamp(((p[0]+p[1])/2-p[2]-C.centre[1])*ratio(C.strength),-C.maxShift,C.maxShift))] : [0,0];
    }
    return room;
  }
  // A mote's six seeded parameters live in the existing renderer pool. Its position and visibility
  // are a pure function of the integer loop frame; write into reusable output storage, no allocation.
  function dustAt(pool,offset,frame,out) {
    const t=((frame%2880)+2880)%2880/60, tau=Math.PI*2;
    out[0]=pool[offset]+Math.sin(t/24*tau+pool[offset+3])*4;
    out[1]=pool[offset+1]+Math.cos(t/16*tau+pool[offset+4])*3;
    out[2]=pool[offset+2]+Math.sin(t/48*tau+pool[offset+5]*tau)*5;
    const phase=t/3+pool[offset+5];out[3]=phase-Math.floor(phase)>=.18?1:0;
    return out;
  }
  return {build,hidden,hidesTile,solids,footprintIssues,routeIssues,sunAmt,compileSun,sunlit,onGridLines,bounds,dustAt};
})();
if(typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports=DEPOT;
// Depot life: immutable frame-keyed data -> reusable state. No renderer, clock, random source
// or per-frame allocation. The scene release director calls the ordinary rules on one shared
// state; it changes only WHEN boxes emerge, never movement, order, gates or delivery.
const DEPOTWORLD=(function(){
  const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports;
  const R=node?require('./10_rules.js'):{grCreate,grTick,grResult,grValidate,GR_DIR,GR_DIRS,GR_COAT,GL_BOARD,GE_MOVED,GO_RUNNING};
  const B=node?require('./12_boardanim.js'):BOARDANIM;
  const TAU=Math.PI*2,clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
  const mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t,smooth=t=>{t=clamp(t);return t*t*(3-2*t);};
  function actor(){return {x:0,y:0,z:0,face:0,walk:-1,state:0,frame:0,head:0,flick:0,bob:0,action:'idle',reach:0,hold:0,scratch:0,pencil:false,pour:false};}
  // Evaluate a route at the supplied frame. The driver uses six-frame pose steps;
  // cats and flying pigeons retain their smooth 60 Hz paths.
  // A return value identifies the current segment without allocating a tuple.
  function route(keys,f,a){
    let k=0;while(k<keys.length-2&&f>=keys[k+1][0])k++;
    const p=keys[k],q=keys[k+1],t=clamp((f-p[0])/(q[0]-p[0]));
    a.x=mix(p[1],q[1],t);a.y=mix(p[2],q[2],t);a.z=mix(p[3],q[3],t);
    const dx=q[1]-p[1],dy=q[2]-p[2];a.walk=dx||dy||q[3]!==p[3]?(Math.floor(f/6)&3):-1;
    a.face=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?dx>0?1:2:dy>0?0:3;
    return k;
  }
  function create(room){
    const s={room,demo:demo(room),watchPose:B.makeOut(),frame:0,driver:actor(),pm:actor(),pigeons:[actor(),actor(),actor()],
      bags:room.hooks.map(()=>({cat:true,on:true,breath:0,ear:0,sway:0,turn:0})),stores:new Int8Array(room.stores.length),
      machine:{roller:0,needle:0,chute:0,clock:0,lamps:new Int8Array(3)},camX:0,camY:0,
      cargo:{kind:'none',place:'hand',x:0,y:0,z:0,fold:0,tag:false,face:0,walk:-1},
      parcel:{kind:'none',place:'chute',x:0,y:0,z:0,fold:0,tag:true},mug:{on:false,x:0,y:0,z:0,sip:0,pour:false}};
    step(s,0);return s;
  }
  function transfer(c,f,from,to,x,y,z){const t=smooth((f-from)/(to-from));c.x=mix(c.x,x,t);c.y=mix(c.y,y,t);c.z=mix(c.z,z,t);}
  function step(s,frame,watch){
    const f=((frame|0)%2880+2880)%2880,q=Math.floor(f/6)*6,r=s.room,m=r.motion,d=s.driver,p=s.pm,c=s.cargo;
    s.frame=f;route(m.driverKeys,q,d);
    let stage=0;while(stage<r.timeline.driver.length-1&&f>=r.timeline.driver[stage].to)stage++;
    d.action=r.timeline.driver[stage].action;d.frame=Math.floor(f/6)&3;d.bob=d.walk>=0?(d.frame&1):0;
    d.reach=(f>=294&&f<354)||(f>=1074&&f<1092)||(f>=1608&&f<1632)?1:0;
    d.scratch=f>=354&&f<390?(Math.floor(f/12)&1):0;d.pencil=f>=714&&f<768;d.pour=f>=1932&&f<1980;d.hold=f>=330&&f<912||f>=1092&&f<1632||f>=1920&&f<2670?1:0;
    if(d.walk<0)d.face=f>=1908?2:f>=618&&f<912?2:3;
    route(m.postmistressKeys,f,p);p.frame=Math.floor(f/6)&3;p.flick=q%120<18?1:0;
    p.state=f<180||f>=2850?0:f<240||f>=2832?1:p.walk>=0?2:3;
    p.head=f>=1920&&f<2580?(q%180<90?0:1):q%240<120?1:2;p.face=p.walk>=0?(p.face===1||p.face===3?1:0):0;
    // Small parabolic hops; all land exactly on the specified platform/table heights.
    if(f>=1212&&f<1260)p.z+=Math.sin((f-1212)/48*Math.PI)*7;
    if(f>=1380&&f<1428)p.z+=Math.sin((f-1380)/48*Math.PI)*7;
    if(f>=1860&&f<1920)p.z+=Math.sin((f-1860)/60*Math.PI)*9;
    if(f>=2580&&f<2640)p.z+=Math.sin((f-2580)/60*Math.PI)*7;
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const a=s.pigeons[i],home=r.characters.pigeons.perches[i];
      a.x=home[0];a.y=home[1];a.z=home[2];a.face=i===2?1:0;a.frame=Math.floor(q/6)&3;a.bob=(q+i*30)%(i===1?180:120)<12?1:0;a.state='perch';
      if(i===r.characters.pigeons.visitor){route(m.pigeonKeys,f,a);a.face=f>=2208?1:0;a.state=f>=1992&&f<2208?'peck':f>=1920&&f<2280?'fly':'perch';}
    }
    // Head tracking is part of the pure state, not a side effect of drawing. Game callers may
    // supply their own watched cats; the demo uses its checked traces at this loop frame.
    if(p.state===3&&f<1920){
      let best=Infinity,tx=0,ty=0;
      const n=watch?watch.n:s.demo.traces.length;
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
        let x,y;
        if(watch){x=watch.xs[i];y=watch.ys[i];}
        else{const tr=s.demo.traces[i];if(f/60<tr.rel||f/60>=tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick)continue;B.pose(tr,q/60,s.watchPose);x=s.watchPose.x;y=s.watchPose.y;}
        const dist=(x-p.x)*(x-p.x)+(y-p.y)*(y-p.y);if(dist<best){best=dist;tx=x;ty=y;}
      }
      if(best<Infinity){const screen=tx-ty-p.x+p.y;p.head=Math.abs(screen)<6?2:screen>0?1:0;}
    }
    for(let i=0;i<s.bags.length;i++){
      const b=s.bags[i];b.cat=i!==0||f<330||f>=1632;b.on=i!==0||f<1092||f>=1632;
      b.breath=(q+i*24)%180<72?1:0;b.ear=(q+i*84)%720<6?1:0;
      b.turn=i===0&&f>=1632&&f<1692?Math.floor((f-1632)/12)%4:0;
      b.sway=b.turn===1?1:b.turn===3?-1:0;
    }
    for(let i=0;i<r.stores.length;i++){
      const st=r.stores[i];s.stores[i]=st.start-(f>=st.takeFrame?1:0)+(f>=st.replaceFrame?1:0)+(f>=st.addFrame?1:0)-(f>=st.removeFrame?1:0);
    }
    const handX=d.x+(d.face===1||d.face===3?3:-3),handY=d.y+(d.face===1||d.face===3?-1:1);
    c.kind='none';c.place='hand';c.x=handX;c.y=handY;c.z=14;c.fold=0;c.tag=f>=750;c.face=0;c.walk=-1;
    if(f>=330&&f<420){c.kind='cat';if(f<354){c.x=54;c.y=10;c.z=29;transfer(c,f,330,354,handX,handY,14);}c.fold=clamp((q-390)/30);}
    if(f>=420&&f<1128){
      c.kind='box';
      if(f>=630&&f<660)transfer(c,f,630,660,18,121,4);
      else if(f>=660&&f<786){c.x=18;c.y=121;c.z=4;c.place='scale';}
      else if(f>=786&&f<810){c.x=18;c.y=121;c.z=4;transfer(c,f,786,810,handX,handY,14);}
      else if(f>=888&&f<1020){route(m.boxKeys,f,c);c.place='conveyor';}
      else if(f>=1020&&f<1110){const t=(f-1020)/90,a=Math.PI*.5+t*TAU*2.2;c.x=16+8*Math.cos(a);c.y=16+8*Math.sin(a);c.z=68-t*61;c.place='chute';}
      else if(f>=1110){const a=Math.PI*.5+TAU*2.2;c.x=16+8*Math.cos(a);c.y=16+8*Math.sin(a);c.z=7-(f-1110);c.place='hatch';}
    }
    // The sent parcel finishes its descent while the driver's hands start unloading.
    const sent=s.parcel;sent.kind=f>=1092&&f<1128?'box':'none';sent.place=c.place;sent.x=c.x;sent.y=c.y;sent.z=c.z;
    if(f>=1092&&f<1230){c.kind='empty-bag';c.place='hand';c.x=handX;c.y=handY;c.z=14;if(f>=1206){transfer(c,f,1206,1230,152,22,8);c.fold=smooth((f-1206)/24);}}
    if(f>=1320&&f<1632){c.kind='full-bag';if(f<1344){c.x=185;c.y=-12;c.z=18;transfer(c,f,1320,1344,handX,handY,14);}if(f>=1608)transfer(c,f,1608,1632,54,10,29);}
    s.mug.on=f>=1920&&f<2670;s.mug.sip=f>=2040&&f<2580&&q%180<48?1:0;
    s.mug.x=d.x-4;s.mug.y=d.y;s.mug.z=s.mug.sip?22:14;s.mug.pour=f>=1944&&f<1980;
    if(f>=1920&&f<2004){
      const at=m.mugPour,amount=f<1944?smooth((f-1920)/24):f<1980?1:1-smooth((f-1980)/24);
      s.mug.x=mix(s.mug.x,at[0],amount);s.mug.y=mix(s.mug.y,at[1],amount);s.mug.z=mix(s.mug.z,at[2],amount);
    }
    if(p.state===3){
      if(f>=912&&f<1128){const box=sent.kind==='box'?sent:c,dx=box.x-box.y-p.x+p.y;p.head=Math.abs(dx)<6?2:dx>0?1:0;}
      if(f>=1920&&f<2580){const bird=s.pigeons[r.characters.pigeons.visitor],dx=bird.x-bird.y-p.x+p.y;p.head=Math.abs(dx)<6?2:dx>0?1:0;}
    }
    s.machine.roller=Math.floor(q/12)%4;s.machine.chute=f>=1020&&f<1128?Math.floor(q/6)%2:0;s.machine.clock=Math.floor(q/48)%60;
    let age=-1,weight=0;
    if(f>=660&&f<786){age=f-660;weight=7;}else if(f>=1260&&f<1380){age=f-1260;weight=11;}
    s.machine.needle=age<0?0:Math.round(clamp(weight*(1-Math.exp(-age/18)*Math.cos(age/7)),0,15));
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++)s.machine.lamps[i]=Math.round(Math.sin(q/(i===0?480:720)*TAU+i*Math.PI)*.65);
    const keys=r.camera.keys;let k=0;while(k<keys.length-2&&f>=keys[k+1].frame)k++;
    const a=keys[k],b=keys[k+1],t=smooth((f-a.frame)/(b.frame-a.frame));
    s.camX=Math.round(mix(a.offset[0],b.offset[0],t));s.camY=Math.round(mix(a.offset[1],b.offset[1],t));
    return s;
  }
  function demo(room){
    const d=room.demo,l=d.level,level={board:{w:l.w,h:l.h},timeLimit:120,
      hatches:l.hatches.map(h=>({...h,cats:d.cats.map(c=>c.colour)})),dogs:l.dogs,gates:l.gates,
      baskets:l.baskets.map(b=>({x:b.x,y:b.y,coat:b.colour})),tray:{plain:2,ginger:2}},
      turns=d.turntables.map(t=>({x:t.x,y:t.y,dir:t.dir,type:t.colour})),errors=R.grValidate(level,turns);
    if(errors.length)throw new Error('Depot demo: '+errors.join('; '));
    const s=R.grCreate(level,turns),traces=d.cats.map(c=>{const tr=B.makeTrace(120),h=l.hatches[0];
      tr.rel=c.releaseFrame/60;tr.tick=d.tickFrames/60;tr.pop=.25;tr.coat=R.GR_COAT[c.colour];tr.hx=h.x;tr.hy=h.y;tr.hatchDir=R.GR_DIR[h.dir];tr.bw=l.w;tr.bh=l.h;
      tr.ox=room.board.x;tr.oy=room.board.y;return tr;}),gates=B.makeGateTrace(120*d.cats.length);
    // Disable ONLY automatic release. grTick still moves all active cats in stable release order,
    // using the same arrays, bounce, gate events and result accounting as a played level.
    for(const h of s.hatches)h.count=0;
    for(let f=0;f<2880&&s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING;f+=d.tickFrames){
      R.grTick(s);
      for(let i=0;i<traces.length;i++)if(s.ev[i]>=R.GE_MOVED)B.record(traces[i],s.px[i],s.py[i],s.pdir[i],s.x[i],s.y[i],s.dir[i],s.ev[i],s.bounced[i]);
      B.recordGates(gates,s,f/60);
      for(let i=0;i<d.cats.length;i++)if(d.cats[i].releaseFrame===f)s.st[i]=R.GL_BOARD;
    }
    const ends=[],shows={plain:false,colourPass:false,dog:false,edge:false};
    for(let i=0;i<traces.length;i++){
      const tr=traces[i],expected=d.paths[d.cats[i].colour],actual=[];
      for(let k=0;k<tr.n;k++){
        actual.push([tr.x1[k],tr.y1[k],R.GR_DIRS[tr.d1[k]]]);
        if(tr.bn[k]){const x=tr.x0[k]+[1,0,-1,0][tr.d0[k]],y=tr.y0[k]+[0,1,0,-1][tr.d0[k]];if(x<0||y<0||x>=l.w||y>=l.h)shows.edge=true;else shows.dog=true;}
        for(const t of turns)if(t.x===tr.x1[k]&&t.y===tr.y1[k]){if(t.type==='plain'&&tr.d0[k]!==tr.d1[k])shows.plain=true;if(t.type==='ginger'&&d.cats[i].colour==='blue'&&tr.d0[k]===tr.d1[k])shows.colourPass=true;}
      }
      if(JSON.stringify(actual)!==JSON.stringify(expected))errors.push('cat '+i+' path differs from stored '+d.cats[i].colour+' path');
      if(tr.end!==B.END_HOME)errors.push('cat '+i+' does not arrive home');
      tr.napUntil=tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+d.delivery.settleFrames/60+d.delivery.napFrames/60;tr.leaveDir=3;tr.blinkPhase=i*7;
      ends.push(tr.napUntil+B.WAKE_LEN+B.LEAVE_LEN+d.delivery.flapFrames/60);
    }
    for(let i=0;i<s.gates.length;i++)if(s.gateState[i])errors.push('gate '+i+' does not reset');
    if(ends.some(t=>t>=48))errors.push('demo outlasts loop');
    if(errors.length)throw new Error('Depot demo: '+errors.join('; '));
    return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,errors,shows,final:R.grResult(s)};
  }

  // Write analytic events straight into the caller's existing particle pool. Slot ownership,
  // palette numbers and drawing stay outside this pure module. No secondary particle pool.
  function particle(o,i,type,x,y,z,age,life,col){
    if(age<0||age>=life)return;
    o.type[i]=type;o.x[i]=x;o.y[i]=y;o.z[i]=z;o.life[i]=life-age;o.max[i]=life;o.col[i]=col;o.phase[i]=i;
  }
  function particles(s,o,game){
    for(let i=152;i<200;i++)o.type[i]=0;
    const f=s.frame,m=s.room.motion.particles;
    for(let k=0;k<8;k++){const age=((f+k*18)%144)/60;particle(o,152+k,1,m.urn[0]+Math.sin(age*3+k)*2,m.urn[1]+Math.cos(age*2+k),m.urn[2]+age*8,age,1.8,o.pale);}
    for(let k=0;k<5;k++){const age=((f+k*24)%144)/60;particle(o,160+k,1,m.bonnet[0]+Math.sin(age*2+k)*2,m.bonnet[1],m.bonnet[2]+age*5,age,1.6,o.mist);}
    if(s.mug.on)for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const age=((f+k*24)%144)/60,a=s.mug;particle(o,165+k,1,a.x+Math.sin(age*3+k),a.y,a.z+3+age*5,age,1.4,o.pale);}
    const feather=(f-m.featherFrame)/60;particle(o,169,6,24+Math.sin(feather*4)*2,128,5-feather*2,feather,2,o.cream);
    const age=(f-s.room.motion.scale.sparkFrame)/60;particle(o,170,3,18,119,32+age*6,age,.7,o.brass);
    if(!game){
      for(let i=0;i<s.demo.traces.length;i++){
        const tr=s.demo.traces[i],last=tr.n-1,t=f/60-tr.rel-tr.n*tr.tick-1.2,x=tr.ox+tr.x1[last]*16+8,y=tr.oy+tr.y1[last]*16+8;
        particle(o,176+i,5,x,y,8+t*5,t,1.3,o.heart);particle(o,184+i,3,x-2,y,6+t*8-t*t*20,t,.7,tr.coat===1?o.ginger:o.blue);
      }
      for(let i=0;i<s.demo.level.gates.length;i++){
        const g=s.demo.level.gates[i];let t=100;
        for(let j=s.demo.gates.n-1;j>=0;j--)if(s.demo.gates.gate[j]===i&&s.demo.gates.time[j]<=f/60){t=f/60-s.demo.gates.time[j];break;}
        particle(o,192+i,4,s.room.board.x+g.x*16+8+t*4,s.room.board.y+g.y*16+8,2+t*3,t,.3,o.stone);
      }
    }
  }
  return {create,step,demo,particles};
})();

// Handmade level rooms. Generated Box Rooms carry their own geometry and do not use
// this check. Offsets are tiles from the room's stone sorting floor, not world units.
// Swift: optional Codable room enum (missing = office), plus immutable floor limits.
const LEVELROOMS = (function () {
  const node = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const office = node ? require('../data/scene.json') : SCENE_DATA;
  const depot = node ? require('../data/depot.json') : DEPOT_DATA;
  const train = node ? require('../data/train.json') : TRAIN_DATA;
  const parcel = node ? require('../data/parcel.json') : PARCEL_DATA;
  const cityhall = node ? require('../data/cityhall.json') : CITYHALL_DATA;
  const christmas = node ? require('../data/christmas.json') : CHRISTMAS_DATA;
  const rooms = {
    christmas: {title:'Christmas Eve', w:christmas.board.w, h:christmas.board.h},
    office: {title:'The sorting office', w:office.floor.w, h:office.floor.h},
    depot: {title:'The town depot', w:depot.board.w, h:depot.board.h},
    train: {title:'The mail train', w:train.board.w, h:train.board.h},
    parcel: {title:'The parcel warehouse', w:parcel.board.w, h:parcel.board.h},
    cityhall: {title:'The city sorting hall', w:cityhall.board.w, h:cityhall.board.h}
  };
  const id = L => L.room === undefined ? 'office' : L.room;
  const floor = L => Object.hasOwn(rooms, id(L)) ? rooms[id(L)] : null;
  function check(L) {
    const F = floor(L), B = L.board, errors = [];
    if (!F) return ['unknown handmade room ' + L.room];
    if (![B.w,B.h,B.roomX,B.roomY].every(Number.isInteger) || B.w < 2 || B.h < 2 ||
        B.roomX < 0 || B.roomY < 0 || B.roomX + B.w > F.w || B.roomY + B.h > F.h)
      errors.push('board is not on the ' + id(L) + ' sorting floor');
    return errors;
  }
  return {rooms, id, floor, check};
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = LEVELROOMS;
// Room and chapter are separate: the depot holds its gates and later flap chapter.
// Metadata does not unlock or advertise levels that have not been added to LEVELS.
// Swift: immutable Chapter: Codable; old progress continues to use the same level IDs.
const CHAPTERS = (function () {
  const data = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports ? require('../data/chapters.json') : CHAPTERS_DATA;
  const id = L => /^\d+-\d+$/.test(L.id) ? L.id.split('-')[0] : '';
  const get = L => data.chapters.find(c => c.id === id(L) && c.room === (L.room || 'office')) || null;
  function group(L) {
    const c = get(L);
    return c ? { id: c.group, title: c.groupTitle } : { id: L.room || 'office', title: L.room || 'The sorting office' };
  }
  function check(levels) {
    const errors = [], seen = new Set();
    for (const L of levels) {
      if (seen.has(L.id)) errors.push('duplicate level ' + L.id);
      seen.add(L.id);
      if (!get(L)) errors.push('unknown chapter or room for ' + L.id);
    }
    return errors;
  }
  return { id, get, group, check };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = CHAPTERS;
// Chapter presentation data and a shared-rules idle demo. Built on entry, then
// sampled by time; no separate cat rules, clock or allocations in frame paths.
const DEPOTCHAPTER=(function(){
  const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports;
  const R=node?require('./10_rules.js'):{grCreate,grTick,grResult,GR_COAT,GR_DIR,GE_RELEASED,GE_MOVED,GO_RUNNING};
  const B=node?require('./12_boardanim.js'):BOARDANIM;
  function demo(ox,oy){
    const level={id:'depot-chapter-demo',room:'depot',board:{w:6,h:4,roomX:0,roomY:0},timeLimit:32,
      hatches:[{x:5,y:1,dir:'L',cats:['ginger','blue','blue']}],
      gates:[{x:3,y:1,exits:['L','U']}],dogs:[{x:3,y:0}],
      flaps:[{x:2,y:3,side:'D',coat:'ginger'},{x:3,y:3,side:'D',coat:'blue'}],
      baskets:[{x:0,y:0,coat:'blue'}],tray:{ginger:1,plain:1,blue:0}},
      turns=[{x:2,y:1,type:'ginger',dir:'D'},{x:0,y:1,type:'plain',dir:'U'}],
      s=R.grCreate(level,turns),traces=[],gates=B.makeGateTrace(96),ends=[],hatch=level.hatches[0];
    for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){
      const tr=B.makeTrace(34);tr.ox=ox;tr.oy=oy;tr.tick=.3;tr.pop=.3;
      tr.coat=s.coat[i];tr.hx=hatch.x;tr.hy=hatch.y;tr.hatchDir=R.GR_DIR[hatch.dir];tr.bw=6;tr.bh=4;
      tr.look=i;tr.blinkPhase=i*7;traces.push(tr);
    }
    while(s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){
      const time=(s.tick+1)*300/1000;R.grTick(s);B.recordGates(gates,s,time);
      for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){
        const tr=traces[i];
        if(s.ev[i]===R.GE_RELEASED)tr.rel=time;
        else if(s.ev[i]>=R.GE_MOVED){
          B.record(tr,s.px[i],s.py[i],s.pdir[i],s.x[i],s.y[i],s.dir[i],s.ev[i],s.bounced[i]);
          B.recordDestination(tr,s,i);
        }
      }
    }
    for(const tr of traces){
      tr.napUntil=tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+B.T_NAP+2;tr.leaveDir=3;
      ends.push(tr.homeKind==='flap'?tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+3:tr.napUntil+B.WAKE_LEN+B.LEAVE_LEN+.6);
    }
    return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,loop:16,final:R.grResult(s)};
  }
  function growth(stage,frame,out){
    const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(frame-24)/120)),u=t*t*(3-2*t);
    out.offset=(stage-1)*20+u*20;
    const d=out.driver;d.x=76+out.offset;d.y=168;d.face=1;d.hold=1;
    d.walk=frame>=24&&frame<144?Math.floor(frame/6)&3:-1;d.bob=d.walk>=0?d.walk&1:0;
    return out;
  }
  return {demo,growth};
})();

// Immutable carriage layout and analytic ambient motion. No renderer or game rules.
const TRAIN=(function(){
 const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports;
 const CFG=node?require('../data/train.json'):TRAIN_DATA,D=node?require('./19b_depot'):DEPOT;
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,mod=f=>((Math.floor(f)%2880)+2880)%2880;
 function boxes(r){
  const a=[r.base,r.underframe,[-4,-4,0,r.room.w+4,4,r.room.wallH],[-4,0,0,0,r.room.d+4,r.room.wallH],...r.roofBands];
  for(const f of r.furniture)for(const b of f.parts)a.push(b);
  for(const p of r.bags)a.push([p.x-7,p.y-4,p.z,p.x+7,p.y+4,p.z+24]);
  for(const p of r.lamps)a.push([p.x-10,p.y-5,p.z,p.x+10,p.y+5,p.z+12]);
  return a;
 }
 function hidden(r,extra){
  const a=[];for(const f of r.furniture)for(const b of f.parts)a.push(b.concat(f.id));
  for(const b of r.roofBands)a.push(b.concat('roof'));
  for(const p of r.bags)a.push([p.x-7,p.y-4,p.z,p.x+7,p.y+4,p.z+24,'mailbag']);
  for(const p of r.lamps)a.push([p.x-10,p.y-5,p.z,p.x+10,p.y+5,p.z+12,'lamp']);
  if(extra)a.push(...extra);
  const out=[];for(const b of a){const tile=D.hidesTile(r.board,b);if(tile)out.push({what:b[6],tile});}return out;
 }
 function build(data){
  const r=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data||CFG));r.id='train';
  const b={sx0:Infinity,sy0:Infinity,sx1:-Infinity,sy1:-Infinity};
  for(const q of boxes(r))for(const x of [q[0],q[3]])for(const y of [q[1],q[4]])for(const z of [q[2],q[5]]){
   b.sx0=Math.min(b.sx0,x-y);b.sx1=Math.max(b.sx1,x-y);b.sy0=Math.min(b.sy0,(x+y)/2-z);b.sy1=Math.max(b.sy1,(x+y)/2-z);
  }
  for(const k of ['sx0','sy0'])b[k]=Math.floor(b[k]);for(const k of ['sx1','sy1'])b[k]=Math.ceil(b[k]);
  if(b.sx1-b.sx0+24>720||b.sy1-b.sy0+24>400)throw new RangeError('Train exceeds720x400 world layer');r.bounds=b;return r;
 }
 function create(r){return step({room:r,frame:0,light:0,signal:0,bags:new Int8Array(r.bags.length),lamps:new Int8Array(r.lamps.length),sorter:{x:r.actors.sorter[0],y:r.actors.sorter[1],z:0,action:'sort',pose:0,face:3},pm:{x:r.actors.postmistress[0],y:r.actors.postmistress[1],z:r.actors.postmistress[2],head:0}},0);}
 function step(s,frame){
  const f=mod(frame),p=s.sorter;s.frame=f;s.light=Math.round((1-Math.cos(f/2880*TAU))*15.5);s.signal=f%960<480?0:1;
  for(let i=0;i<s.bags.length;i++)s.bags[i]=Math.round(Math.sin(f/240*TAU+i*.8));
  for(let i=0;i<s.lamps.length;i++)s.lamps[i]=Math.round(Math.sin(f/320*TAU+i*.6)*.75);
  p.x=84;p.y=22;p.z=0;p.action='sort';p.pose=Math.floor(f/6)%4;
  if(f>=600&&f<840){p.x=84-(f-600)/240*54;p.y=22+(f-600)/240*14;p.action='walk';}
  else if(f>=840&&f<1080){p.x=30;p.y=36;p.action='tea';}
  else if(f>=1080&&f<1320){p.x=30+(f-1080)/240*54;p.y=36-(f-1080)/240*14;p.action='walk';}
  else if(f>=1320&&f<1560){p.action='watch';p.pose=Math.floor((f-1320)/60);}
  else if(f>=2040&&f<2280){p.x=84+(f-2040)/240*82;p.action='walk';}
  else if(f>=2280&&f<2520)p.x=166;
  else if(f>=2520&&f<2760){p.x=166-(f-2520)/240*82;p.action='walk';}
  p.face=p.action==='walk'?(f<840||f>=2520?2:1):p.action==='watch'?0:p.action==='tea'?2:3;
  if(p.action!=='walk')p.x+=Math.sin(f/240*TAU)*.35;
  s.pm.head=Math.round(Math.sin(f/960*TAU)*.8);return s;
 }
 return {CFG,build,hidden,create,step};
})();
if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=TRAIN;
// Shared-rule teaching traces and a seekable, presentation-only station clock.
const TRAINCHAPTER=(function(){
 const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports,R=node?require('./10_rules'):{grCreate,grTick,grResult,GR_COAT,GR_DIR,GE_RELEASED,GE_MOVED,GO_RUNNING},B=node?require('./12_boardanim'):BOARDANIM;
 function demo(ox,oy){

   hatches:[{x:3,y:2,dir:'U',cats:['ginger','ginger','blue','blue']}],gates:[{x:3,y:1,exits:['R','L']}],dogs:[],

  }

  return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,loop:12,final:R.grResult(s)};
 }
 function station(stage,frame,out){
  const f=Math.max(0,frame),t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f-45)/120)),u=t*t*(3-2*t);
  out.approach=stage===2?96*(1-u):0;out.joint=stage===2?Math.max(0,Math.min(3,Math.floor((f-165)/8))):3;
  out.bump=stage===2&&f>=165&&f<213?-Math.sin((f-165)/48*Math.PI)*1.25:0;
  out.phase=f<45?0:f<165?1:f<213?2:3;out.lightFrame=stage===1?900:stage===2?1200:1440;return out;
 }
 return {demo,station};
})();
