// City Hall's immutable layout and projected clearance.16wu tiles; pure Node/Swift data.
const CITYHALL=(function(){
 const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports,CFG=node?require('../data/cityhall.json'):CITYHALL_DATA,D=node?require('./19b_depot'):DEPOT;
 const finite=v=>Array.isArray(v)&&v.every(Number.isFinite);
 // Snapshot source-local geometry once. Anchored drawings consume XY; fixed drawings
 // retain their native coordinates. Neither may silently keep stale declarations.
 const anchored=new Set(['palm','sorting-table','supervisor-desk','bench','trolley']),models=new Map();
 for(const f of CFG.furniture)models.set(f.id,{kind:f.kind,anchor:f.anchor.slice(),parts:f.parts.map(b=>b.slice()),solidParts:f.solidParts?.map(b=>b.slice())});
 function furnitureGeometry(f){
  const m=models.get(f.id)||Array.from(models.values()).find(m=>m.kind===f.kind);
  if(!m)return f.solidParts||f.parts;
  if(f.kind!==m.kind||!finite(f.anchor)||f.anchor.length!==3)throw new RangeError('Invalid furniture anchor '+f.id);
  const moving=anchored.has(f.kind),dx=f.anchor[0]-m.anchor[0],dy=f.anchor[1]-m.anchor[1];
  if(f.anchor[2]!==m.anchor[2]||!moving&&(dx||dy))throw new RangeError('Fixed native furniture anchor '+f.id);
  const translate=list=>list?.map(b=>b.map((v,k)=>v+(k%3===0?dx:k%3===1?dy:0)));
  const parts=translate(m.parts),solids=translate(m.solidParts);
  const matches=(a,b)=>!a&&!b||Array.isArray(a)&&Array.isArray(b)&&a.length===b.length&&a.every((q,i)=>finite(q)&&q.length===6&&q.every((v,k)=>Math.abs(v-b[i][k])<1e-8));
  if(!matches(f.parts,parts)||!matches(f.solidParts,solids))throw new RangeError('Furniture footprint differs from its anchor '+f.id);
  return solids||parts;
 }

 function volumes(r){
  const a=r.volumes.map(b=>b.concat('architecture')).concat(r.columns.map(b=>b.concat('column')));
  for(const f of r.furniture)for(const b of f.parts)a.push(b.concat(f.id));
  for(const route of r.routes)for(let i=1;i<route.points.length;i++){
   const p=route.points[i-1],q=route.points[i],v=route.radius;
   a.push([Math.min(p[0],q[0])-v,Math.min(p[1],q[1])-v,Math.min(p[2],q[2]),Math.max(p[0],q[0])+v,Math.max(p[1],q[1])+v,Math.max(p[2],q[2])+route.height,route.id]);
  }
  for(const p of r.pipes)for(let i=1;i<p.points.length;i++){
   const a0=p.points[i-1],b=p.points[i],v=p.radius;
   a.push([Math.min(a0[0],b[0])-v,Math.min(a0[1],b[1])-v,Math.min(a0[2],b[2])-v,Math.max(a0[0],b[0])+v,Math.max(a0[1],b[1])+v,Math.max(a0[2],b[2])+v,p.id]);
  }
  if(r.motionEnvelopes)for(const e of r.motionEnvelopes)a.push(e.bounds.concat(e.id));
  return a;
 }
 function hidden(r,extra){const out=[];for(const b of volumes(r).concat(extra||[])){if(b[5]<=0)continue;const tile=D.hidesTile(r.board,b);if(tile)out.push({what:b[6],tile});}return out;}
 // Visibility bounds include empty space; traffic uses the native solids instead.
 function staffObstacles(r){
  const out=[];
  for(const f of r.furniture){
   const parts=furnitureGeometry(f);
   for(const b of parts)out.push({id:f.id,bounds:b});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<r.columns.length;i++)out.push({id:'column-'+i,bounds:r.columns[i]});
  const z=r.gallery.z,w=r.gallery.width;
  out.push({id:'back gallery deck',bounds:[0,0,z-2,r.room.w,w,z]},{id:'left gallery deck',bounds:[0,0,z-2,w,r.room.d,z]},
   {id:'back gallery rail',bounds:[0,w-1,z-1,r.room.w,w+1,z+15]},{id:'left gallery rail',bounds:[w-1,0,z-1,w+1,r.room.d,z+15]});
  for(let i=0;i<r.windows.length;i++){
   const a=r.windows[i],back=a.wall==='Y';
   out.push({id:'window-'+i,bounds:back?[a.u0,8.9,a.z0,a.u1,9.1,a.z1]:[8.9,a.u0,a.z0,9.1,a.u1,a.z1]},
    {id:'window sill-'+i,bounds:back?[a.u0-1,1,a.z0-2,a.u1+1,10,a.z0]:[1,a.u0-1,a.z0-2,10,a.u1+1,a.z0]});
  }
  for(const p of r.pipes)for(let k=1;k<p.points.length;k++){
   const a=p.points[k-1],b=p.points[k],v=p.radius+.6;
   out.push({id:p.id,bounds:[Math.min(a[0],b[0])-v,Math.min(a[1],b[1])-v,Math.min(a[2],b[2])-v,Math.max(a[0],b[0])+v,Math.max(a[1],b[1])+v,Math.max(a[2],b[2])+v]});
  }
  for(const x of[110,140])out.push({id:'station hood-'+x,bounds:[x-4.2,27.8,27.8,x+4.2,42.2,39.2]});
  out.push({id:'left station hood',bounds:[21.8,27.8,29.8,30.2,42.2,40.2]});
  for(const t of[45,91,202])out.push({id:'back wall lamp-'+t,bounds:[t-2.5,10.5,68.5,t+2.5,17.5,78.5]});
  for(const t of[48,151])out.push({id:'left wall lamp-'+t,bounds:[10.5,t-2.5,68.5,17.5,t+2.5,78.5]});
  for(const b of r.volumes)if(b[2]>=90)out.push({id:'roof',bounds:b});
  out.push({id:'back wall',bounds:[-4,-4,0,r.room.w,0,112]},{id:'left wall',bounds:[-4,0,0,0,r.room.d,112]});
  return out;
 }
 // Accepted towards artwork looks left; rear artwork looks right.
 const staffMirror=face=>face===1||face===2;
 // Native blit mirrors about half a screen pixel; margin includes anchor rounding.
 function staffSpan(body,action,face){
  const a=body.spans[action][face===2||face===3?'away':'towards'],mirror=staffMirror(face);
  return [ (mirror?.5-a[1]:a[0])-body.margin,(mirror?.5-a[0]:a[1])+body.margin ];
 }
 // Load-time and verification queries only; the frame loop never allocates these bounds.
 function staffBounds(r,a){const u=staffSpan(r.staff,a.action,a.face);return [a.x+u[0],a.y-u[1],a.z-r.staff.sole,a.x+u[1],a.y-u[0],a.z+r.staff.height];}
 function staffSegmentHits(p,q,action,face,body,b){
  if(Math.max(p[2],q[2])+body.height<=b[2]||Math.min(p[2],q[2])-body.sole>=b[5])return false;
  const u=staffSpan(body,action,face);let lo=0,hi=1;
  for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
   const d=q[k]-p[k],min=b[k]-(k?-u[0]:u[1]),max=b[k+3]-(k?-u[1]:u[0]);
   if(!d){if(p[k]<=min||p[k]>=max)return false;}
   else{const a=(min-p[k])/d,c=(max-p[k])/d;lo=Math.max(lo,Math.min(a,c));hi=Math.min(hi,Math.max(a,c));if(lo>=hi)return false;}
  }
  return lo<hi;
 }
 function staffRouteIssues(r){
  const body=r.staff,obstacles=staffObstacles(r),out=[];
  if(!body||!Number.isFinite(body.height)||body.height<=0||!Number.isFinite(body.sole)||body.sole<0||!Number.isFinite(body.margin)||body.margin<0||['walk','read','check','sort','wave'].some(k=>['towards','away'].some(v=>!finite(body.spans?.[k]?.[v])||body.spans[k][v].length!==2||body.spans[k][v][0]>=body.spans[k][v][1])))throw new RangeError('Invalid staff clearance profile');
  for(const o of obstacles){const b=o.bounds;if(!finite(b)||b.length!==6||b[0]>=b[3]||b[1]>=b[4]||b[2]>=b[5])throw new RangeError('Invalid staff solid '+o.id);}
  if(!Array.isArray(r.routes)||r.routes.length<3)throw new RangeError('Missing staff routes');
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
   const route=r.routes[i],points=route.points,faces=i===0?[3,1,1,2,0]:i===1?[1,2]:[3,0];
   if(route.id!==['sorter','worker-back','worker-left'][i]||points.length!==faces.length+1||points.some(p=>p[2]!==points[0][2])||points[0].some((n,k)=>n!==points[points.length-1][k]))throw new RangeError('Invalid closed staff route');
   for(const o of obstacles)for(let k=1;k<points.length;k++)if(staffSegmentHits(points[k-1],points[k],'walk',faces[k-1],body,o.bounds))out.push({kind:'route',who:route.id,obstacle:o.id,segment:k-1});
  }
  const life=create(r),seen=new Set();
  for(let f=0;f<2880;f++){
   step(life,f);
   for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const a=life.workers[i];if(a.action==='walk')continue;
    const key=i+':'+a.x+':'+a.y+':'+a.action+':'+a.face;if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);
    const b=staffBounds(r,a);
    for(const o of obstacles)if(b[0]<o.bounds[3]&&b[3]>o.bounds[0]&&b[1]<o.bounds[4]&&b[4]>o.bounds[1]&&b[2]<o.bounds[5]&&b[5]>o.bounds[2])out.push({kind:'stationary',who:r.routes[i].id,obstacle:o.id,frame:f});
   }
  }
  for(const f of r.furniture)if(f.kind==='trolley'){
   const a=f.anchor,b=[a[0]-9,a[1]-11,0,a[0]+9,a[1]+11,27];
   if(f.parts.length!==1||b.some((v,k)=>v!==f.parts[0][k]))throw new RangeError('Trolley footprint differs from its anchor');
   for(const o of obstacles)if(o.id!==f.id&&b[0]<o.bounds[3]&&b[3]>o.bounds[0]&&b[1]<o.bounds[4]&&b[4]>o.bounds[1]&&b[2]<o.bounds[5]&&b[5]>o.bounds[2])out.push({kind:'parking',who:f.id,obstacle:o.id});
  }
  return out;
 }
 function build(data){
  const r=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data||CFG));
  if(r.board?.w!==8||r.board?.h!==6||r.board.x!==64||r.board.y!==64||!Number.isInteger(r.room?.w)||!Number.isInteger(r.room?.d)||r.room.w<216||r.room.d<184)throw new RangeError('City Hall requires its full8x6 sorting floor and margins');
  for(const route of r.routes){if(!Number.isFinite(route.radius)||route.radius<=0||!Number.isFinite(route.height)||route.height<=0||route.points.length<2||route.points.some(p=>!finite(p)||p.length!==3))throw new RangeError('Invalid City Hall route');}
  const b={sx0:Infinity,sy0:Infinity,sx1:-Infinity,sy1:-Infinity};
  for(const q of volumes(r)){
   if(!finite(q.slice(0,6))||q[0]>=q[3]||q[1]>=q[4]||q[2]>=q[5])throw new RangeError('Invalid City Hall volume '+q[6]);
   for(const x of[q[0],q[3]])for(const y of[q[1],q[4]])for(const z of[q[2],q[5]]){b.sx0=Math.min(b.sx0,x-y);b.sx1=Math.max(b.sx1,x-y);b.sy0=Math.min(b.sy0,(x+y)/2-z);b.sy1=Math.max(b.sy1,(x+y)/2-z);}
  }
  for(const k of['sx0','sy0'])b[k]=Math.floor(b[k]);for(const k of['sx1','sy1'])b[k]=Math.ceil(b[k]);
  if(b.sx1-b.sx0+24>720||b.sy1-b.sy0+24>400||r.room.w+8>720)throw new RangeError('City Hall exceeds720x400');
  if(hidden(r).length)throw new RangeError('City Hall scenery hides a board tile');
  const traffic=staffRouteIssues(r);if(traffic.length)throw new RangeError('Staff '+traffic[0].kind+': '+traffic[0].who+' intersects '+traffic[0].obstacle);
  r.bounds=b;return r;
 }
 const mod=f=>((Math.floor(f)%2880)+2880)%2880;
 function actor(x,y,z){return {x,y,z,face:0,action:'read',frame:0};}
 function create(r){return step({room:r,frame:0,clock:0,lightX:0,lightY:0,workers:r.routes.slice(0,3).map(p=>actor(...p.points[0])),
  pm:{x:26,y:120,z:26,state:3,frame:0,face:0,head:0,flick:0,bat:-1},pigeon:{x:8,y:40,z:111,state:'perch',frame:0,bob:0,face:1},
  capsules:[{x:66,y:24,z:35,visible:false},{x:24,y:32,z:36,vertical:true,visible:false}],
  puffs:[{x:26,y:38,z:31,visible:false,pose:0},{x:110,y:38,z:28,visible:false,pose:0},{x:140,y:38,z:28,visible:false,pose:0}],pressure:new Uint8Array(3)},0);}
 // Cosine ramps keep cruise pace even and bring both feet to a stop before turns.
 function move(a,f,from,to,p,q,face){
  const t=f-from,duration=to-from,r=24,left=duration-t;
  const travel=t<r?(t-r/Math.PI*Math.sin(Math.PI*t/r))*.5:left<r?duration-r-(left-r/Math.PI*Math.sin(Math.PI*left/r))*.5:t-r*.5;
  const u=travel/(duration-r),dx=q[0]-p[0],dy=q[1]-p[1],cycles=Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.hypot(dx,dy)/16));
  a.x=p[0]+dx*u;a.y=p[1]+dy*u;a.z=p[2]+(q[2]-p[2])*u;a.face=face;a.action='walk';a.frame=Math.floor(u*cycles*4+.5)%4;
 }
 function stand(a,p,face,action){a.x=p[0];a.y=p[1];a.z=p[2];a.face=face;a.action=action;a.frame=0;}
 function step(s,frame){
  const f=mod(frame),a=s.workers[0],path=s.room.routes[0].points,p0=path[0],p1=path[1],p2=path[2],p3=path[3];
  s.frame=f;s.clock=Math.floor(f/240)%12;s.lightX=Math.sin(f/2880*Math.PI*2)*3;s.lightY=Math.cos(f/2880*Math.PI*2)*2;
  stand(a,p0,f<156||f>=2796?0:3,'check');
  if(f>=180&&f<516)move(a,f,180,516,p0,p1,3);
  else if(f>=516&&f<552)stand(a,p1,f<534?3:1,'check');
  else if(f>=552&&f<876)move(a,f,552,876,p1,p2,1);
  else if(f>=876&&f<1296)stand(a,p2,f<894||f>=1278?1:3,'sort');
  else if(f>=1296&&f<1452)move(a,f,1296,1452,p2,p3,1);
  else if(f>=1452&&f<1728)stand(a,p3,f<1470?1:3,'check');
  else if(f>=1728&&f<1908)stand(a,p3,0,'wave');
  else if(f>=1908&&f<1944)stand(a,p3,f<1926?0:2,'check');
  else if(f>=1944&&f<2400)move(a,f,1944,2400,p3,path[4],2);
  else if(f>=2400&&f<2436)stand(a,path[4],f<2418?2:0,'check');
  else if(f>=2436&&f<2796)move(a,f,2436,2796,path[4],path[5],0);
  for(let i=1;i<3;i++){
   const p=s.workers[i],t=(f+(i-1)*480)%1440,back=i===1,route=s.room.routes[i].points,outEnd=back?600:720,inStart=back?1080:960;
   const turning=t<18||t>=222;stand(p,route[0],t<18?(back?2:0):t>=222?(back?1:3):(back?0:1),turning?'check':'read');
   if(t>=240&&t<outEnd)move(p,t,240,outEnd,route[0],route[1],back?1:3);
   else if(t>=outEnd&&t<inStart){const turn=t<outEnd+18||t>=inStart-18;stand(p,route[1],t<outEnd+18?(back?1:3):t>=inStart-18?(back?2:0):(back?0:1),turn?'check':'read');}
   else if(t>=inStart)move(p,t,inStart,1440,route[1],route[2],back?2:0);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){s.pressure[i]=Math.round(1+Math.sin(f/480*Math.PI*2+i));const p=s.puffs[i],age=(f+i*60)%360;p.visible=age>=6&&age<36;p.pose=Math.min(3,Math.floor(age/9));}
  const p=s.pm;p.frame=Math.floor(f/240)%6;p.head=Math.floor(p.frame/2);p.flick=p.frame&1;
  const age=(f+48)%480;p.bat=age<24?0:age<64?1:age<81?2:age<108?3:-1;
  const b=s.pigeon,t=(f%960)/960,v=t<.5?t*2:2-t*2;b.y=40+92*v;b.face=t<.5?0:1;b.state=f%480<60?'peck':'perch';b.frame=Math.floor(f/30)&1;b.bob=b.frame;
  const c=s.capsules[0],d=s.capsules[1],u=(f%480)/480,w=((f+240)%480)/480;c.x=66+144*u;c.visible=c.x>=132&&c.x<=164;d.y=32+134*w;d.visible=d.y>=82&&d.y<=108;
  return s;
 }
 return {CFG,build,hidden,volumes,staffMirror,staffObstacles,staffBounds,staffRouteIssues,create,step};

})();

// Shared-rule Hall teaching. Build traces once; CP samples them without live mutations.
const CITYCHAPTER=(function(){
 const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports,R=node?require('./10_rules'):{grCreate,grTick,grResult,GR_DIR,GE_RELEASED,GE_MOVED,GO_RUNNING},B=node?require('./12_boardanim'):BOARDANIM;
 function demo(ox,oy){
  const level={id:'cityhall-chapter-demo',room:'cityhall',board:{w:7,h:5,roomX:0,roomY:0},timeLimit:32,
   hatches:[{x:0,y:2,dir:'R',cats:['blue','ginger','ginger']}],tunnels:[{a:{x:2,y:2},b:{x:4,y:2},symbol:'circle'}],
   gates:[{x:5,y:2,exits:['U','D']}],dogs:[{x:5,y:3}],baskets:[{x:5,y:0,coat:'blue'}],flaps:[{x:2,y:4,side:'D',coat:'ginger'}],tray:{ginger:1,plain:1,blue:0}},
   turns=[{x:5,y:1,type:'ginger',dir:'L'},{x:4,y:1,type:'plain',dir:'D'}],s=R.grCreate(level,turns),traces=[],gates=B.makeGateTrace(96),ends=[],h=level.hatches[0];
  for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const tr=B.makeTrace(34);tr.ox=ox;tr.oy=oy;tr.tick=tr.pop=.3;tr.coat=s.coat[i];tr.hx=h.x;tr.hy=h.y;tr.hatchDir=R.GR_DIR[h.dir];tr.bw=7;tr.bh=5;tr.look=i;tr.blinkPhase=i*7;traces.push(tr);}
  while(s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){const t=Math.round((s.tick+1)*300)/1000;R.grTick(s);B.recordGates(gates,s,t);
   for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const tr=traces[i];if(s.ev[i]===R.GE_RELEASED)tr.rel=t;else if(s.ev[i]>=R.GE_MOVED){B.record(tr,s.px[i],s.py[i],s.pdir[i],s.x[i],s.y[i],s.dir[i],s.ev[i],s.bounced[i]);B.recordDestination(tr,s,i);}}}
  for(const tr of traces)ends.push(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+6);
  return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,loop:15,final:R.grResult(s)};
 }
 function growth(stage,frame,out){
  const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(frame-30)/180)),u=t*t*(3-2*t),length=stage===1?92:76;
  out.u=u;out.pose=Math.min(31,Math.floor(u*32));out.visible=u<1;out.z=0;
  out.x=stage===1?94+length*u:164;out.y=stage===1?132:94+length*u;
  out.face=stage===1?1:0;out.walk=t>0&&t<1?Math.floor(u*length/4)%4:-1;
  return out;
 }
 const H=node?require('./19i_cityhall'):CITYHALL,dispatchLife=H.create(H.CFG);

 }
 return {demo,growth,dispatch};

const PARCEL=(function(){

 const finite=a=>Array.isArray(a)&&a.every(Number.isFinite),hit=(a,b)=>a[0]<b[3]&&a[3]>b[0]&&a[1]<b[4]&&a[4]>b[1]&&a[2]<b[5]&&a[5]>b[2];
 function volumes(r){
  const w=r.room.w,d=r.room.d,h=r.room.wallH,b=r.bay;
  return [[-6,-6,-9,w+6,d+6,0,'base'],r.yard.concat('yard'),[-4,-4,0,0,d,h,'wall-x'],[0,-4,0,b.x0,0,h,'bay-left'],[b.x1,-4,0,w,0,h,'bay-right'],[b.x0,-4,b.h,b.x1,0,h,'bay-lintel'],...r.furniture.map(f=>f.visibility.concat(f.id)),...r.motionEnvelopes.map(e=>e.bounds.concat(e.id)),...r.lamps.map((p,i)=>[i? p[0]-4:0,i?0:p[1]-4,p[2]-.5,p[0]+4,p[1]+4,p[2]+7.5,'lamp-'+i]),[96,-58,0,256,-54,65,'yard-sky'],[2,82,34,3,132,65,'wall-details']];
 }
 function hidden(r,extra){const out=[];for(const b of volumes(r).concat(extra||[])){if(b[5]<=0)continue;const t=D.hidesTile(r.board,b);if(t)out.push({what:b[6],tile:t});}return out;}
 // Union of measured native carry/hold gait extents; existing rooms retain their profiles.
 const CARRY_SPANS={towards:[-4.1875,3.9375],away:[-3.5625,4.4375]};
 const HANDLING_SPANS={towards:[[-4.9375,2.9375],[-4.9375,2.9375],[-4.8125,3.1875]],away:[[-3.1875,5.4375],[-3.1875,5.4375],[-2.9375,5.1875]]};

 function staffBounds(r,a){const u=(a.handling>=0&&a.handling<3?HANDLING_SPANS:a.action==='carry-walk'||a.action==='push'?CARRY_SPANS:STAFF.spans[a.action==='carry'?'read':a.action])[a.face<2?'towards':'away'],span=a.handling>=0&&a.handling<3?u[a.handling]:a.face>=2&&(a.handling===3||a.action==='carry'||a.action==='read')?REAR_CARRY:a.face>=2&&a.action==='sort'?REAR_WRAP:u,m=staffMirror(a.face),lo=(m?.5-span[1]:span[0])-STAFF.margin,hi=(m?.5-span[0]:span[1])+STAFF.margin;return [a.x+lo,a.y-hi,a.z-STAFF.sole,a.x+hi,a.y-lo,a.z+STAFF.height];}
 function staffIssues(r){
  const s=create(r),out=[];
  for(let f=0;f<2880;f++){step(s,f);const b=staffBounds(r,s.sorter);for(const o of r.solids)if(hit(b,o.bounds))out.push({frame:f,obstacle:o.id});}
  return out;
 }
 function build(data){
  const r=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data||CFG)),b=r.board;
  if(b?.x!==80||b.y!==80||b.w!==9||b.h!==7||r.room?.w!==256||r.room.d!==224||r.room.wallH!==84)throw new RangeError('Parcel requires full9x7 floor and reserved aprons');
  if(!Array.isArray(r.route)||r.route.length<2||r.route.some(p=>!finite(p)||p.length!==3||p[2]!==0)||r.route[0].some((v,i)=>v!==r.route.at(-1)[i]))throw new RangeError('Invalid closed staff route');
  if(!Array.isArray(r.timeline)||r.timeline[0][0]!==0||r.timeline.at(-1)[0]!==2880||r.timeline.some((k,i)=>!Number.isInteger(k[0])||i&&k[0]<=r.timeline[i-1][0]||!r.route[k[1]]||!Number.isInteger(k[2])||k[2]<0||k[2]>3||!['walk','carry-walk','carry','push','read','sort','check'].includes(k[3])))throw new RangeError('Invalid staff timeline');
  for(let i=1;i<r.route.length;i++)if(r.route[i][0]!==r.route[i-1][0]&&r.route[i][1]!==r.route[i-1][1])throw new RangeError('Staff route needs stopped right-angle pivots');
  for(const f of r.furniture){if(!['rack','rack-left','bench','tea','floor-scale','box-stack','hand-truck','conveyor','trolley','packing-supplies'].includes(f.kind)||!finite(f.anchor)||f.anchor.length!==3||!finite(f.size)||f.size.length!==3||f.size.some(n=>n<=0))throw new RangeError('Invalid parcel furniture');const a=f.anchor,z=f.size;f.parts=[[...a,a[0]+z[0],a[1]+z[1],a[2]+z[2]]];
   if(f.kind==='bench')f.parts.push([a[0]-1,a[1]-.5,z[2]-1,a[0]+z[0]+1,a[1]+z[1]+.5,z[2]+1],[a[0]+2,a[1]+2,z[2]+1,a[0]+8,a[1]+8,z[2]+12]);
   if(f.kind==='tea')f.parts.push([a[0]-1,a[1]-1,z[2]-1,a[0]+z[0]+1,a[1]+z[1]+1,z[2]+1],[a[0]+4,a[1]+z[1],z[2]+1,a[0]+21,a[1]+z[1]+.2,z[2]+18]);
   if(f.kind==='trolley')f.parts.push([a[0]+1,a[1]+10,9,a[0]+7,a[1]+25,15]);
   if(f.kind==='hand-truck')f.parts=[[a[0]-2,a[1]-2,0,a[0]+z[0]+2,a[1]+z[1]+1,z[2]+6]];
   f.visibility=[Infinity,Infinity,Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity];for(const b of f.parts)for(let i=0;i<3;i++){f.visibility[i]=Math.min(f.visibility[i],b[i]);f.visibility[i+3]=Math.max(f.visibility[i+3],b[i+3]+.5);}
   if(f.kind==='packing-supplies'){f.visibility[0]-=.5;f.visibility[1]-=6;f.visibility[3]+=.5;f.visibility[4]+=1;}
  }
  r.solids=r.furniture.flatMap(f=>f.parts.map(b=>({id:f.id,bounds:b})));for(const b of volumes(r))if(['wall-x','bay-left','bay-right','bay-lintel'].includes(b[6]))r.solids.push({id:b[6],bounds:b.slice(0,6)});
  const bounds={sx0:Infinity,sy0:Infinity,sx1:-Infinity,sy1:-Infinity};
  for(const q of volumes(r)){if(!finite(q.slice(0,6))||q[0]>=q[3]||q[1]>=q[4]||q[2]>=q[5])throw new RangeError('Invalid parcel volume');for(const x of[q[0],q[3]])for(const y of[q[1],q[4]])for(const z of[q[2],q[5]]){bounds.sx0=Math.min(bounds.sx0,x-y);bounds.sx1=Math.max(bounds.sx1,x-y);bounds.sy0=Math.min(bounds.sy0,(x+y)/2-z);bounds.sy1=Math.max(bounds.sy1,(x+y)/2-z);}}
  for(const k of['sx0','sy0'])bounds[k]=Math.floor(bounds[k]);for(const k of['sx1','sy1'])bounds[k]=Math.ceil(bounds[k]);
  if(bounds.sx1-bounds.sx0+24>720||bounds.sy1-bounds.sy0+24>400)throw new RangeError('Parcel exceeds720x400 world layer');
  if(hidden(r).length)throw new RangeError('Parcel scenery hides a board tile');if(staffIssues(r).length)throw new RangeError('Staff route crosses furniture');r.bounds=bounds;return r;
 }
 function create(r){return step({room:r,frame:0,sorter:{x:0,y:0,z:0,face:0,action:'check',frame:0,handling:-1,grip:false,handX:0,handY:0,handZ:10},kitten:{x:243,y:165,z:0,pose:0,frame:0,face:1,look:0},toy:{x:247,y:161,z:1,angle:0},pm:{x:26,y:188,z:35,state:0,frame:0,face:0,head:0,flick:0},parcels:[{x:0,y:0,z:0,visible:true,place:'van',wrapped:false}],dispatch:{x:185,y:49,z:0},van:{x:185,y:0,loaded:false,departing:false,closed:false,cargo:'incoming',trip:0},roller:0,scale:0,lift:0},0);}
 function stand(a,p,face,action){a.x=p[0];a.y=p[1];a.z=p[2];a.face=face;a.action=action;a.frame=0;}
 function move(a,f,start,end,p,q,face){const t=f-start,duration=end-start,r=12,left=duration-t,travel=t<r?(t-r/Math.PI*Math.sin(Math.PI*t/r))*.5:left<r?duration-r-(left-r/Math.PI*Math.sin(Math.PI*left/r))*.5:t-r*.5,u=travel/(duration-r);a.x=p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*u;a.y=p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*u;a.z=0;a.face=face;a.action='walk';a.frame=Math.floor(u*Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1])/16))*4+.5)%4;}
 const smooth=t=>{t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
 function set(p,place,x,y,z){p.place=place;p.x=x;p.y=y;p.z=z;}
 function transfer(p,f,start,end,x,y,z,X,Y,Z){const t=smooth((f-start)/(end-start));set(p,'transfer',x+(X-x)*t,y+(Y-y)*t,z+(Z-z)*t);}
 function handlingTransfer(p,a,f,start,end,x,y,z,X,Y,Z,put){
  const t=(f-start)/(end-start);
  a.handling=put?(t<.12?3:t<.4?2:t<.55?1:t<.7?0:t<.8?1:t<.9?2:3):(t<.2?0:t<.35?1:t<.8?2:3);
  a.grip=put?t<.55:t>=.2;
  const u=smooth((t-(put?.12:.35))/(put?.43:.45));set(p,'transfer',x+(X-x)*u,y+(Y-y)*u,z+(Z-z)*u);
 }
 function play(s,f){
  const t=f%1440,c=s.kitten,b=s.toy;c.x=243;c.y=165;c.z=0;c.pose=0;c.frame=0;c.face=1;c.look=0;b.x=247;b.y=161;b.z=1;b.angle=0;
  if(t>=180&&t<240)c.pose=1;
  else if(t>=240&&t<450){const u=smooth((t-258)/192);c.y=165-49*u;c.pose=2;c.frame=Math.floor(u*49/3)%4;c.z=t<306?Math.sin(Math.max(0,(t-258)/48)*Math.PI)*2:0;b.y=161-49*smooth((t-240)/150);}
  else if(t>=450&&t<540){const u=smooth((t-450)/90);c.x=243+8*u;c.y=116-8*u;c.pose=2;c.frame=Math.floor(u*16/3)%4;b.y=112;}
  else if(t>=540&&t<720){c.x=251;c.y=108;c.face=0;c.pose=t>=660?1:0;b.y=112;}
  else if(t>=720&&t<984){const u=smooth((t-744)/240);c.x=251;c.y=108+49*u;c.face=0;c.pose=2;c.frame=Math.floor(u*49/3)%4;c.z=t>=744&&t<792?Math.sin((t-744)/48*Math.PI)*2:0;b.y=112+49*smooth((t-720)/210);}
  else if(t>=984&&t<1080){c.x=251;c.y=157;c.face=0;}
  else if(t>=1080&&t<1200){const u=smooth((t-1080)/120);c.x=251-8*u;c.y=157+8*u;c.face=0;c.pose=2;c.frame=Math.floor(u*16/3)%4;}
  b.angle=(161-b.y)*.4;c.z=Math.max(0,c.z);c.look=c.pose===0&&(t>=30&&t<110||t>=1240&&t<1320)?1:0;
 }
 function step(s,frame){
  if(!Number.isFinite(frame))throw new RangeError('Invalid warehouse frame');const f=((Math.floor(frame)%2880)+2880)%2880,r=s.room,a=s.sorter,keys=r.timeline;s.frame=f;
  let k=0;while(k<keys.length-2&&f>=keys[k+1][0])k++;const key=keys[k],next=keys[k+1],p=r.route[key[1]],q=r.route[next[1]],moving=p[0]!==q[0]||p[1]!==q[1];
  stand(a,p,key[2],key[3]);a.handling=-1;a.grip=false;
  if(moving){move(a,f,key[0],next[0],p,q,key[2]);a.action=key[3];}
  // Accepted cut-out views turn as a unit. Never interpolate cargo through a body.
  const handSide=a.face===1||a.face===3?1:-1;a.handX=a.x+handSide*4;a.handY=a.y-handSide*4;a.handZ=10;
  play(s,f);
  const c=s.pm;c.state=f<1920||f>=2640?0:f<1980?1:3;c.frame=c.state===0?Math.floor(f/120)%2:c.state===3?Math.floor(f/240)%6:0;c.head=c.state===3?Math.floor(c.frame/2):0;c.flick=c.frame&1;
  const v=s.van;v.loaded=f>=2196;v.cargo=f<252?'incoming':f<2196?'empty':'outgoing';v.closed=f<144||f>=2268;v.departing=f>=2340&&f<2700;v.trip=0;
  v.x=f<144?110+75*smooth(f/144):f<2400?185:f<2700?185-75*smooth((f-2400)/300):110;v.y=f<144?-2:f<180?-2+14*smooth((f-144)/36):f<2340?12:f<2400?12-14*smooth((f-2340)/60):-2;
  const cart=s.dispatch;cart.x=185;cart.y=f<1908?49:f<2058?a.y-12:f<2268?11:f<2412?a.y-12:49;
  const box=s.parcels[0],hx=a.handX,hy=a.handY,hz=a.handZ;box.visible=true;box.wrapped=f>=1008;
  if(f<180||f>=2196)set(box,'van',v.x,v.y-12,11);
  else if(f<252)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,180,252,185,0,11,hx,hy,hz,false);
  else if(f<768)set(box,'hand',hx,hy,hz);
  else if(f<816)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,768,816,hx,hy,hz,53,61,10,true);
  else if(f<840)set(box,'incoming',53,61,10);
  else if(f<876)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,840,876,53,61,10,hx,hy,hz,false);
  else if(f<900)set(box,'hand',hx,hy,hz);
  else if(f<948)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,900,948,hx,hy,hz,67,49,9,true);
  else if(f<1080)set(box,'bench',67,49,9);
  else if(f<1128)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,1080,1128,67,49,9,hx,hy,hz,false);
  else if(f<1296)set(box,'hand',hx,hy,hz);
  else if(f<1344)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,1296,1344,hx,hy,hz,98,50,8,true);
  else if(f<1560)set(box,'belt',98+(r.weighing.x-98)*smooth((f-1344)/216),r.weighing.y,r.weighing.z);
  else if(f<1620)set(box,'scale',r.weighing.x,r.weighing.y,r.weighing.z);
  else if(f<1668)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,1620,1668,r.weighing.x,r.weighing.y,r.weighing.z,hx,hy,hz,false);
  else if(f<1818)set(box,'hand',hx,hy,hz);
  else if(f<1872)handlingTransfer(box,a,f,1818,1872,hx,hy,hz,185,49,10,true);
  else if(f<2082)set(box,'dispatch',cart.x,cart.y,10);
  else transfer(box,f,2082,2196,185,11,10,185,0,11);
  if(box.place==='hand')a.grip=true;
  s.roller=box.place==='belt'?Math.floor((f-1344)/18)%4:0;
  s.scale=box.place==='scale'?f<1572?1:f<1596?2:1:0;
  s.lift=f<1800?0:f<2040?Math.min(3,Math.floor((f-1800)/60)):f<2400?3:Math.max(0,3-Math.floor((f-2400)/60));
  return s;
 }
 return {CFG,build,volumes,hidden,staffMirror,staffBounds,staffIssues,create,step};
})();

const PARCELCHAPTER=(function(){
 const node=typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports,R=node?require('./10_rules'):{grCreate,grTick,grResult,GR_DIR,GE_RELEASED,GE_MOVED,GO_RUNNING},B=node?require('./12_boardanim'):BOARDANIM;
 function demo(ox,oy){
  const level={id:'parcel-chapter-demo',room:'parcel',board:{w:7,h:6,roomX:0,roomY:0},timeLimit:40,
   hatches:[{x:0,y:2,dir:'R',cats:[{coat:'ginger',big:true},'blue','blue']}],gates:[{x:5,y:2,exits:['U','D']}],dogs:[],
   baskets:[{x:5,y:0,coat:'blue'},{x:5,y:5,coat:'blue'},{x:6,y:1,coat:'ginger'}],tray:{plain:0,ginger:1,blue:0}},
   turns=[{x:5,y:1,type:'ginger',dir:'R'}],s=R.grCreate(level,turns),traces=[],gates=B.makeGateTrace(120),ends=[],h=level.hatches[0];
  for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const tr=B.makeTrace(42);tr.ox=ox;tr.oy=oy;tr.tick=tr.pop=.3;tr.coat=s.coat[i];tr.big=!!s.big[i];tr.hx=h.x;tr.hy=h.y;tr.hatchDir=R.GR_DIR[h.dir];tr.bw=7;tr.bh=6;tr.look=i;tr.blinkPhase=i*7;traces.push(tr);}
  while(s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){const t=Math.round((s.tick+1)*300)/1000;R.grTick(s);B.recordGates(gates,s,t);
   for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const tr=traces[i];if(s.ev[i]===R.GE_RELEASED)tr.rel=t;else if(s.ev[i]>=R.GE_MOVED){B.record(tr,s.px[i],s.py[i],s.pdir[i],s.x[i],s.y[i],s.dir[i],s.ev[i],s.bounced[i]);B.recordDestination(tr,s,i);}}}
  for(const tr of traces)ends.push(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+6);
  return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,loop:16,final:R.grResult(s)};
 }
 function growth(stage,frame,out){
  if(!Number.isInteger(stage)||stage<1||stage>3||!Number.isFinite(frame))throw new RangeError('Invalid parcel growth shot');
  const f=Math.max(0,frame),t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f-90)/240)),u=t*t*(3-2*t),startY=stage===1?168:184,travel=(208-startY)*u;
  out.x=stage===1?200:stage===2?184:216;out.y=startY+travel;out.lift=Math.min(3,Math.max(0,Math.floor((f-30)/20)));
  out.walk=t>0&&t<1?Math.floor(travel/4)%4:-1;out.face=0;out.workerX=out.x+4;out.workerY=out.y-9.5;out.revealed=f>=330;return out;
 }
 const P=node?require('./19k_parcel'):PARCEL,dispatchLife=P.create(P.CFG);
 function dispatch(frame,out){
  if(!Number.isFinite(frame))throw new RangeError('Invalid parcel dispatch shot');
  out.worldFrame=Math.min(2699,1908+Math.max(0,frame));P.step(dispatchLife,out.worldFrame);const p=dispatchLife.parcels[0];
  out.bagX=p.x+2;out.bagY=p.y-1;out.bagZ=p.z+6;out.visible=!dispatchLife.van.closed;out.stopped=out.worldFrame===2699;return out;
 }
 return {demo,growth,dispatch};
})();

const CHRISTMAS=(function(){

 function create(r){return step({room:r,frame:0,staff:r.staff.map(()=>({x:0,y:0,z:0,face:0,action:'check',frame:0,handling:-1})),pm:{x:12,y:40,z:42,state:2,frame:0,face:0,head:0,flick:0},snow:r.windows.flatMap((w,i)=>Array.from({length:6},(_,j)=>({window:i,wall:w.wall,seed:j,u:0,z:0,visible:false}))),light:0,record:0},0);}

const CHRISTMASCHAPTER=(function(){

 function demo(ox,oy){
  const level={id:'christmas-chapter-demo',room:'christmas',board:{w:8,h:7,roomX:0,roomY:0},timeLimit:40,
   hatches:[{x:4,y:0,dir:'D',cats:[{coat:'blue',big:true},'ginger']},{x:4,y:6,dir:'U',cats:['blue',{coat:'ginger',big:true}]}],
   gates:[{x:4,y:3,exits:['L','R']}],tunnels:[{a:{x:3,y:3},b:{x:1,y:2},symbol:'circle'}],dogs:[],baskets:[],
   flaps:[{x:0,y:0,side:'U',coat:'blue'},{x:7,y:3,side:'R',coat:'ginger'}],tray:{plain:1,ginger:0,blue:0}},
   turns=[{x:0,y:2,type:'plain',dir:'U'}],s=R.grCreate(level,turns),traces=[],gates=B.makeGateTrace(160),ends=[];
  for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const h=level.hatches[s.hatches.findIndex(h=>i>=h.first&&i<h.first+h.count)],tr=B.makeTrace(42);tr.big=!!s.big[i];tr.ox=ox;tr.oy=oy;tr.tick=tr.pop=.3;tr.coat=s.coat[i];tr.hx=h.x;tr.hy=h.y;tr.hatchDir=R.GR_DIR[h.dir];tr.bw=8;tr.bh=7;tr.look=i;tr.blinkPhase=i*7;traces.push(tr);}
  while(s.outcome===R.GO_RUNNING){const t=Math.round((s.tick+1)*300)/1000;R.grTick(s);B.recordGates(gates,s,t);
   for(let i=0;i<s.n;i++){const tr=traces[i];if(s.ev[i]===R.GE_RELEASED)tr.rel=t;else if(s.ev[i]>=R.GE_MOVED){B.record(tr,s.px[i],s.py[i],s.pdir[i],s.x[i],s.y[i],s.dir[i],s.ev[i],s.bounced[i]);B.recordDestination(tr,s,i);}}}
  for(const tr of traces)ends.push(tr.rel+tr.n*tr.tick+6);
  return {level,turns,traces,gates,ends,loop:18,final:R.grResult(s)};
 }
 function growth(stage,frame,out){
  if(!Number.isInteger(stage)||stage<1||stage>3||!Number.isFinite(frame))throw new RangeError('Invalid Christmas growth');
  const f=Math.max(0,frame),t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f-60)/300)),u=t*t*(3-2*t);
  out.x=stage===1?224:stage===2?152:240;out.y=(stage===2?200:144)+(stage===2?32:stage===1?84:88)*u;
  out.z=0;out.face=0;out.walk=t>0&&t<1?Math.floor((out.y-(stage===2?200:144))/4)%4:-1;out.revealed=f>=360;out.cheer=f>=360&&f<480;return out;
 }
 function finaleRoom(room){
  const galleryRails=room.galleryRails.map(o=>({...o,bounds:o.bounds.slice()}));
  for(const o of galleryRails)if(o.wall==='back')o.bounds[0]=22;else if(o.bounds[1]===0)o.bounds[1]=22;
  const solids=room.solids.filter(o=>!o.id.startsWith('gallery-rail')).concat(galleryRails.map((o,i)=>({id:'gallery-rail'+i,bounds:o.bounds})));
  for(const [id,bounds]of[
   ['tree-gift1',[8,196,0,21,208,8]],['tree-gift2',[10,207,0,20,216,10]],['tree-gift3',[48,192,0,62,203,9]],['tree-gift4',[50,204,0,61,214,7]],
   ['finale-bench',[251,0,42,288,8,54]],
   ...[28,84,140,196].map((x,i)=>['finale-perch'+i,[x-5,19,42,x+5,29,58]]),
   ['corner-gift1',[268,212,0,284,230,12]],['corner-gift2',[268,196,0,281,208,8]],['corner-gift3',[280,192,0,287,201,6]]])solids.push({id,bounds});
  return {...room,chapterOpen:true,galleryRails,solids};
 }
 const CAST=['greyTabby','black','white','cream','smoke','calico','tortie','siamese'];
 function route(start,points){
  const p=[[start.x,start.y,start.z],...points],d=new Float64Array(p.length);
  for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++)d[i]=d[i-1]+Math.hypot(p[i][0]-p[i-1][0],p[i][1]-p[i-1][1],p[i][2]-p[i-1][2]);
  return {p,d,length:d[d.length-1],start:{...start}};
 }
 function prepare(room,staff,pm,coats){
  const saved=Array.isArray(coats)?[...new Set(coats.filter(c=>CAST.includes(c)))].slice(0,8):[],cast=saved.length?saved:CAST.slice(0,4);
  const staffRoutes=[
   route(staff[0],[[80,62,0],[80,140,0],[74,140,0],[22,140,42],[12,140,42],[12,6,42],[236,6,42],[236,16,42],[259,16,42],[259,4,42]]),
   route(staff[1],[[280,62,0],[280,180,0],[258,180,0],[258,226,0],[86,226,0],[86,210,0]]),
   route(staff[2],[[12,6,42],[12,140,42],[22,140,42],[74,140,0],[80,158,0],[86,170,0]]),
   route(staff[3],[[74,staff[3].y,0],[74,190,0],[86,190,0]]),
   route(staff[4],[[12,140,42],[22,140,42],[74,140,0],[86,158,0],[86,222,0],[36,222,0],[36,202,0]])];
  // Clear downhill traffic first. The Postmistress waits in a clear ground bay,
  // then leads the sorter upstairs to the far end of the window bench.
  const upper=pm.z>0,pmDown=upper?route(pm,pm.x<22?[[12,140,42],[22,140,42],[74,140,0],[80,158,0],[74,188,0]]:[[74,140,0],[80,158,0],[74,188,0]]):
   route(pm,[...(pm.x<70?[[pm.x,222,0],[74,222,0]]:[]),[74,188,0]]);
  const finish=r=>Math.ceil(r.length/.9)+6;
  staffRoutes.forEach(r=>r.delay=120);pmDown.delay=120;
  if(upper){
   const bottom=r=>{const i=r.p.findIndex(p=>p[0]===74&&p[1]===140&&p[2]===0);return r.d[i]/.9;},a=bottom(staffRoutes[4]),b=bottom(pmDown);
   if(Math.abs(a-b)<40){if(a>b)staffRoutes[4].delay+=Math.ceil(40-(a-b));else pmDown.delay+=Math.ceil(40-(b-a));}
  }
  staffRoutes[2].delay=Math.max(staffRoutes[4].delay+finish(staffRoutes[4]),pmDown.delay+finish(pmDown))+24;
  const uphill=staffRoutes[2].delay+finish(staffRoutes[2])+24;
  const pmRoute=route({x:74,y:188,z:0},[[74,140,0],[22,140,42],[12,140,42],[12,6,42],[236,6,42],[236,16,42],[279,16,42],[279,10,42],[279,4,53]]);
  pmRoute.delay=uphill;staffRoutes[0].delay=uphill+20;
  const seated=Math.max(pmRoute.delay+finish(pmRoute),staffRoutes[0].delay+finish(staffRoutes[0]));
  staffRoutes[3].delay=seated+12;
  const catsBegin=seated+36;
  const catRoutes=[];
  for(let i=0;i<cast.length;i++){
   const x=[28,48,84,104,140,160,196,216][i],bed=[12+i*16,234,1],start={x,y:24,z:58};
   const points=[[x,12,58],[x,6,42],[12,6,42]];
   points.push([12,140,42],[22,140,42],[74,140,0],[80,152,0],[66,156,0],[66,221,0],[bed[0],221,0]);points.push(bed);
   const r=route(start,points);r.delay=catsBegin+i*36;catRoutes.push(r);
  }
  const duration=Math.max(...catRoutes.map(r=>r.delay+finish(r)))+90;
  return {coats:cast,staffRoutes,pmDown,pmRoute,catRoutes,duration,room:finaleRoom(room)};
 }
 function create(){
  const actor=()=>({x:0,y:0,z:0,face:0,action:'read',frame:0,handling:-1,seated:false,arrived:false,state:2,head:0,flick:0,distance:0});
  return {staff:Array.from({length:5},actor),pm:actor(),cats:Array.from({length:8},()=>({...actor(),visible:false,phase:'gallery',coat:'greyTabby'})),lightStep:0,pull:0,done:false};
 }
 function follow(r,frames,out){
  const time=Math.max(0,frames),distance=Math.min(r.length,.9*(time<12?time*time/24:time-6));let k=1;
  while(k<r.p.length-1&&r.d[k]<distance)k++;
  const a=r.p[k-1],b=r.p[k],u=r.d[k]===r.d[k-1]?1:(distance-r.d[k-1])/(r.d[k]-r.d[k-1]);
  out.x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u;out.y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u;out.z=a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*u;
  if(a[1]===140&&b[1]===140&&a[2]!==b[2]&&out.x>=22&&out.x<74)out.z=42-Math.floor((out.x-22)/4)*42/13;
  out.face=b[0]>a[0]?1:b[0]<a[0]?2:b[1]>a[1]?0:3;out.frame=Math.floor(distance/4)%4;out.distance=distance;out.arrived=distance>=r.length;
 }
 function sample(scene,frame,out){
  if(!Number.isFinite(frame))throw new RangeError('Invalid Christmas ending frame');const f=Math.max(0,Math.floor(frame));
  out.lightStep=Math.min(16,Math.floor(f/7.5));out.pull=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(f-60)/240));out.done=f>=scene.duration;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
   const a=out.staff[i],r=scene.staffRoutes[i];follow(r,f-r.delay,a);a.handling=-1;a.seated=i===0&&a.arrived;
   a.action=f<r.delay?r.start.action:a.arrived?(i===2?'wave':'read'):'walk';if(f<r.delay){a.face=r.start.face;a.frame=r.start.frame;}else if(a.arrived)a.frame=0;
  }
  const pr=f<scene.pmRoute.delay?scene.pmDown:scene.pmRoute;follow(pr,f-pr.delay,out.pm);out.pm.state=pr===scene.pmRoute&&out.pm.arrived?3:f<pr.delay?pr.start.state:2;out.pm.head=0;out.pm.flick=out.pm.frame&1;if(f<pr.delay)out.pm.face=pr.start.face;
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
   const c=out.cats[i];c.visible=i<scene.coats.length;if(!c.visible)continue;
   const t=f-scene.catRoutes[i].delay;follow(scene.catRoutes[i],t,c);c.coat=scene.coats[i];c.phase=t<0?'gallery':c.arrived?'curl':'walk';if(c.arrived||t<0)c.frame=Math.floor(f/120)%2;
  }
  return out;
 }
 function settled(traces,count=traces.length){let last=0;for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const t=traces[i];if(t.n)last=Math.max(last,t.rel+t.n*t.tick+2.2);}return Math.round(last*1e9)/1e9;}
 return {demo,growth,prepare,create,sample,settled,finaleRoom,CAST};
})();
if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=CHRISTMASCHAPTER;
// ============================================================================
// 20 NIGHT SHIFT: a deterministic round simulation. It uses the puzzle rules'
// board, cat and turntable data, but owns its release clock, live editing,
// persistent sleepers, puzzled baskets, fair round events and strike limit. Nothing here draws or
// reads a wall clock. advance() is the only real-time adapter.
// ============================================================================
const NIGHTSHIFT = (function () {
  const isNode = typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports;
  const R = isNode ? require('./10_rules.js') : {
    grCreate, grValidate, grEnter, grCanMove, grFlapAt, GR_DIR, GR_DIRS, GR_DX, GR_DY, GR_COATS, GR_COAT, GR_TYPE, GR_TYPES,
    GC_DOG, GC_BASKET_GINGER, GC_BASKET_BLUE, GC_HATCH, GC_GATE, GC_TUNNEL, GL_WAIT, GL_BOARD, GL_DONE, GL_WRONG,
    GE_NONE, GE_RELEASED, GE_MOVED, GE_DELIVERED, GE_WRONG, GE_STUCK, GE_TUNNEL, GE_WAIT,
  };
  const SETTINGS = isNode ? require('../data/night_shift.json') : NIGHT_SHIFT_SETTINGS;
  const PERMISSIONS = isNode ? require('./10a_piece_permissions.js') : PIECE_PERMISSIONS;
  const ASLEEP = 4, CARRIED = 5, LIFTED = 6;
  const CARD_IDS = ['extra', 'ginger', 'blue', 'floor', 'wake', 'walkies', 'slow'];
  const clone = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const index = (board, x, y) => y * board.w + x;
  const onBoard = (board, x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < board.w && y < board.h;

  function validateSettings(s) {
    const errors = [];
    const positive = (name, value, min = 1) => {
      if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < min) errors.push(name + ' must be an integer at least ' + min);
    };
    if (!s || !s.board || !s.start || !s.round || !s.wrongBasket || !s.sleep || !s.events || !s.cards || !s.clock) return ['missing settings section'];
    let flaps = false, points = false, tunnels = false;
    try { const p=PERMISSIONS.read(s);flaps=p.flaps;points=p.points;tunnels=p.tunnels; } catch (error) { errors.push(error.message); }
    if (!flaps && s.start.flaps && s.start.flaps.length) errors.push('flaps must be enabled in allowedPieces');
    if (!tunnels && s.start.tunnels && s.start.tunnels.length) errors.push('tunnels must be enabled in allowedPieces');
    if (!points && s.start.gates && s.start.gates.length) errors.push('points must be enabled in allowedPieces');
    for (const k of ['startW', 'startH', 'maxW', 'maxH']) positive('board.' + k, s.board[k]);
    if (s.board.startW > s.board.maxW || s.board.startH > s.board.maxH) errors.push('starting board exceeds its maximum');
    for (const k of ['catsBase', 'catsPerRound']) positive('round.' + k, s.round[k], 0);
    for (const k of ['releaseGapStart', 'releaseGapDropEvery', 'releaseGapMin', 'tickMsStart', 'tickMsDropPerRound', 'tickMsMin'])
      positive('round.' + k, s.round[k], k === 'tickMsDropPerRound' ? 0 : 1);
    if (s.round.releaseGapMin > s.round.releaseGapStart || s.round.tickMsMin > s.round.tickMsStart)
      errors.push('minimum gap or tick exceeds its starting value');
    positive('wrongBasket.strikesToEnd', s.wrongBasket.strikesToEnd);
    positive('wrongBasket.clearMs', s.wrongBasket.clearMs);
    positive('sleep.travelTicks', s.sleep.travelTicks);
    positive('sleep.carryAtTea', s.sleep.carryAtTea, 0);
    for (const k of ['basketEvery', 'hatchEvery', 'dogEvery', 'moveBasketFrom', 'moveBasketEvery', 'animationMs'])
      positive('events.' + k, s.events[k]);
    if (!['ginger', 'blue'].includes(s.events.basketFirstCoat)) errors.push('events.basketFirstCoat must be ginger or blue');
    positive('clock.fastMultiplier', s.clock.fastMultiplier);
    if (!s.cards.weights) errors.push('cards.weights is missing');
    else for (const id of CARD_IDS) positive('cards.weights.' + id, s.cards.weights[id]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(s.cards.slowFactor) || s.cards.slowFactor <= 1) errors.push('cards.slowFactor must exceed 1');
    if (!Array.isArray(s.start.hatches) || !s.start.hatches.length || !Array.isArray(s.start.baskets) || !Array.isArray(s.start.dogs))
      errors.push('the starting board needs hatches, baskets and dogs lists');
    else {
      const level = { board: { w: s.board.startW, h: s.board.startH },
        hatches: s.start.hatches.map((h) => Object.assign({}, h, { cats: ['ginger'] })),
        baskets: s.start.baskets, dogs: s.start.dogs, flaps: s.start.flaps, gates: s.start.gates, tunnels: s.start.tunnels };
      errors.push(...R.grValidate(level, null));
      for (const coat of ['ginger', 'blue']) if (!s.start.baskets.some((b) => b.coat === coat)) errors.push('no ' + coat + ' basket');
    }
    if (!s.start.tray) errors.push('no starting tray');
    else for (const type of R.GR_TYPES) positive('start.tray.' + type, s.start.tray[type], 0);
    return errors;
  }
  function create(seed, settings = SETTINGS) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(seed) || seed < 0 || seed > 0xffffffff) throw new RangeError('seed must be a 32-bit unsigned integer');
    const s = clone(settings), errors = validateSettings(s);
    if (errors.length) throw new RangeError(errors.join('; '));
    const shift = { seed, settings: s, rngState: seed >>> 0, roomMode: 'free', phase: 'ready', round: 0, catsHome: 0, strikes: 0,
      board: { w: s.board.startW, h: s.board.startH, hatches: clone(s.start.hatches),
        baskets: clone(s.start.baskets), dogs: clone(s.start.dogs) },
      tray: clone(s.start.tray), turntables: [], sleepers: [], puzzled: [], teaCarried: [], emergencyCarried: [], current: null,
      paused: false, fastForward: false, clockUnits: 0, elapsedShiftMs: 0, lastEvents: [], roundEvents: [], endReason: '',
      cardOffers: [], cardChoice: null, pendingWalkies: false, pendingGrowth: null };
    const pieces = PERMISSIONS.read(s);
    // Reserve all supplied fixtures before filling omitted lists in tunnel mode.
    // The preceding non-tunnel seed stream and initialisation order stay intact.
    if (pieces.tunnels) for (const key of ['flaps', 'gates', 'tunnels'])
      if (s.start[key] && s.start[key].length) shift.board[key] = clone(s.start[key]);
    if (pieces.flaps && !shift.board.flaps) shift.board.flaps = s.start.flaps && s.start.flaps.length ? clone(s.start.flaps) : makeFlaps(shift);
    if (pieces.points && !shift.board.gates) shift.board.gates = s.start.gates && s.start.gates.length ? clone(s.start.gates) : makePoints(shift);
    if (pieces.tunnels) {
      if (!shift.board.tunnels) shift.board.tunnels = makeTunnels(shift);
      const b = shift.board, level = { board: b, hatches: b.hatches.map(h => ({ ...h, cats: ['ginger'] })),
        baskets: b.baskets, dogs: b.dogs, gates: b.gates, flaps: b.flaps, tunnels: b.tunnels };
      const errors = R.grValidate(level, null);
      if (errors.length) throw new RangeError(errors.join('; '));
    }
    return shift;
  }
  function makeTunnels(shift) {
    const tiles = openTiles(shift);
    if (tiles.length < 2) throw new RangeError('tunnels need two free tiles away from hatch exits');
    return [{ a: tiles[0], b: tiles[tiles.length - 1], symbol: 'circle' }];
  }
  function makeFlaps(shift) {
    const b = shift.board, candidates = [];
    for (let y = 0; y < b.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < b.w; x++) if (emptyTile(shift, x, y)) {
      const side = x === b.w - 1 ? 'R' : y === b.h - 1 ? 'D' : x === 0 ? 'L' : y === 0 ? 'U' : '';
      if (side) candidates.push({ x, y, side });
    }
    if (!candidates.length) throw new RangeError('flaps need a free edge tile');
    const start = shift.seed % candidates.length, out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(2, candidates.length); i++)
      out.push({ ...candidates[(start + i) % candidates.length], coat: i ? 'blue' : 'ginger' });
    return out;
  }
  function makePoints(shift) {
    const b=shift.board,candidates=[];
    for(const h of b.hatches){
      const d=R.GR_DIR[h.dir],x=h.x+R.GR_DX[d],y=h.y+R.GR_DY[d];
      if(onBoard(b,x,y)&&emptyTile(shift,x,y))candidates.push({x,y,exits:[h.dir,R.GR_DIRS[(d+2)&3]]});
    }
    if(!candidates.length)throw new RangeError('points need a free hatch approach tile');
    return [candidates[shift.seed%candidates.length]];
  }
  function nextInt(shift, n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new RangeError('random range must be positive');
    shift.rngState = (shift.rngState + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
    let t = shift.rngState;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return Math.floor(((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) * n / 4294967296);
  }
  function roundParams(settings, n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new RangeError('round must be positive');
    const r = settings.round;
    return { cats: r.catsBase + r.catsPerRound * n,
      releaseGap: Math.max(r.releaseGapMin, r.releaseGapStart - Math.floor((n - 1) / r.releaseGapDropEvery)),
      tickMs: Math.max(r.tickMsMin, r.tickMsStart - (n - 1) * r.tickMsDropPerRound) };
  }
  function eventPlan(settings, n) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1) throw new RangeError('round must be positive');
    const e = settings.events, out = [];
    if (n % e.hatchEvery === 0) out.push({ type: 'hatch' });
    if (n >= e.moveBasketFrom && n % e.moveBasketEvery === 0) out.push({ type: 'moveBasket' });
    if (n % e.basketEvery === 0) {
      const first = Math.floor(n / e.basketEvery) % 2 === 1;
      out.push({ type: 'basket', coat: first ? e.basketFirstCoat : e.basketFirstCoat === 'ginger' ? 'blue' : 'ginger' });
    }
    if (n % e.dogEvery === 0) out.push({ type: 'dog' });
    return out;
  }
  function shuffle(shift, list) {
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = nextInt(shift, i + 1), item = list[i]; list[i] = list[j]; list[j] = item;
    }
    return list;
  }
  function tunnelAt(board,x,y) {
    if(board.tunnels)for(const t of board.tunnels)if((t.a.x===x&&t.a.y===y)||(t.b.x===x&&t.b.y===y))return t;
    return null;
  }
  function emptyTile(shift, x, y) {
    const occupied = shift.board.hatches.concat(shift.board.baskets, shift.board.dogs, shift.turntables, shift.sleepers, shift.puzzled, shift.board.flaps || [], shift.board.gates || []);
    return !tunnelAt(shift.board,x,y) && !occupied.some((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y);
  }
  function nearHatchExit(board, x, y) {
    return board.hatches.some((h) => {
      const d = R.GR_DIR[h.dir];
      return Math.abs(h.x + R.GR_DX[d] - x) + Math.abs(h.y + R.GR_DY[d] - y) <= 1;
    });
  }
  function openTiles(shift) {
    const out = [], board = shift.board;
    for (let y = 0; y < board.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < board.w; x++)
      if (emptyTile(shift, x, y) && !nearHatchExit(board, x, y)) out.push({ x, y });
    return shuffle(shift, out);
  }
  function placeEvent(shift, planned) {
    const board = shift.board;
    if (planned.type === 'hatch') {
      const candidates = [];
      for (const tile of openTiles(shift)) for (const dir of R.GR_DIRS) {
        const d = R.GR_DIR[dir], ex = tile.x + R.GR_DX[d], ey = tile.y + R.GR_DY[d];
        if (onBoard(board, ex, ey) && emptyTile(shift, ex, ey)) candidates.push({ x: tile.x, y: tile.y, dir });
      }
      for (const p of shuffle(shift, candidates)) {
        board.hatches.push(p);
        if (fairness(shift).ok) return { type: 'hatch', x: p.x, y: p.y, dir: p.dir };
        board.hatches.pop();
      }
    } else if (planned.type === 'moveBasket') {
      const choices = shuffle(shift, board.baskets.map((_, i) => i));
      for (const i of choices) {
        const before = board.baskets[i];
        if (shift.puzzled.some((cat) => cat.x === before.x && cat.y === before.y)) continue;
        for (const tile of openTiles(shift)) {
          if (tile.x === before.x && tile.y === before.y) continue;
          board.baskets[i] = { x: tile.x, y: tile.y, coat: before.coat };
          if (fairness(shift).ok) return { type: 'moveBasket', x: tile.x, y: tile.y, coat: before.coat, fromX: before.x, fromY: before.y };
          board.baskets[i] = before;
        }
      }
    } else if (planned.type === 'basket' || planned.type === 'dog') {
      const list = planned.type === 'basket' ? board.baskets : board.dogs;
      for (const tile of openTiles(shift)) {
        const p = planned.type === 'basket' ? { x: tile.x, y: tile.y, coat: planned.coat } : tile;
        list.push(p);
        if (fairness(shift).ok) return Object.assign({ type: planned.type }, p);
        list.pop();
      }
    }
    return { type: 'skipped', event: planned.type, coat: planned.coat || null };
  }
  function placeRoundEvents(shift, n) {
    shift.roundEvents = eventPlan(shift.settings, n).map((event) => Object.assign({ round: n }, placeEvent(shift, event)));
  }
  function walkiesMoves(shift) {
    const moves = [], board = shift.board;
    for (let dog = 0; dog < board.dogs.length; dog++) {
      const from = board.dogs[dog];
      for (let y = 0; y < board.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < board.w; x++) {
        if (!emptyTile(shift, x, y) || nearHatchExit(board, x, y)) continue;
        board.dogs[dog] = { x, y };
        const fair = fairness(shift).ok;
        board.dogs[dog] = from;
        if (fair) moves.push({ fromX: from.x, fromY: from.y, x, y });
      }
    }
    return moves;
  }
  function cardUsable(shift, id) {
    const board = shift.board;
    if (id === 'floor') return board.w < shift.settings.board.maxW || board.h < shift.settings.board.maxH;
    if (id === 'wake') return shift.sleepers.length > 0;
    if (id === 'walkies') return walkiesMoves(shift).length > 0;
    return true;
  }
  function offerCards(shift) {
    if (shift.phase !== 'tea' || shift.cardChoice) return shift.cardOffers;
    const pool = CARD_IDS.filter((id) => cardUsable(shift, id));
    let state = (shift.seed ^ Math.imul(shift.round, 0x9e3779b9) ^ 0xa5a5a5a5) >>> 0;
    const rand = () => { state ^= state << 13; state ^= state >>> 17; state ^= state << 5; return state >>> 0; };
    shift.cardOffers = [];
    while (shift.cardOffers.length < 3 && pool.length) {
      const total = pool.reduce((n, id) => n + shift.settings.cards.weights[id], 0);
      let roll = rand() % total, chosen = 0;
      while (roll >= shift.settings.cards.weights[pool[chosen]]) roll -= shift.settings.cards.weights[pool[chosen++]];
      shift.cardOffers.push(pool.splice(chosen, 1)[0]);
    }
    return shift.cardOffers;
  }
  function chooseCard(shift, id) {
    if (shift.phase !== 'tea' || shift.cardChoice || !shift.cardOffers.includes(id) || !cardUsable(shift, id)) return { ok: false, reason: 'card unavailable' };
    shift.cardChoice = id;
    if (id === 'extra') shift.tray.plain += 2;
    else if (id === 'ginger' || id === 'blue') shift.tray[id]++;
    else if (id === 'wake') {
      for (const cat of shift.sleepers) {
        shift.teaCarried.push(cat);
        if (cat.round === shift.round) shift.current.sim.st[cat.index] = CARRIED;
      }
      shift.sleepers = [];
    } else if (id === 'walkies') shift.pendingWalkies = true;
    else if (id === 'floor') {
      const w = shift.board.w < shift.settings.board.maxW, h = shift.board.h < shift.settings.board.maxH;
      shift.pendingGrowth = w && h ? ((shift.seed ^ shift.round) & 1) ? 'w' : 'h' : w ? 'w' : 'h';
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }
  function moveDog(shift, fromX, fromY, x, y) {
    if (shift.phase !== 'tea' || !shift.pendingWalkies) return { ok: false, reason: 'Walkies is not selected' };
    const move = walkiesMoves(shift).find((p) => p.fromX === fromX && p.fromY === fromY && p.x === x && p.y === y);
    if (!move) return { ok: false, reason: 'choose an empty reachable tile away from hatch exits' };
    const dog = shift.board.dogs.find((p) => p.x === fromX && p.y === fromY);
    dog.x = x; dog.y = y; shift.pendingWalkies = false;
    return { ok: true };
  }
  function startRound(shift, startPaused = false) {
    if (shift.phase !== 'ready' && shift.phase !== 'tea') return false;
    if (shift.phase === 'tea' && (!shift.cardChoice || shift.pendingWalkies)) return false;
    if (shift.pendingGrowth && shift.board[shift.pendingGrowth] >= shift.settings.board[shift.pendingGrowth === 'w' ? 'maxW' : 'maxH']) return false;
    const n = shift.round + 1, params = roundParams(shift.settings, n);
    const catRng = { rngState: (shift.seed ^ Math.imul(n, 0x9e3779b9) ^ 0x63c52a17) >>> 0 };
    if (shift.cardChoice === 'slow') params.tickMs *= shift.settings.cards.slowFactor;
    if (shift.pendingGrowth) shift.board[shift.pendingGrowth]++;
    for (const f of shift.board.flaps || []) {
      if (f.side === 'R') f.x = shift.board.w - 1;
      if (f.side === 'D') f.y = shift.board.h - 1;
    }
    shift.pendingGrowth = null; shift.cardChoice = null; shift.cardOffers = [];
    placeRoundEvents(shift, n);
    const hatches = shift.board.hatches.map((h) => Object.assign({}, h, { cats: [] }));
    if (!hatches.length) throw new Error('a shift needs an open hatch');
    const start = nextInt(catRng, hatches.length), plan = [], bigCats = PERMISSIONS.read(shift.settings).bigCats;
    for (let j = 0; j < params.cats; j++) {
      const h = (start + j) % hatches.length, local = hatches[h].cats.length;
      const coat = nextInt(catRng, 2) === 0 ? 'ginger' : 'blue';
      hatches[h].cats.push(bigCats && j % 3 === 0 ? {coat,big:true} : coat);
      plan.push({ hatch: h, local });
    }
    const level = { board: { w: shift.board.w, h: shift.board.h }, hatches,
      baskets: shift.board.baskets, dogs: shift.board.dogs, flaps: shift.board.flaps, gates: shift.board.gates, tunnels: shift.board.tunnels };
    const sim = R.grCreate(level, shift.turntables);
    sim.releaseTick.fill(-1);
    shift.current = { sim, params, releaseOrder: plan.map((p) => sim.hatches[p.hatch].first + p.local),
      releaseHatches: plan.map((p) => p.hatch), travel: new Int16Array(sim.n), released: 0 };
    shift.round = n; shift.phase = 'running'; shift.paused = !!startPaused; shift.fastForward = false;
    shift.clockUnits = 0; shift.teaCarried = []; shift.lastEvents = [];
    return true;
  }
  function seekRound(shift, target) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(target) || target < 1) throw new RangeError('round must be positive');
    const fresh = create(shift.seed, shift.settings);
    for (let n = 1; n < target; n++) {
      placeRoundEvents(fresh, n);
      fresh.round = n; fresh.phase = 'ready';
    }
    startRound(fresh);
    Object.assign(shift, fresh);
    return shift;
  }
  function blocked(shift, x, y, nextTick = false) {
    const board = shift.board, k = index(board, x, y);
    if (!onBoard(board, x, y) || shift.current.sim.cell[k] === R.GC_DOG) return true;
    if (shift.sleepers.some((c) => c.x === x && c.y === y)) return true;
    const clearAt = nextTick ? shift.current.params.tickMs : 0;
    return shift.puzzled.some((c) => c.flap === undefined && c.x === x && c.y === y && c.remainingMs > clearAt);
  }
  function nextTile(shift, i, nextTick) {
    const sim = shift.current.sim, x = sim.x[i], y = sim.y[i];
    let d = sim.dir[i], nx = x + R.GR_DX[d], ny = y + R.GR_DY[d];
    if (!onBoard(shift.board, nx, ny) && R.grFlapAt(sim, i, d) >= 0)
      return { x, y, dir: d, bounced: false, stuck: false, flap: R.grFlapAt(sim, i, d) };
    if (blocked(shift, nx, ny, nextTick)) {
      d = (d + 2) & 3; nx = x + R.GR_DX[d]; ny = y + R.GR_DY[d];
      if (!onBoard(shift.board, nx, ny) && R.grFlapAt(sim, i, d) >= 0)
        return { x, y, dir: d, bounced: true, stuck: false, flap: R.grFlapAt(sim, i, d) };
      if (blocked(shift, nx, ny, nextTick)) return { x, y, dir: d, bounced: true, stuck: true };
      return { x: nx, y: ny, dir: d, bounced: true, stuck: false };
    }
    return { x: nx, y: ny, dir: d, bounced: false, stuck: false };
  }
  function lockedTiles(shift) {
    const locks = new Set(), board = shift.board;
    for (const c of shift.sleepers.concat(shift.puzzled)) locks.add(index(board, c.x, c.y));
    if (shift.phase === 'running' && shift.current) {
      const sim = shift.current.sim;
      for (let i = 0; i < sim.n; i++) if (sim.st[i] === R.GL_BOARD) {
        locks.add(index(board, sim.x[i], sim.y[i]));
        const p = nextTile(shift, i, true); locks.add(index(board, p.x, p.y));
      }
    }
    return [...locks].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  function fairness(shift) {
    const board = shift.board, blocked = new Set(board.dogs.concat(shift.sleepers).map((p) => index(board, p.x, p.y)));
    const missing = [];
    board.hatches.forEach((h, hatch) => {
      const dir = R.GR_DIR[h.dir], sx = h.x + R.GR_DX[dir], sy = h.y + R.GR_DY[dir];
      const seen = new Set(), queue = [];
      if (onBoard(board, sx, sy) && !blocked.has(index(board, sx, sy))) {
        const k = index(board, sx, sy); seen.add(k); queue.push(k);
      }
      for (let head = 0; head < queue.length; head++) {
        const x = queue[head] % board.w, y = Math.floor(queue[head] / board.w);
        for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
          const nx = x + R.GR_DX[d], ny = y + R.GR_DY[d];
          if (!onBoard(board, nx, ny)) continue;
          const k = index(board, nx, ny);
          if (seen.has(k) || blocked.has(k)) continue;
          seen.add(k);
          const t=tunnelAt(board,nx,ny);
          if(t){const e=t.a.x===nx&&t.a.y===ny?t.b:t.a,exit=index(board,e.x,e.y);if(!seen.has(exit)){seen.add(exit);queue.push(exit);}}
          else queue.push(k);
        }
      }
      for (const coat of ['ginger', 'blue'])
        if (!board.baskets.concat(board.flaps || []).some((b) => b.coat === coat && seen.has(index(board, b.x, b.y)))) missing.push({ hatch, coat });
    });
    return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
  }
  function syncTurntable(shift, x, y, placement) {
    if (!shift.current) return;
    const sim = shift.current.sim, k = index(shift.board, x, y);
    sim.chDir[k] = placement ? R.GR_DIR[placement.dir] : -1;
    sim.chType[k] = placement ? R.GR_TYPE[placement.type] : 0;
  }
  function edit(shift, change) {
    if (shift.phase === 'ended') return { ok: false, reason: 'shift ended' };
    if (shift.phase === 'tea' && (!shift.cardChoice || shift.pendingWalkies)) return { ok: false, reason: 'choose a tea card first' };
    const { x, y, action } = change, board = shift.board;
    if (!Number.isInteger(x) || !Number.isInteger(y) || !onBoard(board, x, y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'outside board' };
    if (tunnelAt(board,x,y) || board.hatches.some((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y) || board.baskets.some((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y) ||
        board.dogs.some((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y) || (board.gates||[]).some((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y)) return { ok: false, reason: 'piece occupies tile' };
    if (lockedTiles(shift).includes(index(board, x, y))) return { ok: false, reason: 'cat locks tile' };
    const at = shift.turntables.findIndex((p) => p.x === x && p.y === y);
    if (action === 'place') {
      if (at >= 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'turntable already there' };
      if (!R.GR_TYPES.includes(change.type) || !R.GR_DIRS.includes(change.dir)) return { ok: false, reason: 'invalid turntable' };
      if (shift.tray[change.type] < 1) return { ok: false, reason: 'tray is empty' };
      const p = { x, y, type: change.type, dir: change.dir };
      shift.turntables.push(p); shift.tray[p.type]--; syncTurntable(shift, x, y, p);
    } else if (action === 'turn' && at >= 0) {
      const p = shift.turntables[at]; p.dir = R.GR_DIRS[(R.GR_DIR[p.dir] + 1) & 3]; syncTurntable(shift, x, y, p);
    } else if (action === 'pickup' && at >= 0) {
      const p = shift.turntables.splice(at, 1)[0]; shift.tray[p.type]++; syncTurntable(shift, x, y, null);
    } else return { ok: false, reason: 'no turntable to edit' };
    return { ok: true };
  }
  function clearPuzzled(shift, tickMs) {
    for (let j = shift.puzzled.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const c = shift.puzzled[j]; c.remainingMs -= tickMs;
      if (c.remainingMs > 0) continue;
      shift.puzzled.splice(j, 1);
      if (c.round === shift.round) shift.current.sim.st[c.index] = LIFTED;
      shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'lifted', x: c.x, y: c.y, round: c.round, index: c.index });
    }
  }
  function moveCat(shift, i) {
    const current = shift.current, sim = current.sim, p = nextTile(shift, i, false);
    if (p.bounced) { sim.dir[i] = p.dir; sim.bounced[i] = 1; }
    if (p.stuck) sim.ev[i] = R.GE_STUCK;
    else {
      sim.x[i] = p.x; sim.y[i] = p.y; sim.ev[i] = R.GE_MOVED;
      const k = index(shift.board, p.x, p.y), cell = sim.cell[k];
      if (p.flap !== undefined || cell === R.GC_BASKET_GINGER || cell === R.GC_BASKET_BLUE) {
        const basketCoat = p.flap !== undefined ? R.GR_COAT[sim.flaps[p.flap].coat] : cell === R.GC_BASKET_GINGER ? R.GR_COAT.ginger : R.GR_COAT.blue;
        if (p.flap !== undefined) sim.homeFlap[i] = p.flap;
        if (sim.coat[i] === basketCoat) {
          sim.st[i] = R.GL_DONE; sim.ev[i] = R.GE_DELIVERED; shift.catsHome++;
          shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'delivered', index: i, x: p.x, y: p.y });
        } else {
          sim.st[i] = R.GL_WRONG; sim.ev[i] = R.GE_WRONG; shift.strikes++;
          shift.puzzled.push({ round: shift.round, index: i, x: p.x, y: p.y, remainingMs: shift.settings.wrongBasket.clearMs, ...(sim.big[i]?{big:true}:{}) });
          if (p.flap !== undefined) shift.puzzled[shift.puzzled.length - 1].flap = p.flap;
          shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'wrong', index: i, x: p.x, y: p.y, strikes: shift.strikes });
          if (shift.strikes >= shift.settings.wrongBasket.strikesToEnd) {
            shift.phase = 'ended'; shift.endReason = 'threeStrikes';
            shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'shiftEnded', round: shift.round, catsHome: shift.catsHome });
          }
        }
      } else if(cell===R.GC_GATE||cell===R.GC_TUNNEL){
        R.grEnter(sim,i);
      } else {
        const d = sim.chDir[k], type = sim.chType[k];
        if (d >= 0 && (type === R.GR_TYPE.plain || type === sim.coat[i])) {
          if (d !== sim.dir[i]) sim.turns[k]++;
          sim.dir[i] = d;
        }
      }
    }
    current.travel[i]++;
    if (sim.st[i] === R.GL_BOARD && current.travel[i] >= shift.settings.sleep.travelTicks) {
      const k = index(shift.board, sim.x[i], sim.y[i]);
      if (sim.cell[k] === R.GC_HATCH) { // adjacent hatches can loop without p.stuck when sleepers block both exits
        const dx = R.GR_DX[sim.dir[i]], dy = R.GR_DY[sim.dir[i]];
        const j = shift.sleepers.findIndex((c) =>
          (c.x === sim.x[i] + dx && c.y === sim.y[i] + dy) || (c.x === sim.x[i] - dx && c.y === sim.y[i] - dy));
        if (j >= 0) {
          const cat = shift.sleepers.splice(j, 1)[0]; shift.emergencyCarried.push(cat);
          if (cat.round === shift.round) sim.st[cat.index] = CARRIED;
          shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'emergencyCarry', x: cat.x, y: cat.y, round: cat.round, index: cat.index });
        }
      } else if (sim.cell[k] !== R.GC_HATCH && sim.cell[k] !== R.GC_BASKET_GINGER && sim.cell[k] !== R.GC_BASKET_BLUE) {
        sim.st[i] = ASLEEP;
        shift.sleepers.push({ round: shift.round, index: i, x: sim.x[i], y: sim.y[i], coat: R.GR_COATS[sim.coat[i]], ...(sim.big[i]?{big:true}:{}) });
        shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'asleep', index: i, x: sim.x[i], y: sim.y[i] });
      }
    }
  }
  function finishRound(shift) {
    const current = shift.current, sim = current.sim;
    if (current.released < current.releaseOrder.length) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < sim.n; i++) if (sim.st[i] === R.GL_BOARD || sim.st[i] === R.GL_WAIT) return;
    shift.phase = 'tea'; shift.teaCarried = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < shift.settings.sleep.carryAtTea && shift.sleepers.length; k++) {
      const cat = shift.sleepers.shift(); shift.teaCarried.push(cat);
      if (cat.round === shift.round) sim.st[cat.index] = CARRIED;
      shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'carried', x: cat.x, y: cat.y, round: cat.round, index: cat.index });
    }
    offerCards(shift);
    shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'tea', round: shift.round, catsHome: shift.catsHome });
  }
  function tick(shift) {
    if (shift.phase !== 'running' || shift.paused) return shift;
    const current = shift.current, sim = current.sim, t = sim.tick, tickMs = current.params.tickMs;
    sim.flipCount=0;
    shift.lastEvents = [];
    clearPuzzled(shift, tickMs);
    for (let i = 0; i < sim.n; i++) {
      sim.px[i] = sim.x[i]; sim.py[i] = sim.y[i]; sim.pdir[i] = sim.dir[i]; sim.ev[i] = R.GE_NONE; sim.bounced[i] = 0; sim.tunnelPair[i] = sim.entryX[i] = sim.entryY[i] = -1;
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < sim.n; j++) {
      const i=sim.gates.length||sim.hasBig?current.releaseOrder[j]:j;
      if(sim.st[i]!==R.GL_BOARD)continue;
      if(!R.grCanMove(sim,i,t)){sim.ev[i]=R.GE_WAIT;continue;}
      moveCat(shift, i);
      if (shift.phase === 'ended') break;
    }
    if (shift.phase === 'running' && t % current.params.releaseGap === 0 && current.released < current.releaseOrder.length) {
      const j = current.released++, i = current.releaseOrder[j];
      sim.releaseTick[i] = t; sim.st[i] = R.GL_BOARD; sim.ev[i] = R.GE_RELEASED;
      shift.lastEvents.push({ type: 'released', index: i, hatch: current.releaseHatches[j], coat: R.GR_COATS[sim.coat[i]] });
    }
    sim.tick = t + 1; shift.elapsedShiftMs += tickMs;
    if (shift.phase === 'running') finishRound(shift);
    if (shift.phase !== 'running') { sim.endTick = t; sim.outcome = shift.phase; shift.clockUnits = 0; }
    return shift;
  }
  function advance(shift, elapsedMs, onTick) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(elapsedMs) || elapsedMs < 0) throw new RangeError('elapsedMs must be nonnegative');
    if (shift.phase !== 'running' || shift.paused) return 0;
    shift.clockUnits += elapsedMs * 4 * (shift.fastForward ? shift.settings.clock.fastMultiplier : 1);
    let ticks = 0;
    while (shift.phase === 'running' && shift.clockUnits >= shift.current.params.tickMs * 4) {
      shift.clockUnits -= shift.current.params.tickMs * 4;
      tick(shift); ticks++;
      if (onTick) onTick(shift);
    }
    return ticks;
  }
  function setPaused(shift, value) { if (shift.phase === 'running') shift.paused = !!value; return shift.paused; }
  function setFastForward(shift, value) { if (shift.phase === 'running') shift.fastForward = !!value; return shift.fastForward; }
  function snapshot(shift) {
    const c = shift.current, sim = c && c.sim;
    const out = { seed: shift.seed, roomMode: shift.roomMode, round: shift.round, phase: shift.phase,
      endReason: shift.endReason, catsHome: shift.catsHome, strikes: shift.strikes,
      board: clone(shift.board), tray: clone(shift.tray), turntables: clone(shift.turntables),
      sleepers: clone(shift.sleepers), puzzled: clone(shift.puzzled), teaCarried: clone(shift.teaCarried),
      emergencyCarried: clone(shift.emergencyCarried),
      roundEvents: clone(shift.roundEvents),
      cardOffers: shift.cardOffers.slice(), cardChoice: shift.cardChoice, pendingWalkies: shift.pendingWalkies, pendingGrowth: shift.pendingGrowth,
      rngState: shift.rngState, paused: shift.paused, fastForward: shift.fastForward,
      clockUnits: shift.clockUnits, elapsedShiftMs: shift.elapsedShiftMs,
      current: c && { tick: sim.tick, released: c.released, total: sim.n, releaseOrder: c.releaseOrder.slice(),
        releaseHatches: c.releaseHatches.slice(), params: clone(c.params),
        cats: Array.from({ length: sim.n }, (_, i) => ({ coat: R.GR_COATS[sim.coat[i]], state: sim.st[i],
          x: sim.x[i], y: sim.y[i], dir: R.GR_DIRS[sim.dir[i]], travel: c.travel[i], ...(sim.big[i]?{big:true,releaseTick:sim.releaseTick[i]}:{}) })) } };
    if(c&&sim.gates.length)out.current.gateState=Array.from(sim.gateState);
    return out;
  }
  return { SETTINGS, ASLEEP, CARRIED, LIFTED, validateSettings, create, roundParams, eventPlan, startRound, seekRound, tick, advance,
    offerCards, chooseCard, walkiesMoves, moveDog, setPaused, setFastForward, lockedTiles, fairness, edit, snapshot };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = NIGHTSHIFT;
// Shared Night Shift identity and share text. An instant is converted to London's civil date before
// finding its ISO Monday week, so the shared seed changes together for players in every time zone.
const NIGHTSHIFT_META = (function () {
  const DAY_MS = 86400000;
  const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const londonDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/London', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
  function seedForWeek(year, week) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(year) || !Number.isInteger(week) || week < 1 || week > 53) throw new RangeError('invalid ISO week');
    const key = year + '-W' + pad(week);
    let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ key.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    return hash;
  }
  function weekForInstant(instant) {
    if (!(instant instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())) throw new RangeError('invalid instant');
    const parts = Object.fromEntries(londonDate.formatToParts(instant).filter((p) => p.type !== 'literal').map((p) => [p.type, Number(p.value)]));
    const thursday = new Date(Date.UTC(parts.year, parts.month - 1, parts.day));
    thursday.setUTCDate(thursday.getUTCDate() + 4 - (thursday.getUTCDay() || 7));
    const year = thursday.getUTCFullYear(), yearStart = Date.UTC(year, 0, 1);
    const week = Math.ceil(((thursday.getTime() - yearStart) / DAY_MS + 1) / 7);
    return { kind: 'weekly', year, week, weekKey: year + '-W' + pad(week), seed: seedForWeek(year, week) };
  }
  function shareText(run, catsHome, round) {
    const identity = run.kind === 'weekly' ? 'week ' + run.week + ' (' + run.year + ')' : 'random seed ' + run.seed;
    return 'Cats by Post · Night Shift, ' + identity + '\n🐈 ' + catsHome + ' cats home · round ' + round;
  }
  return { seedForWeek, weekForInstant, shareText };
})();
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = NIGHTSHIFT_META;
// ============================================================================
// 20 PALETTE + LIGHT RAMPS
// Every pixel on screen is one of these colours. Lighting never blends: it
// walks a colour along its ramp (SH = one step darker/cooler, LIT = one step
// warmer/brighter). Five light levels: 0 = SH(SH(c)), 1 = SH(c), 2 = c,
// 3 = LIT(c), 4 = LIT(LIT(c)).
// ============================================================================
// Up to 128 indexed colours, available to every sprite; the table stride is PAL_N, so a colour's
// number never changes when colours are added after it.
const PAL_DEF = PALETTE_DATA.colours;   // [name, hex, SH, LIT] rows from src/data/palette.json
const PAL_N = 128;                     // table stride and the most colours there may be
const NPAL = PAL_DEF.length;          // colours in use (<= PAL_N)
const C = {};                          // name -> index
PAL_DEF.forEach((p, i) => { C[p[0]] = i; });
const PAL32 = new Uint32Array(PAL_N);  // ABGR for little-endian ImageData
const PALRGB = [];                     // [r,g,b] for tooling
const SH = new Uint8Array(PAL_N), LITC = new Uint8Array(PAL_N);
PAL_DEF.forEach((p, i) => {
  const v = parseInt(p[1], 16), r = v >> 16, g = (v >> 8) & 255, b = v & 255;
  PAL32[i] = (255 << 24 | b << 16 | g << 8 | r) >>> 0;
  PALRGB.push([r, g, b]);
  SH[i] = C[p[2]]; LITC[i] = C[p[3]];
});
// LUT[level * PAL_N + index] -> final palette index
const NLVL = 5;
const LUT = new Uint8Array(NLVL * PAL_N);
for (let i = 0; i < PAL_N; i++) {
  const c = i < NPAL ? i : 0;
  LUT[0 * PAL_N + i] = SH[SH[c]];
  LUT[1 * PAL_N + i] = SH[c];
  LUT[2 * PAL_N + i] = c;
  LUT[3 * PAL_N + i] = LITC[c];
  LUT[4 * PAL_N + i] = LITC[LITC[c]];
}
// Flattened final colour table: RES32[level*PAL_N+idx] = PAL32[LUT[...]]. Grayscale preview (G): each
// resolved colour mapped to its luminance, so the ginger/blue and round/square cues can be checked without colour.
const lumOf = (i) => 0.2126 * PALRGB[i][0] + 0.7152 * PALRGB[i][1] + 0.0722 * PALRGB[i][2];
// Two halves: the room's light, then the board's (a colour number with bit 7 set: 31_compose's resolve).
function resolveTables(lut, boardLut) {
  const N = NLVL * PAL_N, res = new Uint32Array(2 * N), gray = new Uint32Array(2 * N);
  for (let h = 0; h < 2; h++) {
    const L = h ? boardLut || lut : lut;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      res[h * N + i] = PAL32[L[i]];
      const y = Math.round(lumOf(L[i]));
      gray[h * N + i] = (255 << 24 | y << 16 | y << 8 | y) >>> 0;
    }
  }
  return { res, gray };
}
const BASE_TABLES = resolveTables(LUT, LUT);
let RES32 = BASE_TABLES.res, GRAY32 = BASE_TABLES.gray;   // the tables in use: the base ramps, or a light set's
let grayscale = false;

// ---- time of day (palette.json lightSets): one LUT per light set, for the Box Room ---------------------
// For each colour and level: the base ramp's colour, transformed (dim for levels 0-2, lit for 3-4), then snapped
// to the nearest palette colour (not a coat or a fixed colour) by redmean distance. The coats keep their own
// ramps, so ginger stays brighter than blue at every hour (a lamp at night only shifts them a level, as it does
// everything); fixed colours (skies, stars, bulbs) never change. In a set that transforms, each level is at
// least as bright as the one below.
// Integer maths only, so a port builds the same tables (the atlas export also writes them out).
const LIGHT_SETS = PALETTE_DATA.lightSets;
function lightTransform(rgb, T) {
  let v = rgb.slice();
  if (T && T.mul) v = v.map((c, k) => Math.floor(c * T.mul[k] / 256));
  if (T && T.add) v = v.map((c, k) => c + T.add[k]);
  if (T && T.mix) { const t = parseInt(T.mix[0], 16), tc = [t >> 16, (t >> 8) & 255, t & 255]; v = v.map((c, k) => c + Math.round((tc[k] - c) * T.mix[1] / 256)); }
  return v.map((c) => (c < 0 ? 0 : c > 255 ? 255 : c));
}
function nearestColour(v, cands) {
  let best = cands[0], bd = Infinity;
  for (const i of cands) {
    const p = PALRGB[i], rm = (v[0] + p[0]) >> 1, dr = v[0] - p[0], dg = v[1] - p[1], db = v[2] - p[2];
    const d = (((512 + rm) * dr * dr) >> 8) + 4 * dg * dg + (((767 - rm) * db * db) >> 8);
    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; }
  }
  return best;
}
function buildLightLUT(S) {
  const fam = new Int16Array(PAL_N).fill(-1), fixed = new Uint8Array(PAL_N), mat = new Int16Array(PAL_N).fill(-1), notLight = new Uint8Array(PAL_N);
  LIGHT_SETS.coatFamilies.forEach((f, k) => f.forEach((n) => { fam[C[n]] = k; }));
  LIGHT_SETS.materialFamilies.forEach((f, k) => f.forEach((n) => { mat[C[n]] = k; }));
  for (const n of LIGHT_SETS.fixed) fixed[C[n]] = 1;
  for (const n of LIGHT_SETS.notLight) notLight[C[n]] = 1;
  const light = [];                                      // colours any colour may take on in the light
  for (let i = 0; i < NPAL; i++) if (fam[i] < 0 && mat[i] < 0 && !notLight[i]) light.push(i);
  // Appended artwork shades may use the wider palette without changing existing
  // scenery's authored contrast (especially the three separate night skylines).
  const stableCount=LIGHT_SETS.stableColourCount||NPAL,stableLight=light.filter(i=>i<stableCount);
  const cands = (b,c) => {
    const base=c<stableCount?stableLight:light;
    return mat[b]<0?base:base.concat(LIGHT_SETS.materialFamilies[mat[b]].map(n=>C[n]).filter(i=>c>=stableCount||i<stableCount));
  };
  const lut = new Uint8Array(NLVL * PAL_N), shifts = !!(S.dim || S.lit || S.litFrom);
  for (let c = 0; c < PAL_N; c++) {
    for (let l = 0; l < NLVL; l++) {
      const from = l >= 3 && S.litFrom ? l + S.litFrom : l, b = LUT[from * PAL_N + c];
      let out = b;
      if (c < NPAL && !fixed[c] && !fixed[b] && fam[c] < 0 && fam[b] < 0) {   // a coat keeps its whole ramp, highlights too
        const T = l >= 3 ? S.lit : S.dim;
        if (T || from !== l) out = nearestColour(lightTransform(PALRGB[b], T), cands(b,c));
      }
      if (shifts && fam[c] < 0 && l > 0 && lumOf(out) < lumOf(lut[(l - 1) * PAL_N + c])) out = lut[(l - 1) * PAL_N + c];
      lut[l * PAL_N + c] = out;
    }
  }
  return lut;
}
// The board's light: in the sun the base ramps, the light its pieces were drawn for (snapping the day's sun to the
// nearest colours can merge a piece into the stone); in the shade the set's dimming at lightSets.board.dimStrength,
// so the board darkens a little with the evening. Lamps at night still shift it a level (litFrom).
function scaledSet(S, s) {
  const sc = (T) => T && { mul: T.mul && T.mul.map((m) => Math.round(256 + (m - 256) * s)), add: T.add && T.add.map((a) => Math.round(a * s)), mix: T.mix && [T.mix[0], Math.round(T.mix[1] * s)] };
  return { dim: sc(S.dim), lit: null, litFrom: S.litFrom };
}
const LIGHT_LUTS = {}, BOARD_LUTS = {}, LIGHT_TABLES = {};
for (const name of Object.keys(LIGHT_SETS.sets)) {
  const S = LIGHT_SETS.sets[name];
  LIGHT_LUTS[name] = buildLightLUT(S);
  BOARD_LUTS[name] = buildLightLUT(scaledSet(S, LIGHT_SETS.board.dimStrength));
  LIGHT_TABLES[name] = resolveTables(LIGHT_LUTS[name], BOARD_LUTS[name]);
}
let lightSetName = null;                                  // null: the base ramps (the sorting office)
function useLightSet(name) {
  const t = name ? LIGHT_TABLES[name] : null;
  RES32 = t ? t.res : BASE_TABLES.res; GRAY32 = t ? t.gray : BASE_TABLES.gray;
  lightSetName = t ? name : null;
}
// ============================================================================
// 21 CORE: constants, buffers, projection, rasterisers, sunlight
// World units (wu): 1 tile = 16 wu; z is in wu and 1 wu of z = 1 screen px.
// Projection (2:1 isometric): sx = OX + x - y ; sy = OY + (x + y) / 2 - z.
// Visible faces: TOP (+z), FY (+y, front-left), FX (+x, front-right).
// Depth (towards camera) = x + y + z, stored as 4x fixed point in Int16.
// ============================================================================
let LW = 320, LH = 200;                // logical view size: set on resize by the viewport rule (40_viewport)
// The baked world layer (views bigger than it show plain backdrop) and the pixel of world (0,0,0) in it.
// The sorting office uses 720 x 336 with (0,0,0) at (336, 104); a Box Room (34_boxroom) sets its own height
// and origin, up to WH_MAX rows, so its whole room and roof fit.
const WW = 720, WH_MAX = 400;
const OFFICE_LAYER = { WH: 336, OX: 336, OY: 104 };
let WH = OFFICE_LAYER.WH, OX = OFFICE_LAYER.OX, OY = OFFICE_LAYER.OY;
const SCN = SCENE_DATA;                  // room layout + props (src/data/scene.json)
const WS = WORLD.create(SCN, { mode: 'demo' });   // everything in the room that moves (sim/14_world); boot sets the mode
const TILE = SCN.tile;
const F_TOP = 0, F_Y = 1, F_X = 2;
const DEPTH_EMPTY = -32768;

// ---- small maths -----------------------------------------------------------
function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }
function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
function sstep(t) { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
function fract(v) { return v - Math.floor(v); }
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

// ---- ordered dither ---------------------------------------------------------
const BAYER = new Float32Array([0, 8, 2, 10, 12, 4, 14, 6, 3, 11, 1, 9, 15, 7, 13, 5].map(v => (v + 0.5) / 16));
function bayer(px, py) { return BAYER[((py & 3) << 2) | (px & 3)]; }

// ---- deterministic randomness -------------------------------------------------
let rngState = 1;
function rngSeed(s) { rngState = s >>> 0; }
function rnd() {                        // mulberry32
  rngState = (rngState + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
